bluejetty:00042129:ios.description:
Trying to get eight hours of sleep? Get your workout in? Finally finish that audiobook? BetterYou turns the things you mean to do into habits you actually keep — and makes keeping them the best part of your week.
Set your goals. We track them for you. Then you race real people to see who improves the most.
Pick goals across seven areas: fitness, sleep, mindfulness, social connection, learning, focus (screen time), and anything custom. BetterYou tracks your progress automatically wherever it can, learns your patterns, and nudges you before you fall off — not after.
AUTOMATIC TRACKING
Steps, workouts, and sleep sync from Apple Health. Connect a wearable — Fitbit, Garmin, Oura, Whoop, Withings, Polar, or Samsung Health — and it all flows in. Place goals check you in when you arrive at the gym, the studio, or the library.
WEEKLY TRIALS
The heart of the new BetterYou. Every week you're matched into a pod of people with similar habits and schedules, then compete for seven days. Finish strong and you promote; slip and you drop — Bronze to Diamond. Sunday brings the Ceremony: your weekly score, your Bolts, and your movement, revealed at once. You're scored on improvement, not raw numbers, so a beginner and a marathoner both have a real shot.
RIVALS AND BUDDY CHALLENGES
An accountability partner makes a goal far more likely to stick. Call out a rival in your pod, or challenge a friend head-to-head on steps, sleep, workouts, or mindful minutes.
COMMUNITY AND COMPANY CHALLENGES
Join open challenges alongside the whole BetterYou community, complete missions, and climb the leaderboard. If your employer offers BetterYou, your company's challenges show up here too.
EARN BOLTS, REDEEM FOR REAL REWARDS
Every workout, every good night's sleep, every goal you hit earns Bolts. Open a daily and a weekly Bolt Box. Spend them on titles and collectibles — and with Premium, cash them out for real gift cards.
LEVEL UP AND FIGHT WEEKLY BOSSES
Everything you do feeds one progression bar. Level up your BetterBot, and every few levels face a weekly boss you damage by logging real activity. XP never goes down, and skipping a week costs you nothing.
JOURNEYS
Guided 14, 21, and 30-day arcs that lay out a few daily bounties and adapt when life gets in the way. Fall behind and the map reroutes instead of failing you.
BETTERBOT, YOUR COACH
Chat with BetterBot about what's working. Log your mood in a tap, keep private notes, and get a short daily briefing built from your own data. BetterBot also shows up as a competitor — tuned to be beatable.
SLEEP THAT ADAPTS TO YOU
Instead of one static bedtime you never hit, BetterYou builds a weekly sleep plan anchored to how you're actually sleeping, then moves it about 15 minutes a week toward your goal. You get a 0-100 sleep score covering duration, timing, and consistency. No wearable? BetterYou can estimate your night from phone motion the next morning — nothing runs overnight.
SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Explore your stats, per-goal history, streaks, badges, and earned titles. Cheer the community on in the activity feed with tap-to-grow reactions. It all works offline and syncs when you're back.
BETTERYOU PREMIUM
Premium unlocks gift-card redemption for your Bolts, the full Journey catalog, levels past 50, and more.
BetterYou Premium is $30/year. This price is for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on your country of residence.
Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew in your Apple Account settings. Your account is charged when the purchase is confirmed.
Terms of Use: https://www.betteryou.ai/terms-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://www.betteryou.ai/privacy-policy/

A hack & slash idle RPG in a captivating fantasy world! Build a
bluejetty:00088147:ios.description:
◆ Artesnaut: Hardcore Idle Fantasy RPG
Experience a deep story of adventure with characters YOU create! Select from myriad jobs, races, and skills to build your perfect party!
A hack & slash idle RPG in a captivating fantasy world! Build a party of unique characters and conquer dungeons! Progress even when you can’t play! Start a quest and return later to reap the rewards and make the most of your time!
With classic, text-based gameplay, complete dungeons and unlock the next page of your epic adventure in Artesnaut!
◆ Four Key Features
- Unique “Epithet” system gives characters their own unique personalities!
One of Artesnaut’s most standout features is its flexible character creation. Create a character by choosing a job and race, then create their epithet by selecting various adjectives (Blazing, Righteous, Fearless, etc.) and nouns (Contender, Alchemist, Executioner, etc.) to gain stat bonuses! Make a brutal attacker, hearty guardian, savvy treasure hunter, or whatever you want, then pit your perfect party against perilous dungeons!
- Diverse, intertwined narrative that captivated 93% of Japanese players!
New pages of Artesnaut’s story unfold as you progress through dungeons, then read those stories to unlock new dungeons
Main Story chapters chronicle the protagonists’ adventures, and interwoven Side Story chapters provide intriguing new perspectives to enrich the world. We hope you find yourself deeply immersed in Artesnaut’s authentic medieval fantasy world!
- A text-based, idle RPG! Dungeoneer during your downtime!
Exploration and battles occur automatically, and characters return after a set time. Watch events unfold in real-time, or see how your party fared afterward. Did your brave adventurers return with rare loot, or did the dungeon’s perils get the better of them?
Forge equipment, earn experience, and learn uncanny skills to grow your favorite characters as they venture into ever-deeper dungeons, teeming with evermore perilous foes! Engrossing character progression that is easy to enjoy!
Randomly generated loot means you can keep questing for the perfect gear! Strengthen and combine equipment to create items as legendary as your adventures.
- Deep lore in every dungeon and piece of loot breathes life into the world of Artesnaut!
Approximately 1000 pieces of equipment, each with their own story to tell! What is it? Why was it made? The answers to these questions take you deeper into the world of Artesnaut! Each dungeon is packed with lore as well, tying together the intricate narrative. Delving into dungeons may reveal short passages related to their origins. What you learn may give clues to help you on your adventure, or offer more context to characters’ stories.
We present to you a vast, detailed world, rife with text to discover and enjoy!

bluejetty:00014115:ios.summary:
For a generation, the ArtScroll Siddur has been the unchallenged Siddur of choice across the English-speaking world.

Now bein
bluejetty:00014115:ios.description:
For a generation, the ArtScroll Siddur has been the unchallenged Siddur of choice across the English-speaking world.
We have transformed the Updated ArtScroll Wasserman Edition Ashkenaz Siddur into a Fully Digital Smart Siddur! 
Now being Joined by the Long Awaited Kest Family Edition Sefard Smart Siddur.
* ArtScroll's classic look & feel: the fonts, layout, nikud
* Tap on a phrase & you get the ArtScroll translation, commentary & sources
* Hundreds of Hyperlinks to Laws & references in the commentary
* Enlarge the font size & still keep the classic ArtScroll format
* Includes weekday Torah readings with phrase-by-phrase translation
* Synchronized Scrolling so you don't lose your place
But now the World's Best Selling Siddur is the World's Smartest Siddur!
* The ArtScroll Smart Siddur knows where you are, what the date is and dynamically changes to show you just what you need to see for that day
* The Smart Siddur can look like the Printed Siddur - but in smart mode all the you see is what you need to! All time bound insertions show up in blue so you wont miss them.
* With dynamic rules for Chanukah, Purim, Hallel, Rosh Chodesh, Proper Torah Reading, Erev Rosh Hashana, Sefirah, Tachanun, Fast Days, Days of Repentance, Chol Hamoed, Erev Shabbos, Erev Yom Kippur, Motzai Shabbos, Yom Kippur Katan, Bahab & dozens of additional dynamic changes.
* The Smart Table of Contents - shows you just the prayers that are for that day/time. Or Toggle to SHOW ALL & See Everything in the Siddur
* The Smart Repetition Feature will suppress all the portions of Shemonah Esrei that are only said by the Chazzan or during the repetition
* Minyan/No Minyan setting will suppress the portions of the prayers that are not said without a minyan
* House of Mourning Settings for changes to the prayers in a house of mourning.
* Chazan Mode - Highlights the sections that the Chazan says
* Set your location to Israel or Jerusalem & receive the appropriate prayers & customs for Israel
Customize the Siddur with your personal settings, that control how you want to use it.
* Turn the instructions on or off
* Control how optional prayers appear
* Change the font style
* Keep a Dynamic Misheberach list that appears in Shemonah Esrei
* Have the Verse for Your name dynamically appear in Shemonah Esrei
* Vertical Scrolling or regular pagination
* Adjust the navigation to be top or bottom or for Right/Left Handed operation
* Set how you want the translation to appear - separate pages/Phrase by Phrase side by Side or Below the Line
PLUS These Exclusive Features
* Put in personal notes, highlight text & Bookmark Selections & add ribbons.
* The commentary has every Reference to the Talmud Hyperlinked to the Schottenstein Talmud - for in-depth study
* Navigate the Smart Siddur by using the Printed ArtScroll Page Numbers
* The Search function allows you to instantly find any phrase in the Siddur
Plus These RustyBrick Features
* Zmanim - Get all the important Zmanim for your current location or other saved locations
* Luach & Events - Keep track of special dates & events. Sync with iCal. 
* Misheberach Lists - Private & Public lists that can appear in your prayers & in other peoples Siddurim
* Verses for Names - Enter your Hebrew name & your Verse will appear in Shemonah Esrei
* Map - See everyone who is using the Siddur around the world
* Mizrach & Tefillin Mirror
The Wasserman and Kest Siddurim Contain this Addtional Content:
* An original new Overview
* Yom Kippur Kattan
* Megillas Esther, Ruth & Koheles - with Phrase by Phrase Translation
* Perek Shirah
* Six Constant Mitzvos
* Iggeres HaRamban
* Prayer of the Holy Sh'lah
* Prayer at the Holy places in Israel
* Special section: The Laws, Customs, & Prayers in the Land of Israel
* Entire Megillah
* All of Tehillim

bluejetty:00121050:ios.name: Christmas Train Snowman Games
bluejetty:00121050:ios.summary: Christmas is here and it’s time for some fun with Christmas trains and reindeer games in the Christmas Train Snowman Games App! This entertaining and imagination evoking app was designed by teachers with over 15 years childcare experience
bluejetty:00121050:ios.description:
Christmas is here and it’s time for some fun with Christmas trains and reindeer games in the Christmas Train Snowman Games App! This entertaining and imagination evoking app was designed by teachers with over 15 years childcare experience, using their philosophy of learning through play. The Christmas train sounds will keep you entertained while you delve into different Christmas worlds with music and train horn sounds. Then jump into those different worlds and help Santa collect sweet and fun items in the exciting platform jumping game. The icing on this app is the Christmas ABC book, which will delight all ages with 26 different Christmas themed pictures. If you love Christmas then hop on board for some true holiday fun with the Christmas Train Snowman Games App!
Build A Snowman
Building a snowman is fun, but have you ever built a police snowman, or a snow princess? This entertaining game will keep little ones delighted as they tap and build a snow fireman, fairy, baseball player, pirate, and more! Make magic happen when you tap the screen, hear cute music and a sound when they are done.
Christmas Train Sounds
Jingle toot toot! Everyone thrills to see a Christmas train and with 5 interactive sounds to delight and entertain you you’re sure to have a blast! The trains are all ready for Christmas and they take you into different holiday inspired worlds as they drive by. Also on the page are more cute Christmas things to tap and hear what sound they make, including Christmas tunes. These Christmas train sounds will delight all train lovers and everyone who loves the holidays!
Santa Reindeer Games
Santa needs help! He’s busy at this time of year and needs help to collect some things he likes and might have misplaced, like his favorite cookies and his reindeer. Each exciting game takes you into a different world, the same cute Christmas worlds as the sounds, as you use the platforms to make Santa jump and collect his items, while listening to boppy Christmas music. Every game has a different amount to collect and when you find everything Santa needs then you get a sound reward because Santa thinks you’re great! It’s an interactive and fun game that is sure to get you into the Christmas spirit.
Christmas ABC Book
Santa loves to read as much as he loves trains so he knows you’ll adore the Christmas ABC book! Filled with cute Christmasy pictures that will make your Christmas spirit sing this fun book will delight all holiday lovers. Of course Santa knows the building blocks to reading are letter recognition and seeing how the letter is pronounced in a word, so he wants all potential elves to have fun learning letters in this Christmas inspired book. 
Present Tap
Who doesn't love to open presents? In this delight-filled game your little one taps the present to reveal the toy inside. But the real fun is they never know how many times they have to tap it or what it's going to do before it opens! And after the toy pops out they can tap it to hear what sound it makes. Pure Christmas fun!
Sound the Christmas train horns and whistles and have a delight-filled time playing with trains, reindeer's, and Santa games in the Christmas Train Snowman Games App, where learning through play encourages you to have fun while sharpening imagination, skills, and letter recognition. If you love Christmas and Santa and fun this is the app for you!

bluejetty:00042436:ios.description:
Heart Rate Monitor, Health App helps you accurately measure, check and monitor your heart rate (HR), pulse rate and heart rate variability (HRV) , making it simple to track your heart rate performance, and understand your fitness, activity, stress and health.
FEATURES
▸ Heart Rate or Heartbeat Monitor
▸ Detailed Analysis of HRV Score, SDNN, RMSSD, Mean NN, PNN50
▸ Tag for Resting Heart Rate (RHR), Exercise Heart Rate...
▸ Tips for Better Health and Fitness
▸ Easily Check Heart Rate History
▸ Unlimited Measurement
USER'S REVIEW
"It amazes me that it was so accurate. I compared it to a monitor I have for my fingers to measure my heartbeat and I done old fashion pulse check and count method. Both times I tested and compared, it was dead on."
HOW IT WORKS
▸Place and lightly hold your forefinger on the back camera lens and stay still. The heart rate is shown after few seconds.
▸Do not press too hard when you measure your pulse heart rate, otherwise blood circulation will be altered and the results in your pulse app could be affected.
▸Make sure there is a bright background, otherwise the app won't be able to detect your heartbeat. 
▸The camera flash can help to create a bright background. It will get hot, don't burn yourself.
MEDICAL DISCLAIMER
· iHeart should not be used as a medical device in the diagnosis of heart diseases
· Please seek a doctor’s advice in addition to using this app and before making any medical decisions
· iHeart is not intended for a medical emergency. Consult your primary care physician if you need any help
· In some devices, iHeart may make the LED flash very hot
SUPPORT

- Terms: https://www.iheart.io/terms.html
- Privacy: https://www.iheart.io/privacy.html
CONTACT US
If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to send us an email at feedbackiheart@gmail.com. 
FOLLOW US
Stay tuned to our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/iHeartApp/ for more information!
We’d love to hear from you.

bluejetty:00018994:ios.description:
Color Code is the logic game where you must crack the secret code. Every colour combination is possible. Play alone against the computer, with a friend on the same device, or online with Game Center.
◆◆ HOW TO PLAY
You have 10 tries to find the code. Build a combination and check it to get clues:
• Red peg: a colour is right and in the right place.
• White peg: a colour is right but in the wrong place.
• No peg: neither the colour nor the place is right.
In the settings you can also choose black and white pegs and marbles with symbols.
◆◆ GAME MODES
• Training: play against the computer and choose your options.
• 1 Player: 16 levels of increasing difficulty, with more and more colours to use. Watch the time limit: a game that takes too long is lost. Your level is saved, along with your best score for each level.
• 2 Players: play with someone on the same device.
• Online: face another player connected through Game Center. Choose the code your opponent must find, then find theirs as fast as you can, in as few tries as possible. You earn 1 point for each game won. If your opponent leaves the game, you are notified.
• Game Center leaderboard and achievements.
◆◆ SETTINGS
• Game language.
• Style of pegs and marbles.
• Banner position (top or bottom), free for everyone.
• "More games" screen to discover our other games.
• Works on iPhone and iPad, including iPhone Duo.
◆◆ IN-APP PURCHASE
Remove all advertising from the game.
◆◆ USEFUL LINKS
Questions and support : https://dunjegame.com/Support.html
Privacy policy : https://dunjegame.com/PrivacyPolicy.html
Flags : www.nordicfactory.com

bluejetty:00124269:ios.description:
Weed Street$ is a weed grow-op simulator and city builder from the team that brought you the legendary Weed Firm.
In Weed Street$ you start with nothing but a bag of weed and some potential customers looking for hemp’s medicinal or recreational benefits. Obtain a growing and selling license and sell that weed to make cash and slowly but surely rise to become the owner of the whole street.
Buy and renovate dilapidated buildings to launch businesses, hire staff and make even more cash. Expand and upgrade those businesses to grow your cash stack and become richer and richer.
But never forget your roots. Grow weed and make edibles in your upstairs grow-ops. Expand and upgrade those grow-ops and the weed hungry customers looking for medicinal or recreational marijuana will flock to your street in great numbers.
It is not all going to be carefree though. Cops will stop by to check your license, gangbangers will want a piece of your success and wreck your shops. If you stop and just rest on your laurels you will be eaten alive. Never stop growing.
And once the street becomes too small of a playground for you, expand to other streets and slowly take over the whole world!
Jah be with You. Peace.

bluejetty:00122935:ios.description:
Vous avez décidé de souscrire un compte LCL ou simplement de suivre en temps réel votre situation bancaire, l'application est faite pour vous !
• SOUSCRIVEZ UN COMPTE BANCAIRE EN LIGNE EN QUELQUES MINUTES
Peu importe votre profil (étudiant, jeune actif, salarié, chef d'entreprise, profession libérale, sénior) profitez d'offres bancaires adaptées à vos besoins mais aussi de toute l'expertise LCL.
Pour ce faire, munissez-vous :
- d'une pièce d'identité
- d'un numéro de mobile français
- si vous êtes étudiant, votre justificatif de scolarité
Disponible exclusivement pour les personnes majeures et résidant en France.
En quelques minutes vous pourrez :
- créer un compte en ligne
- trouver l'agence qui vous conviendra le mieux
- choisir la carte bancaire adaptée à vos besoins
Une fois client, ou si vous l'êtes déjà, vous pourrez consulter à tout moment vos comptes bancaires, vos crédits, vos assurances mais aussi rester en contact avec votre conseiller.
• CONNEXION BIOMÉTRIQUE (TOUCH ID / FACE ID)
Connectez-vous et validez vos opérations en ligne grâce à votre empreinte digitale ou à la reconnaissance faciale
Pensez à mémoriser votre profil si vous souhaitez accéder à cette fonction
• MON COMPTE EN UN COUP D'ŒIL
Affichez dès la page d'accueil, ou via le widget, un aperçu du solde de votre compte en banque et de l'encours carte
• VOTRE SYNTHÈSE
Gérez vos comptes:
- Retrouvez vos contrats par famille (Compte, Epargne, Crédit, Assurance)
- Ajoutez et consultez vos comptes de vos autres établissements bancaires
- Personnalisez les libellés de vos comptes LCL et hors LCL
- Consultez vos relevés de comptes
- Retrouvez vos opérations comptabilisées par libellé ou par montant avec notre moteur de recherche.
- Contestez un prélèvement ou annulez une autorisation de prélèvement
Consultez tous vos crédits (découvert autorisé, prêt immobilier...) :
- Gérez votre crédit renouvelable
- Souscrire et suivre un crédit à la consommation (prêt personnel, crédit instantané)
- S'informer, simuler ou suivre un prêt immobilier
Consultez vos contrats d'assurance et faites un devis
Ouvrez un compte pour vos enfants
• EFFECTUEZ DES VIREMENTS
Transférez immédiatement de l'argent avec le virement instantané
Utilisez Wero pour envoyer ou demander de l'argent
Créez et gérez vos virements ainsi que vos bénéficiaires
Modifiez en temps réel votre plafond de virement et votre liste de pays autorisés depuis votre appareil de confiance
• MON ESPACE CARTE
Gérez vos cartes bancaires, ainsi que celles de vos enfants mineurs, en toute autonomie :
- Activez / désactivez le paiement sans contact ou le paiement sur internet
- Consultez le code confidentiel de votre carte
- Verrouillez / déverrouillez votre carte en temps réel
- Modifiez vos plafonds de carte
Activez le paiement mobile avec Apple Pay®
Accédez à votre carte virtuelle temporaire en cas d'opposition d'une de vos cartes bancaires
Activez, modifiez ou désactivez l'option System' Epargne
• ESPACE CONSEILLER
Besoin de conseils ou d'information? Retrouvez les coordonnées de votre conseiller et de votre agence
Prenez rendez-vous en agence ou à distance dans l'agenda de votre conseiller.
Avec la messagerie communiquez et envoyez des documents.
• MES ACTUS
Retrouvez l'actualité de votre compte, les échéances de vos cartes, vos rendez-vous avec votre
Conseiller, les confirmations de vos saisies d'IBAN, etc.
• ÉGALEMENT DANS VOTRE APPLICATION
Commandez votre chéquier pour le recevoir chez vous ou à votre agence LCL
Analysez votre appareil pour vérifier la présence d'applications malveillantes
SOS Cartes : Faites opposition rapidement en cas de perte ou vol d'une carte bancaire

bluejetty:00160825:ios.description:
Embark on an exhilarating journey through the urban jungle in Rooftops Parkour Freerun! This dynamic mobile game puts you in the shoes of a fearless freerunner, navigating the treacherous rooftops of towering skyscrapers. Your objective: complete increasingly challenging levels by executing breathtaking parkour moves and stunts.
Experience the thrill of realistic parkour physics that bring every move to life. The intuitive controls allow you to perform seamless sequences of movements, testing your reflexes and precision. Each level is a meticulously designed location, filled with obstacles, gaps, and opportunities to showcase your agility.
Key Features:
Realistic Parkour Physics: Feel the rush of lifelike parkour mechanics as you jump and climb across rooftops, wall-running, making tricks and stunts.
Challenging Levels: Progress through a variety of levels, each with unique layouts and obstacles that demand quick thinking and expert timing.
Stunning Urban Environments: Immerse yourself in the vibrant cityscape, with detailed graphics and immersive soundscapes that heighten the sense of adventure.
Smooth Controls: Enjoy fluid and responsive controls that make mastering complex parkour moves accessible and fun.
First-Person Mode with Bodycamera Effect: Experience the adrenaline-pumping action from a first-person perspective, enhanced by a dynamic bodycam effect that puts you right in the middle of the action.
Are you ready to defy gravity and become the ultimate freerunner? Download Rooftops Parkour Freerun now and start your rooftop adventure!

bluejetty:00005776:ios.summary:
Throw away your pads and pencils, Clued Up will make you a Clue champion.

bluejetty:00005776:ios.description:
Throw away your pads and pencils, Clued Up will make you a Clue champion.
Clued Up transforms your messy notes into a crisp table, showing you for each card, at a glance: who’s holding it, who’s not holding it, who’s suggested it, who’s seen it and the likelihood of it being the card in the envelope. All you have to do is enter the details of each turn.
If you don’t want to give your opponents a chance Clued Up can go beyond just a smart scorecard. If you enable automatic deductions the app will cross-reference all of the turns in the game and locate cards for you, going way beyond what a human could achieve.
Clued Up works with pretty much any edition of Clue. 
Including: 
Alfred Hitchcock
Alien Vs. Predator
The Big Bang Theory
Doctor Who
Downton Abbey
Dungeons and Dragons
Family Guy
Firefly
Five Nights at Freddy’s
Game of Thrones
Golden Girls
Harry Potter
The Haunted Mansion
Juicy Couture
Legend of Zelda
The Office
Penny Dreadful
Rick and Morty Back in Blackout
Scooby-Doo!
Seinfeld
Sherlock
Simpsons
Star Wars
Supernatural
The Twilight Zone
The Walking Dead
If you don’t see your edition listed you can use the card set editing feature to create any edition you like and store it in the cloud for others to use.
Instructions
Game Setup:
Enter your name then the names of your opponents in the order they are sitting, starting with the player on your left.
Select if you want the game to automatically locate cards for you. If you select to use this feature, as you record the turns in the game the app will cross-reference the location of cards from all of the player's responses and deduce for you what cards must have been shown in each go. Be sure that your opponents don’t mind you winning if you leave this switch on (or don’t tell them).
Once you’ve entered the names of the players in the game you’ll be given the option to select which edition of the game you are playing. If you don’t see your edition listed then you can create a new edition. Any edition you create will be stored in the cloud for yourself and other players to use.
After selecting your card set you then have to enter in all of the cards you have been dealt. Enter every card you are holding and then press finish.
Playing the Game:
On the main screen, you have a list of all of the items. Eliminated items are shown in blue, items held by you in green and solved items are shown in red. Underneath the item name, you will see additional information such as who does or does not hold the card, who has suggested a card and who has seen a card. You will also see stats indicating how likely each card is to be the final item as a percentage and with the progress bar under each card.
To eliminate items you need to make suggestions and enter in the suggestions that your opponents make. The app will automatically eliminate a card if it is shown to you and, if you’ve selected to have the game located cards for you, when entering another player’s suggestion, if a card is shown and it’s known that the other two cards in the suggestion are elsewhere or not held by that player the game will automatically eliminate these.
To enter your suggestion you pick the items from the table and press the ‘Your Suggestion’ button. You will ask the player to your left, if they don’t show a card to you press ‘No Cards Shown’ and move on to the next player, if they show a card you select the card from the wheel and press ‘Card Shown’.
To enter an opponent’s suggestion you do the same thing except you select ‘Other’s Suggestion’ and, on the next screen, select the player making the suggestion.
You can manually enter that a player holds or doesn’t hold a particular card by swiping the cell to the left a pressing the Eliminate/Uneliminate button.
The app will tell you when cards locations are deduced and categories are solved.
You can undo your last move if you make a mistake by pressing the menu button and selecting Undo.

Check Balances – See current account balances for your checking, savings, money market and certificate of deposits as well as your loan balances. 
View Transactions – View recent transaction history in your deposit accounts and search for specific transactions by date, amount, or check number. 
Transfer Funds – Transfer funds between your eligible West Pointe Bank deposit accounts. 
Mobile Deposit - Save a trip to the bank and use your supported, camera-equipped mobile device to deposit checks.*
*Customers that are eligible to use the Mobile Deposit service will have the “Make Deposit” option available within the app. 
Disclosures
While West Pointe Bank does not charge a fee for mobile banking, third party text messaging and data rates may apply. A supported mobile device is needed to use the West Pointe Bank Mobile Banking App. Must be enrolled in Online Banking; simply use the same user name and password to login to Mobile Banking. Certain other restrictions apply. See the West Pointe Bank Mobile Banking Service Agreement for more details.

bluejetty:00119861:ios.description:
Have you ever wondered how busy is the library, the museum, the pool or even the city hall? 
Affluences gives you an answer in real time! 
Stop indefinitely searching for a place to study and better prepare your visits thanks to our attendance prediction algorithm: anticipate queues and packed places.
We provide a 24/7 transparent information so that you can keep organized and stick to your plans.
----
Affluences is currently available for partner libraries, museums, swimming pools, cafeterias and public administrations.
If your favourite place is not available yet, just let us know! 
We are always trying to work with new partners so feel free to mention the app whenever you can.
----
How do we predict attendance and waiting time?
The Affluences technology computes several inputs (sensors, visiting history, users...) to generate an accurate measure of live occupation and waiting time. 
If you’d like to learn more, feel free to contact us.
----
Affluences is free and without ads.

bluejetty:00069832:ios.description:
Ощадбанк запустив абсолютно новий додаток – Мобільний Ощад. Зараз це нова версія. Ми хочемо дати нашим клієнтам можливість скористатись новим додатком, щоб отримати зворотний зв'язок. Ми будемо регулярно оновлювати Мобільний Ощад, щоб зробити його максимально зручним та функціональним.
Мобільний Ощад – вже має майже всі сервіси, які були в попередньому додатку. Все зручно, просто, швидко. За чашкою кави чи на дивані відкривайте і поповнюйте депозити, погашайте кредити, переказуйте гроші, сплачуйте за комунальні та інші послуги, керуйте картками, рахунками та налаштовуйте додаток під себе. А ми поступово будемо наповнювати додаток новим функціоналом.
Чому новий додаток?
Мобільний Ощад – простий та зрозумілий, ближчий ніж найближче відділення, вміє все тільки готівку не видає. Додаток працює набагато швидше, ніж попередній. Тут реально немає черг та перерви на обід. Звичні послуги в новому дизайні.
Який новий функціонал?
В Мобільному Ощаді додано понад 10 нових функцій та фішок:
• Вхід по номеру телефону, а якщо клієнт не пам’ятає свої логін чи пароль, достатньо ввести номер телефону та легко відновити пароль.
• Додаток став ще безпечніший – додано верифікацію по PIN-коду картки.
• Додано вибір основного продукту та можливість змінювати порядок відображення продуктів на головній сторінці.
• Можна скопіювати номер картки та CVV.
• Додано функцію швидкого поповнення картки, всього декілька кліків.
• Деталізовано інформацію по продуктах та історії операцій для кредитів, депозитів, та поточних рахунків.
• Мобільні заощадження тепер як окремий продукт – їх зручно відкривати та поповнювати.
• Легко контролювати використання лімітів – додано візуалізацію витрат в рамках встановленого ліміту.
• Обміняти валюту тепер простіше – додано окремий розділ «Обмін валют» та конвертер валют.
• Перекази грошей ще зручніші: за номером телефону, за номером картки, а при переказі на карту іншого банку відображається логотип банку-отримувача для того, щоб впевнитись в коректності вказаного номеру карти.
• Сплачувати за комунальні послуги простіше – регіон клієнта обраний за замовчуванням, а всі послуги тепер відображаються в розрізі категорій.
• Шаблони та підписки з попереднього додатку будуть доступні в Мобільному Ощаді автоматично, не потрібно їх заводити повторно.
Це не все! Ми будемо регулярно оновлювати Мобільний Ощад і додавати нові функції, щоб зробити його максимально зручним для вас. Слідкуйте за релізами, щоб нічого не пропустити. Встановіть додаток, знайомтеся з його функціоналом, інтуїтивним інтерфейсом та користуйтесь послугами банку онлайн. Знайомтесь з діджитальними працівниками додатку – ощадиками. Вони милі, кумедні і дуже працьовиті.

bluejetty:00120520:ios.description:
Quran for All - Structured Islamic Learning
Quran for All is an Islamic learning app designed to help you study the Quran, Tafsir, Hadith, Seerah, Tajweed, and Duas through structured Islamic lectures and guided learning series.
Inspired by the vision of Dr. Farhat Hashmi: "Quran for All, in every hand, in every heart", the app aims to make authentic Islamic knowledge accessible, organized, and easy to follow.
Quran for All is an app by Al-Huda International.
It brings together Quran study, Islamic lectures, and learning resources in one place so you can listen, reflect, and continue learning consistently.
Learn the Quran With Understanding
Listen to lectures covering:
- Quran recitation
- Tafsir (explanation of the Quran)
- Hadith studies
- Seerah (life of the Prophet PBUH)
- Tajweed lessons
- Duas and supplications
- Islamic knowledge and guidance
Lessons are organized into structured learning series, helping you build understanding step by step.
Structured Learning Through Series
Instead of scattered lectures, Quran for All organizes Islamic knowledge into clear lecture series and courses.
You can navigate lessons by:
- Day
- Juz
- Para
- Topic
- Series
This structured approach allows you to follow complete Quran courses and Islamic lecture series with continuity and clarity.
Listen Anytime With a Simple Audio Experience
The app is designed for Islamic audio learning, allowing you to listen to lectures throughout your day.
Features include:
- Resume lectures from where you stopped
- Adjustable playback speed
- Skip forward and backward easily
- Background audio playback
- Download lectures for offline listening
Whether you are commuting, traveling, or reflecting at home, you can continue listening to Quran lessons and Islamic lectures without interruption.
Study With Integrated Learning Resources
Many lessons include contextual learning resources that support deeper understanding.
These may include:
- Lesson transcripts
- Visual mindmaps
- PDF study notes
- Additional learning materials
These resources allow you to go beyond listening and engage in guided Quran study and reflection.
Search Islamic Lectures Easily
Find the lecture you need quickly.
Search by:
- Scholar or speaker
- Lecture series
- Topic or keyword
- Quran themes or subjects
Discover lectures related to Quran, Tafsir, Hadith, Seerah, and Islamic studies easily.
Your Personal Learning Library
Create your own learning space inside the app.
You can:
- Save lectures to favorites
- Access recently played sessions
- Download lectures for offline listening
Your progress stays organized so you can continue your Islamic learning journey anytime.
Learning That Continues Anywhere
With offline listening and structured lecture series, Quran for All makes it easier to stay connected to the Quran and authentic Islamic knowledge wherever you are.
Whether you are studying Tafsir, listening to Hadith, or learning Tajweed, the app helps support consistent learning and reflection.
Quran for All - In every hand, in every heart.
Inspired by the vision of Dr. Farhat Hashmi.
An app by Al-Huda International.

bluejetty:00145167:ios.description:
Supercharge your mobile workflow with the Frame.io experience on the smaller screen. Now it’s easier than ever to collaborate, review, and manage work with your team, clients, and other stakeholders from anywhere in the world using the Frame.io app for iPhone and iPad.
Rebuilt from the ground up
Customize how you view your assets — then scroll, scrub, zoom, and comment with incredible precision and responsiveness. Built natively in Swift, the Frame.io iOS and iPadOS apps allow you to bring the Frame.io experience with you anywhere.
Find what you need faster
Search comes to the Frame.io iPhone and iPad apps for the first time. Quickly find the assets, folders, or projects you need on the go.
Experience a faster workflow
Group, tag, and sort assets by out-of-the-box and custom metadata. Edit those fields right in the player — like Status or Rating, when you need to quickly approve on-the-go.
Review more accurately
Scroll, scrub, zoom, and comment with incredible precision and responsiveness. Pinch-and-zoom videos and images up to 400% to inspect fine details. Navigate quickly between assets by swiping left or right. Control your playback speed and resolution, and double-tap to skip backwards and forwards.
Comment more effectively 
Leave anchored comments, include links and attachments for reference — even include emojis. Or draw annotations using the new full-screen experience. Over a dozen new commenting features help you get the point across faster.
Customize your Shares
Curate and send professional-looking shares from your iPhone or iPad. All the settings and controls are right there at your fingertips — title, description, appearance, visibility, and more.
See everything the way you’d like to see it
Customize your view including List and Grid options, thumbnail size, and aspect ratio. Reorder visible fields like Status and Rating, or easily sort by fields for more control over your browsing experience.
Enhanced file and folder management
Manage files and folders as easily as using Frame.io on your desktop. Rename, move, copy, export, and delete files and folders, modify files in bulk, or navigate through all your assets with full folder path support.
Reduce notification fatigue
Get more granular control over which notifications you get and where you get them.

bluejetty:00089654:ios.summary:
World leader in Muslim travel. Use our unique halal-friendly filters to book hotels and villas worldwide. Find women-only pools, beaches and spas, alcohol-free areas and halal food. Beach holidays, Umrah trips, city breaks and more.
Our tr
bluejetty:00089654:ios.description:
World leader in Muslim travel. Use our unique halal-friendly filters to book hotels and villas worldwide. Find women-only pools, beaches and spas, alcohol-free areas and halal food. Beach holidays, Umrah trips, city breaks and more.
Our trusted app features over 500,000 hotels and villas worldwide and helps you find the best choice of accommodation for you and your family with its unique filters and features. Sign up for immediate discounts.
Women-only beaches, pools & spas
Ensure peace of mind by finding hotels with women-only leisure facilities, including resort hotels with secure women-only areas featuring beaches, pools, restaurants, masjids and more, alongside separate family and men-only amenities.
Villas with secluded pools
Find a villa with a completely private, fully secluded pool where you and your family can relax, knowing you can’t be seen from outside.
Hotels & beaches where burkinis are permitted
Find accommodation and leisure facilities where modest swimwear is allowed, wherever in the world you are visiting.
DIY Umrah
Our unique features help you to make the best choice of accommodation in Makkah and Madinah. Find rooms with Kaaba or Haram view. Choose hotels in walking distance of the Haram or with a free shuttle service. In Madinah, check which way your hotel is facing and the distance to the Ladies section.
Family-friendly accommodation
Enter your family group with the ages of any children, together with any other families in your party, and find room options which are an exact fit. See at a glance whether there are adjacent or connecting rooms available.
Holidays for all tastes
We offer all types of accommodation from beach resorts to Umrah, city breaks to ski holidays, spa and wellness retreats and even business trips. Wherever and whenever you are travelling, we can help you travel the world in line with your faith.
Big savings with HB Loyalty Club
Sign up to the HB Loyalty Club to benefit from immediate savings, increasing to up to 20%. Also enjoy privileges such as room upgrades, late check-out and early check-in.
Reviews from like-minded travellers
Read verified hotel reviews from our community of like-minded travellers to pick up tips from their first-hand experience.
Holiday your way
Find accommodation which suits your needs and allows you to travel in line with your faith. Pick your top priorities and use our filters to find hotels and villas which fulfil your requirements.
User-friendly app
Explore our easy-to-use and intuitive filters and features to find the accommodation which best suits your needs – whether it is for a beach holiday, Umrah trip, city break, ski holiday or spa retreat.
Trusted by Muslim travellers worldwide
Our trusted platform serves halal-conscious travellers from across the world, earning us a prestigious 5 star Trustpilot rating from thousands of reviews.
Ten years’ experience
We are world-leaders in halal-friendly travel, using over ten years of expertise to refine and improve our app to offer you the most detailed unique information and widest range of choices.

bluejetty:00041136:ios.description:
Learn Azure is an app which helps you to become Microsoft Azure Certified Professional from fundamentals, to role-based and expert level. Learn Azure is an “always here” assistant in boosting your Azure skills from any level of experience. Also check out our web platform at LearnCloudAcademy.com.
Learn Azure app has already helped more than 100,000+ specialists to improve their Microsoft Azure skills, become certified professionals and boost their IT-career. Download the app today and achieve your career goals faster.
There are preparation for most popular Azure Certification exams right now. Such as
• AZ-900 - Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
• AI-900 - Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals
• AZ-104 - Microsoft Azure for Administrators
• AZ-204 - Microsoft Azure for Developers
• AZ-400 - Microsoft Azure for DevOps experts
• AZ-305 - Microsoft Azure for Solution Architects
• DP-900 - Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals
• DP-203 - Data Engineering on Microsoft Azure
There are no narrowly focused high-quality mobile applications to prepare for the Microsoft Azure exams. We know it is currently impossible to test knowledge in the conditions close to the exam with Microsoft Azure, but we have solved this problem!
Additional Features of app:
→ Learn offline. No internet connection required to pass tests and exams
→ Learn Azure Community which is ready to assist you anytime
→ All that you want to know about Cloud Computing and Azure is in this app
→ Track progress. Self-motivate with achievements and reminders
• AZ-900 - Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
Do you begin with MS Azure or Cloud computing? Going to pass the AZ-900 Microsoft certification exam? Start here! You choose where to invest your time:
→ 150+ tutorials sorted by 15 separated categories
→ Full video course with 62 videos that cover all topics of Azure and more
→ Lots of practice labs to apply your knowledge in real environment
→ Validate knowledge with Quizzes on each topic you learned
→ AZ-900 Exam Simulator with unlimited attempts and hundreds of questions
→ Track your progress, receive reminders and content updates
• AZ-104 - Microsoft Azure for Administrators
Are you Microsoft Azure Administrator or going to take this job position? Already familiar with MS Azure services and keen to dive deeper into managing Azure? Want to become a certified Microsoft Azure Administrator? Choose this one!
→ 200+ tutorials sorted by 17 separated categories
→ Full AZ-104 preparation video course, which covers all topics of the exam
→ Hands-on Practice labs to improve your Azure administrator skills in a real environment
→ Validate knowledge with Quizzes on each topic you learned
→ AZ-104 Exam Simulator with terms and topics from real certification exam
• AZ-204 - Developing Solutions for Microsoft Azure
Are you a developer on Microsoft Technology stack like me? Are you a .NET/ASP.NET Core/WebAPI developer? Are you developing mobile apps and backend for them using Xamarin/.NET MAUI and ASP.NET WebAPI MVC? Going to become → → → → Microsoft Azure Certified Developer? Choose the AZ-204 exam and boost your career!
→ 250+ tutorials carefully sorted by categories to reduce cognitive load
→ Full Microsoft Azure for Developers video course
→ Practice with hands-on labs! Write code, setup Azure services, deploy your web-apps and microservices. This is the key to become an expert Azure developer
→ Validate knowledge with Quizzes on each topic you learned
→ AZ-204 Exam Simulator with unlimited attempts and questions
• AZ-400 - Designing and Implementing Microsoft DevOps Solutions 
Only for experts. Want to boost your career, skills and salary as a result? Microsoft Azure DevOps certification may be the last point of your journey to become an Azure guru. 
→ 100+ tutorials which cover all topics for Azure DevOps 
→ Full video course for Azure DevOps
→ Validate knowledge with 26 unique tests for Azure DevOps
→ AZ-400 Exam Simulator with unlimited attempts

bluejetty:00095746:ios.description:
Can you power a tiny town.. sustainably?
Eco Power Towns is a thoughtful strategy puzzle where every placement matters. Generate clean energy using solar, wind, tidal and biomass technologies; all while managing your limited resources. Upgrade, research, and optimize your layout to reach the energy goal and light up all the cozy homes.
What to expect?
- Contains no text at all: the entire game is icon-driven and intuitive.
- Build solar panels, windmills, biomass plants, tidal generators and more.
- Hints are available in case you get stuck on a level.
- Reach energy goals before you run out of resources
- Light up cozy houses across forests, swamps, hills, and rocky terrain
- Unlock research upgrades to improve your production efficiency
- Explore handcrafted levels of increasing challenge
- Solve satisfying puzzles that reward careful planning
- Enjoy peaceful lo-fi beat vibes and a clean, minimalist art style
- A paid game: no ads, no tracking, no distractions, no data collected
- Haptic Feedback
- Game Center & Achievements
I'm a solo game developer who made this game with a lot of care and love. I hope Eco Power Towns brings you a little joy, a little challenge, and a lot of cozy energy.

bluejetty:00039812:ios.description:
Hey Sunrise: Sunrise & Sunset Times
Never miss a perfect sunrise or sunset again! Hey Sunrise delivers precise sun timing information (including sunrise and sunset) with recurring sunrise and sunset alarms, customizable sunrise/sunset notifications, beautiful widgets, an interactive map for exploring sunrise and sunsets, and detailed solar data for any location worldwide, all displayed in a simplistic, ad-free user interface. 
Perfect for:
- Photographers capturing sunrise, sunset, golden hour, or blue hour
- Outdoor enthusiasts planning activities around sunrise and sunset
- People practicing sunrise meditation or yoga
- Travelers adjusting to different time zones
- Gardeners monitoring sunlight exposure
- Homebuyers who want to check where the sun rises and sets in their new backyard
- Anyone who appreciates nature's daily rhythm
Key Features:
Sun Alarms
- Set customizable alarms for sunrise and sunset
- Configure alarms to trigger up to 120 minutes before or after sunrise and sunset
- Select specific days of the week for alarms to trigger
- Advanced alarm settings like snooze and countdown
Smart Notifications
- Set customizable alerts for sunrise and sunset
- Configure notifications up to 120 minutes before or after sunrise and sunset
- Select specific days of the week for notifications to trigger
- Maximize sunshine and never miss the perfect lighting conditions again
Beautiful Home Screen Widgets
- 6 different widget styles to choose from showing sunrise, sunset, and other solar data
- Display your most important sun data at a glance
Interactive Sun Angle Map
- Track the sun’s position on a map
- View what direction the sun is coming from when the sun rises and sets
- Follow the path of the sun throughout the day
- Explore the direction of the sun for any time, date, or location
- Watch how the sun patterns change throughout the year
Comprehensive Sun Information
- Precise sunrise and sunset times for any location
- Total daylight hours and daily daylight change
- Solar noon times
- Astronomical, nautical, and civil twilight times
- Golden hour and blue hour times
- Detailed day-by-day sun information
- Solstice information, including summer solstice dates and winter solstice dates
Location Management
- Automatic GPS location detection
- Search for any location worldwide
- Save and organize favorite locations
- Quick switching between multiple saved locations
- Choose locations for your widgets
Personalization Options
- Choose between light and dark modes
- Select custom color themes to match your style
- Configure which sun metrics appear on your home screen
- Customize date and time formats to your preference
User-Friendly Design
- Intuitive, easy-to-navigate interface
- Clean, distraction-free presentation of information
- Fast loading times and minimal battery usage
- No account creation required
Family Sharing
- Share your Hey Sunrise Premium membership with the rest of your household members!
Hey Sunrise is the perfect companion for photographers seeking the perfect light, outdoor enthusiasts planning activities around daylight hours, or anyone who wants to stay connected with nature's rhythm.
Whether you're capturing stunning sunrise photos, planning outdoor adventures around daylight hours before sunset, or simply want to know when to expect darkness, Hey Sunrise provides all the solar information you need in one beautiful, easy-to-use app, ad-free app.
Download Hey Sunrise today and never miss a perfect sunrise or sunset again!

bluejetty:00016820:ios.description:
You Spoke, We Listened! 
Introducing the all-new My Robi App redesigned from scratch based on User Feedback and In-Depth User Research! It is now the one-stop single destination for meeting all your mobile and lifestyle needs with just a few taps on your smartphone screen. Thanks to the host of new and improved features, you don’t need to memorize complicated codes or wait in queue at the call center anymore!
Always Stay on Top! 
Check all your balances and history in one place and avail Jhotpot Loan when you're running out!
- Have it your way!
 Explore our lucrative offers personalized just for you or make your own packs from EasyPlan!
- Keep Your Family Closer! 
Manage up to 5 Secondary Accounts and share monthly plans with family members from My Family!
- Sharing is Caring! 
Send customized packs as Gifts to your loved ones or share your balance with them directly!
- Discover Something Brand-new! 
Weather, News, Games, Live Streaming, Travel Tickets, Online Shopping, Namaz Timing - all you need at your fingertips!
- Get Rewarded Everyday! 
Spin the Wheel once everyday to earn Elite points which you can redeem to buy Internet Packs!
- The More, The Merrier! 
Enjoy Internet Bonus on your first time registration and rewards for bringing your friends onboard!
Wait, There’s More! 
In case you aren’t impressed already, the app has some more features that deserve your attention -
- Recharge & Bills: Recharge your balance or pay bills using your favorite payment method!
- Internet Pack Management: Suspend and resume your active Internet Packs from the App!
- Rate Cutters: Reduce call rates by activating Rate Cutter Offers!
- GoonGoon: Choose your favorite song and set it as your caller tune right from the My Robi app!
- SIM Purchase: Buy a new SIM with a Phone Number of your choice delivered at your doorstep!
- Robi Elite: Check your Elite status and benefits and flaunt your Elite status with a personalized Loyalty Card
- Roaming: Activate International Roaming right from your phone
- Robi Sheba Locator: Locate your nearest Robi Sheba and R-Store Service Point!
- App Guide: Learn more about using the app from App Guide!
- Customer Service: Register Complaints, check Complaint Status and provide Feedbacks and Suggestions!
So, what are you waiting for? Download the My Robi App on your smartphone and gear up for a new experience in life! We await you with a welcoming gift on your first login. 
* Browsing the My Robi App is completely free of cost. However, standard data charges may apply for accessing other apps/portals from My Robi
** If you face any issues with the app, please let us know using the in-app Customer Service feature or the live chat in Robi website (www.robi.com.bd)

bluejetty:00129463:ios.name: Chairgun Elite Ballistic Tool+
bluejetty:00129463:ios.summary:
This is a smart ballistic calculator for long range shooters. It helps shooters calculate hold overs, and scope settings necessary for long range shots. Works with large caliber and airguns.
This app is using temperature, altitude, humidit
bluejetty:00129463:ios.description:
This is a smart ballistic calculator for long range shooters. It helps shooters calculate hold overs, and scope settings necessary for long range shots. Works with large caliber and airguns.
This app is using temperature, altitude, humidity, atmospheric pressure, distance to target, target speed and direction, coriolis effect, slope angle, cant and your rifle configuration for calculate optimal vertical, horizontal and lead corrections.
Features:
• Can use G1, G2, G5, G6, G7, G8, GA, GC, GI, GL, GS, RA4 and even custom drag-functions (built-in editor), and can calculate trajectory without using ballistic coefficient!
• You can select reticle from the list (around 2600 reticles! including reticles from Carl Zeiss, Nightforce Optics, Kahles, Vixen Sport Optics, Premier Reticles, Primary Arms, Schmidt and Bender, SWFA, U.S. Optics, and Vortex Optics) and see hold overs at any magnification (see list of reticles supported here http://jet-lab.org/chairgun-reticles)
• List of bullets: around 4000 cartridges database, more than 2000 bullets database, around 700 G7 ballistic coefficient bullets database, around 500 air rifle pellets database includes American Eagle, Barnes, Black Hills, Federal, Fiocchi, Hornady, Lapua, Norma, Nosler, Remington, Sellier & Bellot, and Winchester (see list of bullet/cartridges supported here http://jet-lab.org/chairgun-cartridges )!
• Correction for coriolis effect
• Takes into account temperature of powder (powder sensitivity factor)
• Correction for spin drift
• Correction for vertical deflection of crosswind
• Trajectory validation (truing) by speed or ballistic coefficient
• Correction for gyroscopic stability factor
• Can measure incline angle with phone camera
• Can get current weather (include wind speed and wind direction) from internet for current location and for any place in the world
• Supports Imperial (grain, in, yard) and Metric units (gram, mm, meter)
• Elevation: Mil-MRAD, MOA, SMOA, Clicks, Inch/Cm, Turret
• Get accurate local pressure using internal barometer in iPhone/iPad
• Adjusts for atmospheric conditions for current and zero conditions (Density Altitude or Altitude, Pressure, Temperature and Humidity)
• Density altitude support (determined automatically for any place in the world)
• Ballistics chart (Range, Elevation, Windage, Velocity, Time Of Flight, Energy)
• Ballistics graph (Elevation, Velocity, Energy)
• Reticle Drop Chart
• Range cards
• Select target type from big list of targets (80+ available)
• Target size presets
• Second focal plane scope support
• Moving target lead calculation
• Fast windspeed/direction adjustment
• Integrated with smart sensors. With the tap of a button you can calibrate density altitude, Coriolis, cant and slope in real-time
• Unlimited equipment profiles (create own rifles and bullets)
• Full history of all your shootings
• Scope turret calibration
• Rangefinder
• Ballistic coefficient calculator
• Support Kestrel DROP, Kestrel 5x00, WeatherFlow WEATHERmeter, Skywatch BL, Vectronix, Terrapin X bluetooth devices
• Air laboratory (Air Density, Density Altitude, Relative Air Density (RAD), Dew Point, Station Pressure, Saturation Vapor Pressure, Virtual Temperature, Actual Vapor Pressure, Cumulus Cloud Base Height, Dry Air, Dry Air Pressure)
• Light/dark/gray color themes
• Built-in tutorials
PRO Version available:
Subscription available for $1.49/month, $9.99/year and provides access to all features.
• Your subscription will renew automatically each period. You can turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
Terms of Use:
http://jet-lab.org/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy:
http://jet-lab.org/chairgun-privacy-policy

bluejetty:00077960:ios.description:
Welcome to **Match Blast**, a fun and relaxing block-matching puzzle adventure! Match two or more blocks of the same color to create satisfying blasts, powerful boosters, and exciting chain reactions. With easy-to-learn gameplay, colorful levels, and rewarding challenges, Match Blast offers endless puzzle fun for players of all ages.
Dive into a world filled with cute blocks, clever puzzles, and exciting events. Test your strategy and reflexes as you clear stages, unlock special blocks, and overcome unique obstacles. Every level brings a new challenge, making Match Blast easy to enjoy but hard to put down.
Whether you're looking for a quick break or a long puzzle session, Match Blast is the perfect way to relax and have fun anytime, anywhere.
**[Features]**
**- Cute and Colorful Blocks**
Match adorable blocks with vibrant designs and enjoy a cheerful puzzle experience.
**- Easy to Play, Fun to Master**
Simply match two or more blocks of the same color to clear them. The rules are simple, but mastering every challenge takes skill.
**- Create Powerful Blast Combos**
Match blocks strategically to generate special boosters and trigger exciting chain reactions that help clear difficult stages.
**- Hundreds of Challenging Levels**
Enjoy a wide variety of puzzles filled with unique layouts, obstacles, and rewarding objectives.
**- Exciting Events and Rewards**
Join special events, complete challenges, and collect valuable rewards every day.
**- Play Anytime, Anywhere**
No internet connection? No problem. Enjoy Match Blast online or offline whenever you want.
Start your puzzle adventure today and discover why players love the satisfying gameplay, colorful challenges, and endless fun of **Match Blast**!

Keto, paleo, vegetarian, and vegan diets all supported. 531, Strong Curves, PHAT, PHUL, Greyskull, Texas Method, Madcow, nSuns, GZCL Method, Strong Curves and bodyweight routines included.
If diet is 80% of achieving your fitness goals and exercise is 20%, then Strongr Fastr has you covered. It gives you a plan every day and week showing what you should eat and how you should workout to burn fat and build muscle. It's for people who want plans based on the core tenets of nutrition and training research rather than current fads and pseudo science. 
*Meal plans and training plans- because doing random things doesn't get you results*
MEAL PLANS
• Built around your calorie and macro needs (protein, fat, carbs)
• Swap out meals for others that also meet your macros
• Foods for fat loss and muscle building
• Personalized by your budget and how much variety/cooking you prefer
• Supports group meal planning
• Add your own recipes
• Hundreds of healthy, easy, realistic recipes
• Allergies: Lactose, peanuts, tree nuts, gluten, soy, eggs, and more!
• Diets: Standard, Paleo, Keto, Vegetarian and more!
FOOD LOGGING:
• Barcode scanning
• AI meal and food photo logging
• Voice and text logging
• Manual logging
TRAINING PLAN
• Effective bodyweight or weighted routines
• Meets your schedule, goals, and equipment needs
• Choose from some of the most successful programs out there
• Backed by strength and conditioning research
• Build muscle, lose fat
• Incorporates cardio
• Step-by-step guides
• Video instructions
• Automated progression keeps workouts challenging
GROCERY LIST
• Check off items as you shop
• Sorted by aisle
PROGRESS CHARTS:
• See your progress over time
• Weight loss/gain chart
• Lifting volume chart
• Progress charts for individual exercises
ADVANCED FEATURES:
• Edit workout routines, including the ability to add periodization with multiple training cycles, automatic progression of exercises, or autoregulated progression of exercises
• Input your own nutrition targets (calories, protein, carbohydrates, fiber)

bluejetty:00186476:ios.description:
Feed your child’s curiosity with MarcoPolo World School! We’ve reimagined how your child can explore the universe around them with our award-winning app. It’s trusted by parents and educators worldwide.
Serving up smart learning for kids aged 3-6, our research-led curriculum helps children develop the skills they need to prepare for school and beyond. Even better, they’ll have oodles of fun while doing it.
Designed by leading early childhood educators, our colorful, educational characters take your child on a mind-expanding journey through 500+ video lessons and 3,000+ activities.
Dive into the MarcoPolo world today with a 7-day free trial.
• 2019 International Emmy Award Nominee
• Winner of the 2019 Kidscreen Awards: Best Original Learning App
• Winner of the 2019 Rockies Award: Interactive Content - Children & Youth
• Winner of the Parents’ Choice Award 2018
• Rated A+ for educational value by Common Sense Media
CHILDREN LEARN ABOUT:
SCIENCE
Take a trip through the human body, learn about the world’s climate and weather conditions, explore natural habitats, discover different lifecycles and more!
TECHNOLOGY
Blast into space to learn about rockets, the International Space Station and the mysterious solar system. Back on Earth, learn how humans are creating technology inspired by nature.
ENGINEERING
Understand why hot air balloons need warm air to fly, visit the depths of the ocean in a submersible, and learn how humans use electricity to make cars go vrooooom!
ART
Unleash your creativity with crafty art tutorials, kaleidoscopic coloring exercises and more. Don’t forget to send us a photo of your gallery-worthy creations!
MATH
Get your math cogs whirring with number recognition, geometry, sequencing and addition. Then apply your new knowledge with the help of our educational characters, The Polos!
LITERACY
Spot letter sounds and formations, start reading fluently and recognize sight words. Plus, learn sentence composition, and practice handwriting with tricky tracing activities.
SOCIAL STUDIES
Discover different countries’ holidays and traditions, geography, music and arts. Explore fascinating resources from around the world – and ancient civilizations, too!
SOCIAL EMOTIONAL SKILLS
Build up your social skills by understanding empathy, jealousy and nervousness. And learn all about the complex world of feelings, friendships and human interactions.
FEATURES:
• Unlimited access to 500+ real-world video lessons and 3,000+ fun activities
• STEAM (science, technology, engineering, art, math)+ literacy curriculum designed by learning early childhood education educators.
• Tackle the four Cs: Critical Thinking, Creativity, Communication and Collaboration
• Engage their curiosity. Whenever your child "hearts" a video, you'll get a special "MarcoPolo Let's Talk™" email with questions and fun facts to help you explore that topic further
• You can trust us—we’re COPPA and GDPR certified, which means your date is secure and never shared. A proud recipient of the KidSAFE seal. 
• No advertisements. Ever. 
SUBSCRIPTION INFO
Subscribing includes a FREE 7 day trial. Your subscription will automatically renew unless you turn auto-renew off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off the auto-renewal function by accessing your Subscription Settings on your device. Any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription to MarcoPolo World School.
See our full Terms and Conditions at https://marcopoloworldschool.com/terms

bluejetty:00095704:ios.description:
CleanEasy is a mobile tool for record management and smart cleaning, featuring one-tap cleaning, deleting duplicates/similar files, clearing calendar events, and time capsule functions to record good memories—offering efficient phone management and cleaning. 
【One-Tap Release】Manage & clean, optimize phone storage 
Deeply detects redundant files; one-tap cleaning frees up space and boosts phone performance. 
【Smart Recognition】Identify duplicates/similars, keep the best 
Smartly identifies and auto-selects top-quality photos/videos; one-tap removal of redundancies saves storage efficiently. 
【Calendar Cleanup】Quickly clear invalid schedules 
Supports batch selection and one-tap clearing of invalid to-dos, enhancing calendar tidiness for more efficient schedule management. 
【File Management】Efficiently manage media files 
Covers album, calendar, and file management with efficient, user-friendly operations—helping users organize, manage, and recall fragmented memories effectively. 
【Beautiful Memories】Record life's memories 
Supports uploading videos, photos, and voice notes, leaving vivid traces of every time-space dialogue. Amid time's flow, hear the echo of your growth. 
【Chat Capsule】Cross-time spiritual dialogue 
Leave messages or questions for your future self, preset answers, set an unlock time to create a personalized time capsule. When the appointed time comes, open it to hold a self-dialogue with your past self.
***CleanEasy Membership Automatic Subscription Service Agreement***
1. Subscription Service: Continuous Monthly (1 month), Continuous Quarterly (3 months)
2. Subscription Price: The specific price is subject to the iAP application information. For example, the continuous monthly subscription is 6.99/month, and the continuous quarterly subscription is 49.99/quarter.
3. Payment: The price will be charged to the iTunes account after the user confirms the purchase and payment.
4. Renewal: If auto-renewal is not turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period, Apple will automatically debit your Apple ID account within 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. If successful, the membership will be automatically extended for one additional period.
5. Cancellation of Renewal: To cancel auto-renewal, you can follow these steps: Go to "Settings" on your iPhone, tap "Apple ID," select "Subscriptions," and then select "CleanEasy."
This auto-renewal service is valid from the date you activate it until you choose to cancel it.
6. Related Agreements
Service Agreement: http://esh.CleanEasyfing.com/privacy/CleanEasy/en/useragreement.html
Privacy Policy: http://esh.CleanEasyfing.com/privacy/CleanEasy/en/privacypolicy.html
Membership Agreement: http://esh.CleanEasyfing.com/privacy/CleanEasy/en/subscriptionagreement.html

bluejetty:00177274:ios.description:
The Memphis Groove On-Demand makes it easier than ever to move around the city of Memphis, TN — with a few taps, book a ride using the app and we’ll pair you with others headed your way. No detours, no delays.
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our tech matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
AFFORDABLE
Rides are priced comparable to public transport and there are additional discounts for passengers who qualify. Head to ‘https://downtownmemphis.com/groove-on-demand’ for more information.
How does Groove On-Demand work?
- Groove On-Demand is an on-demand travel concept that takes multiple passengers heading in the same direction and books them into a shared vehicle. Using the Groove On-Demand app, input your address and we’ll match you with a vehicle going your way. We’ll pick you up on a nearby corner and drop you off within a short walk of your chosen destination. Now for the clever bit; our algorithms provide journey times that are comparable to a taxi and much more convenient than other modes of travel, making public transportation easier than ever before! 
How long will I wait
- You'll always get an accurate estimate of your pick-up ETA before booking.
- You can also track your bus in real time using the app.
Questions? Head to https://downtownmemphis.com/groove-on-demand/or reach out at support-groove@ridewithvia.com.
Loving your experience so far? Give us a 5-star rating.

bluejetty:00026256:ios.summary: Intuitive and powerful, PWS Connect is the personal weather station app designed by weather aficionados for weather aficionados. It's the only PWS app that lets weather station owners automatically and continuously keep track of station con
bluejetty:00026256:ios.description:
Intuitive and powerful, PWS Connect is the personal weather station app designed by weather aficionados for weather aficionados. It's the only PWS app that lets weather station owners automatically and continuously keep track of station conditions and get notified of changing conditions based on individual preferences.
And if you don't have your own weather station, you can monitor any of the thousands of weather stations in the global network of NOAA/ICAO stations.
PWS Connect displays weather station data for up to the past 7 days this is continuously updated in the background. No more having to open an app to see what's happening with your station! The app displays trends for barometric pressure, temperature, wind, and humidity with beautiful, informative, and fully interactive graphs on your iPhone and Apple Watch. PWS Connect provides notifications and alerts for conditions such as high and low temperatures, pressure changes, and precipitation. PWS Connect supports iPhone widgets and all Watch complication styles to keep you up to date on weather conditions at a glance, and currently supports Weather Underground, Davis WeatherLink, Ambient Weather, Xweather, and NOAA/ICAO weather station networks.
This app even has a forecast feature that shows you the forecast from the NOAA/ICAO forecasting station closest to the station currently being monitored. These are the same forecasts that pilots across the world use to fly safely.
PWS Connect also has a powerful history features that takes daily snapshots of weather station data which the app stores securely in iCloud. In the History screen, you can swipe left and right to go backwards and forwards through time through a continuous graph of previously saved weather snapshots stretching back weeks, months, and years, and you can explore any day in detail. In short, you can make your past weather station data come alive!
The app's optional Premium Features subscription option also gives you full access to the app’s Watch functionality, widget, and notification features.
Privacy policy: https://www.bogbridges.com/pwsconnectprivacy
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

*Why Golfers Choose Gol
bluejetty:00180448:ios.description:
Get pinpoint GPS distances on 47,000+ golf courses worldwide, automatic shot tracking, scoring, handicap posting, and Strokes Gained analytics — whether you're a beginner or a scratch golfer chasing a course record.
*Why Golfers Choose Golfshot*
- Best golf app for Apple Watch — the original Apple Watch golf GPS since 2015. Play hands-free with distances, auto-advance, scoring, and shot tracking right on your wrist.
- Best shot tracking app in golf — Auto Shot Tracking (AST) uses Apple Watch machine learning to capture every shot automatically. No tags, no buttons, no extra devices..
- Best golf GPS app worldwide — 47,000+ courses across 169 countries with front/center/back-of-green distances, hazards, targets, and 3D flyovers.
- Best scoring and handicap tracking app — link your Handicap Index® and post World Handicap System scores hole-by-hole, directly from the app.
- Best golf app for every skill level — beginners get easy scoring. Intermediates get Strokes Gained and Swing ID. Scratch golfers get tour-level shot data w/ auto shot tracking and Round Reviews.
- Exclusive Golf Genius tournament integration — the only golf app that lets you play, score, and track Golf Genius tournament rounds with GPS & scoring.
*Golf GPS & Course Management Intelligence*
- Best-in-class GPS distances to greens, hazards, layups, and targets
- 3D hole previews and flyovers — visualize and plan every shot before you hit
- Auto-advance between holes plus voice hole information for hands-free play
*Automatic Shot Tracking & Strokes Gained*
- Auto Shot Tracking (AST) on Apple Watch — every shot captured automatically
- Auto Strokes Gained — see exactly where you gain or lose strokes Off the Tee, On Approach, Around the Green, and Putting
- Swing ID — automated swing analysis on every shot, so you learn your real club distances and dispersion
- Smart Caddy — personalized club recommendations based on your shot history
- 3D Flyover Round Review to view, edit, and share every shot
*Scoring, Handicap & Friends*
- Stroke Play, Stableford, Skins, Nassau, and Match Play scoring for you or your foursome
- Link your USGA Handicap Index® and post scores directly through Golfshot
- Share scores, swings, and tracked shots with friends
- Pace of Play tracking and Apple Health and Fitness integration
*Practice & Improvement*
- Swing ID On Range — distances to driving range targets without a rangefinder
- Save practice shots to see club dispersion and shot distribution over time
- Statistics dashboard built from your real round and practice history
*Tournament Play*
- Exclusive Golf Genius integration — play GPS-enabled tournament rounds in Golfshot
- Real-time scoring synced to your Golf Genius tournament leaderboard
- GolfNow tee time deals plus $20 off Hot Deal tee times for Pro members
*Free vs. Pro Membership - Try Pro out with a 7-day free trial*
Free includes: GPS distances, shot tracking, scoring, statistics, 3D hole previews, Handicap Index® linking, Apple Watch GPS, and GolfNow tee times.
Pro Membership unlocks: Front/center/back-of-green distances, hazard and target distances, Smart Caddy club recommendations, Auto Shot Tracking, Strokes Gained, Swing ID for Apple Watch, Club Recommendations, Apple Watch scoring, ad-free experience, and exclusive partner benefits.
Some features require a subscription. Golfshot offers weekly, monthly, and yearly membership options purchased in-app and renewed automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage subscriptions through your iTunes account. Starting a paid subscription while a free trial is active will end the trial and activate the membership immediately.
Golfshot GPS requires a GPS-enabled iPhone® or iPad®. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
View our privacy policy and terms of service at https://golfshot.com/privacy-policy and https://golfshot.com/terms-of-service

• Design your own custom setups with a step-by-step picker
• Quickly access rules, strategies, and tips for each card through shortcuts to the Dominion Strategy Wiki
• View all cards across the different expansions
• Explore recommended sets by selecting different expansions
• Block and replace cards that your play group dislikes
• Go back in your history and see recent kingdoms you've generated
• Optimized for both iPhone and iPad

HUMAIN Chat – Your native‑Arabic AI companion.
Meet the powerful conversational assistant built natively for the Arab world. HUMAIN Chat harnesses ALLAM 34B, a leading Arabic large language model that is rooted in our culture, our religion and our history. ALLAM 34B is designed and built in Saudi Arabia by Saudis, fully hosted and operated in Saudi.
Chat in Arabic or English, or speak naturally in Arabic and get culturally intelligent responses.
From trip planning to business letters to creative brainstorming, HUMAIN Chat thinks with you in your language, respects your values, and adapts to your communication style.
- BUILT FOR ARABIC SPEAKERS
Powered by the highest-ranked Arabic model and trained on massive, diverse Arabic datasets that include cultural and local content and the rich heritage of the Arabic language.
- REAL-TIME WEB SEARCH INTEGRATION
Toggle web search on to continue chatting while the AI conducts web searches before replying. Get the latest information and current events seamlessly integrated into your conversation.
- SPEAK NATURALLY WITH ARABIC VOICE INPUT
Advanced speech recognition for Arabic dialects from Gulf to Maghreb. Speak naturally in your dialect and get instant responses that understand your accent.
- A PERSONAL AI THAT REMEMBERS YOU
Remembers your conversation context, and preferences so every interaction feels effortless and familiar
- SWITCH BETWEEN ARABIC AND ENGLISH ANYTIME 
Type in Arabic or English within the same chat. Voice input works seamlessly across Arabic dialects for hands-free conversations.
- SHARE ANSWERS IN A TAP Send links to AI responses to share your conversations with your family and friends.
Experience AI that doesn't just speak your language, but understands your world.
