bluejetty:00099772:ios.description:
Christmas Mahjong is a cozy holiday tile-matching game where you find and match three identical tiles to clear the board. Easy to learn, satisfying to master, and perfect for quick breaks all season long.
How to Play:
+ Tap tiles with the same icon (bells, stockings, trees, candy canes, and more).
+ Collect 3 of a kind to make a match and remove them.
+ Clear every tile to beat the level.
+ Stuck? Use Hint, Shuffle, or Undo to turn the tide.
Features:
+ True triple-tile gameplay: simple rules, surprisingly deep strategy.
+ Holiday vibe with crisp festive art and warm, wintry ambience.
+ Varied layered layouts that ramp up the challenge as you progress.
+ Smart power-ups (Hint, Shuffle, Undo) when you need a little help.
+ Quick pick-up-and-play sessions for 1–3 minute breaks or longer runs.
Tips:
+ Remove tiles that unlock covered ones to open new moves.
+ Scan by icon groups (bells, gifts, trees) to set up clean triples.
+ Use Undo for mistaps and Shuffle when your tray is nearly full.
Enjoy a cheerful season of matches with Christmas Mahjong

Key Features: 
⁃ Set daily water drinking goals. 
⁃ Custom water drinking schedule. (Create unlimited reminders.) 
⁃ 12 free reminding sounds. 
⁃ Custom reminding test. 
⁃ Set default bottle or you can custom yourself. 
⁃ Shows drunk / goal water. 
⁃ Custom quantity of each bottle. 
⁃ Supports oz/ml/L. 
⁃ Badge to show drunk percentage or remaining percentage. 
⁃ Keeps daily water drinking logs. 
⁃ Shows quantity of each day by logs and histogram. 
⁃ Shows time and quantity of each drinking of a day. 
⁃ Send Logs by email. 
⁃ Supports Wifi Backup and Restore. 
⁃ Supports iCloud Backup and Restore.
⁃ Supports Dropbox backup and restore. 
⁃ Supports Apple Watch.
⁃ Supports Today Widget.
⁃ Adds 3D Touch function.
⁃ Supports universal version (available on both iPhone and iPad). 
Apple Health

If allowing WATER ALERT to write data, you could transfer the drunk water data to Health App easily.

bluejetty:00145625:ios.summary: Experience car rental on your terms. With Virtuo your phone is your key! Wave goodbye to car rental counter queues, paperwork and hidden fees - just unlock and drive. Choose from a selection of premium cars that are cleaned after every rent
bluejetty:00145625:ios.description:
Experience car rental on your terms. With Virtuo your phone is your key! Wave goodbye to car rental counter queues, paperwork and hidden fees - just unlock and drive. Choose from a selection of premium cars that are cleaned after every rental and available 24/7
1. BOOK 
Book the car you want to hire in just a few clicks on our app.
2. UNLOCK
Forget physical keys - unlock the car via the app and enjoy a seamless experience.
3. DRIVE
Press the start button and hit the road!
Our premium cars are available for rental in the major cities in the UK, France, Germany, Spain, Italy and Portugal. More cities and countries coming soon!
CAR HIRE DELIVERY TO YOUR DOOR
We’ve gone one step further with our car delivery option.
You can select, book and have a Mercedes delivered to your door. Our car rental delivery service is available in London zones 1-3 as well as in Paris, Lyon, Barcelona, Madrid, Berlin and Milan. Save time and stress by having your car delivered.
PREMIUM CARS
Book from a selection of premium cars. In the UK, you can rent a Mercedes A-Class or Mercedes GLA, from 1 to 90 days with a generous 150 miles per day included. In France, you can rent even more car models such as a BMW or Tesla. Trip to the sea? Adventure to the countryside? Whatever the occasion we have a car for you.
SIGN UP IN MINUTES 
You can sign up to Virtuo in just a few clicks. Upload your licence and a selfie and we will take care of the rest. With everything done in the app before hand there is no need to wait around in the airport or in car rental offices. You just show up, unlock the car and go - it really is that simple!
STATE OF THE ART TECHNOLOGY
Our next generation technology puts you in control of the whole process via our application. Book and unlock your car in just a few clicks. All cars come with Apple CarPlay, GPS, Bluetooth, rear view camera, cruise control and many more options that will make your trip one to remember. 
RELIABLE AND FLEXIBLE
Choose one of our three levels of protection and enjoy your trip with total peace of mind. With Virtuo you can rent a premium car 24/7. Modify or cancel your rental free of charge up to 3 hours before your rental start time (24 hours at an airport). 
THE BEST VALUE FOR MONEY
No more paperwork, no more queues and no more counters, our application really is hassle free. Book and rent a Mercedes from 1-90 days via the app at an unbeatable price. Perfect for a couple of days out of the city, a week away or a month long road trip. There really is no need to own a car!
ROAD TRIP SPECIALISTS
Whether you are going on holiday, running errands or escaping the city; we are your perfect partner to hit the road. Add up to 4 drivers free of charge and share the driving experience. If your plans change and you want to rent your Mercedes a little longer, just extend your duration or add extra mileage in the application. With Virtuo, anything is possible.
HOLIDAY EXPERTS 
Our Mercedes cars are perfect for a holiday. You can hop in a car in just a few clicks and be on your way. Our generous mileage package and the option to add more means that no destination is off limits. If you’re travelling with the family and need a baby seat then that's no issue; just add it on when confirming your booking. 
24/7 CUSTOMER SERVICE
Customer service is at the heart of what we do. We are proud to offer 24/7 assistance via our help centre where you can reach our team. Our customer service team are prepped and ready to help with any issues you may have. We’re in it together.
WE’D LOVE TO CONNECT WITH YOU 
Find out more at https://www.govirtuo.com/
Follow us on Twitter https://twitter.com/virtuoUK
Like us on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/VirtuoUK/ 
Have a question? Visit https://www.govirtuo.com/uk/faq

---
• 100% Ad-Free Experience

• Clean, Efficient, and Intuitive Interface

Ask questions directly to your transcript and get instant answers.

Automatically identify and label different speakers in meetings or interviews.
• Search & Seek:
Type a keyword and instantly jump to that exact point in the audio.
---
CORE TRANSCRIPTION & IMPORT
---
• Unlimited Live Transcription:
Real-time, low-latency transcription for any length.
• File Import:
Transcribe audio/video files from your phone or cloud services (Dropbox, etc.).
• Video/Link Transcription:
Extract audio and text from local video files or links (YouTube, TikTok, etc.).
---
LIVE TRANSLATION
---
• Translate live speech between 20+ languages. Perfect for global meetings and travel.
---
PRO AUDIO EDITOR
---
• Audio Editing:
Trim, split, and merge your audio files like a pro.
• Format Converter:

bluejetty:00015771:ios.description:
Symphony Pro 6 is a complete and intuitive app for writing music notation on iPad. It allows you to compose music for just about any size ensemble, from piano, symphonies, band, lead sheets, chord charts, guitar tabs, and more.
Starting Version 5, Symphony Pro now offers handwriting recognition as the only in-app purchase: Perfect with Apple Pencil, and works great with touch or capacitive stylus
GETTING STARTED 
SP provides all of the key options to begin your work. Import a score via MusicXML, MXL, MIDI, or SP file from your computer, or from apps like Dropbox, Mail, iCloud Drive, or Safari. You can base your project on a template, or start a blank score and add additional parts later. 
EDITING
To add notes, choose Pencil mode, and tap anywhere on a bar to begin editing right away. You can quickly specify note properties before or after placing notes. By switching to Select mode with one touch, you can also transpose, erase, cut, and paste multiple notes/tracks.
With an on-screen instrument, a QWERTY keyboard, or Core MIDI compatible keyboard, you can quickly enter notes & chords in step entry mode. Record a part in real-time with on-screen instruments to transcribe into notation.
Versions 4 & 5 take greater advantage of the iPad touchscreen. With shortcuts and contextual menus to edit note & bar properties, many of the commonly used editing commands are right at your fingertips.
SP supports a wide range of notational elements for your composition. Including dynamics & articulations, time & key signature changes, clef changes, pedals, and repeat conventions. Edit chord symbols, lyrics, and annotations using the iPad’s standard keyboard. 
EXPORT & SHARE
When you’re finished, print out your score with AirPrint, or export it as a PDF, MusicXML, AAC, MIDI, or Symphony file. Share files via email or directly to another computer or iPad via Dropbox/iCloud Drive.
KEY FEATURES
• Introducing Handwriting Recognition for Apple Pencil & touch
• Starting Version 5, Handwriting is the only In-App Purchase to enable the complete app
• Now download SP on your iPhone
• 24+ professionally recorded and sound-designed acoustic instruments, free out of the box 
Earlier features offered free, to existing & new owners
• 114 built-in instruments for playback, and auditioning the notes you entered
• Create in standard music notation or tablature
• Edit with an on-screen piano, QWERTY keyboard, or a MIDI input device
• Dozens of shortcuts & gestures to edit & navigate
• Reduce your score size, range, or combination of parts for viewing & editing*
• Print directly to AirPrint
• Up to 48 instruments, 100 staves, 4 voices/layers per score
• Record a part in real-time with clicks at the beat with optional emphasis
• Backup & sync your scores with iCloud*
• Import MusicXML, MIDI, MXL, or Symphony files
• Export as a PDF, MusicXML, MIDI, AAC, or Symphony file
• Large selection of articulations & dynamics
• Multi-measure rests, including automatic rests
• Grace notes
• Customizable noteheads & note colors
• Chord symbol, lyric, and annotation tools
• Edit the properties of multiple notes and rests simultaneously by multi-note select
• Copy/Paste function supports partial & multi-bar/staff select
• Unlimited undo/redo
• Customizable stem directions & note beaming
• Transposing & concert pitch score option
• Change tempo or clef anywhere in score or bar
• Stream audio or share your screen wirelessly with AirPlay
• Advanced document management
• Create your own custom project template or use a built-in one
• Customizable part groupings for SATB and instrument families
• Customizable chord symbol, lyric, and annotation font
• Loop playback feature
• Auto-save support
* Previously paid, but now free upgrade in Version 5
For More information, please visit:
• http://www.symphonypro.net
• http://forums.symphonypro.net
• Facebook page at www.facebook.com/symphonyapp
• Learn about the iPhone-only app: bit.ly/symphonyiphone

bluejetty:00088657:ios.description:
Klewos is a unique word search app with a focus on language learning with thousands of hand-picked words organized by categories and lessons!
It currently supports seven languages: English (US), French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Russian and Spanish (Spain).
You can find three modes for three moods.
"Learn" mode
• Small levels of 3 words.
• A review every once in a while to challenge yourself (The reviews can't be failed, no stress!).
• Ideal for short and relaxing sessions.
• Exclusive "Sentence" gameplay where you need to fill out missing words from proverbs, idioms, movie quotes, songs and so on.
"Play" mode
• Many categories (always more to come) with over a hundred words each.
• Configure the size of the grids (Tiny, Small, Medium, Large).
• Configure the density of the grids (Sparse, Balanced, Dense).
• Configure the gameplay (Classic, Translation, Hidden, Kanji).
• Decide on having a chill experience or an intense one.
"Create" mode
• Create your own lists of words with no limit.
• Play your own creations with all the usual configuration options seen in "Play" mode.
• Language support extended to 14! You can generate grids in the 7 base languages + Chinese (traditional and simplified), German, Greek, Hindi, Portuguese and Vietnamese.
You can also find these features:
• PRINT and SHARE any grid!
• iCloud support for your progress.
• Dark mode support.
• Change your source language in addition to your target language.
• Japanese support includes kanji, hiragana and katakana.
• iPads with a keyboard and a built-in trackpad support.
• Customizable daily reminders.
One great feature of Klewos is that it allows for passive and immersive learning: You can play word search puzzles even if you are tired or just want to relax. Your subconscious will do the rest.
If you choose to subscribe to an optional Premium plan, payment will be charged to your Apple account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the App Store after purchase. A lifetime option is available and requires you to first cancel your subscription.
Klewos Privacy Policy can be found at https://bookopedia.app/klewos/privacy/
Klewos Terms of Use can be found at https://bookopedia.app/klewos/terms/

• Build any home you can imagine, from a simple cottage to the grandest mansion or a unique shipping container home.

bluejetty:00131465:ios.description:
Discover a reliable, real-time and hyper-local forecast that will always warn you about upcoming severe weather. Weather Underground combines data from over 250,000+ personal weather stations and a proprietary forecast model to give you the most accurate and hyperlocal forecasts, at a microclimate level. Discover about current conditions, interactive Nexrad radar, get customizable severe weather alerts and much more. You’ll always be prepared for whatever the weather brings.
5 REASONS TO DOWNLOAD WEATHER UNDERGROUND
• Severe weather alerts: set weather alerts for your exact position, so you can always be prepared for an upcoming storm!
• Local conditions: get current weather conditions from local weather stations and hourly/daily summary forecasts up to 10 days in the future, which include chance of precipitation and daily weather summaries.
• Most detailed weather data: stay updated with the best weather data including temperature, “Feels Like,” wind speed, wind directions, today’s rain accumulation, humidity, dew point, visibility, and pressure.
• Other geographical data: discover our air quality index, UV index, local flu outbreaks, sunrise & sunset and moonrise & moonset.
• Customized experience: set your app with light & dark modes, various map types and units.
DISCOVER THE UNIQUE FEATURES OF WEATHER UNDERGROUND
• Interactive radar maps & severe weather:
• The most interactive weather map on mobile allows you to select from different weather overlays, personal weather stations, nexrad radar, satellite, heat maps, and rain accumulation.
• Sophisticated weather visualizations with hi-res satellite & cloud cover imagery from GOES-16, powered by data from NOAA.
• Keep an eye out for extreme weather and always be prepared with severe weather alerts.
Accurate hyper-local forecasts:
• Over 250,000 personal weather stations report the most accurate local weather conditions.
• Made to fill in the gaps between the airport weather stations that other weather services rely upon to generate forecasts - meaning our data is generated from actual data points in your neighborhood.
Subscribe to Premium!
• Upgrade and remove all ads from your weather app by purchasing an annual subscription.
• Access Smart Forecasts: set your ideal weather conditions for your outdoor activities and we’ll tell you when to go.
• View Extended Hourly Forecasts up to 15 days in the future.
You can cancel your Weather Underground subscription anytime through your iTunes account settings, or it will automatically renew. This must be done 24 hours before the end of any subscription period to avoid being charged another fee. Subscription payments will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of your purchase and upon commencement of each renewal term. VANTAGENS:
É GRÁTIS! Você não tem nenhum custo adicional para pedir o gás pelo aplicativo.
É RÁPIDO! Seu gás de cozinha é entregue em poucos minutos no endereço da sua escolha.

1 – Cadastre suas informações e endereço de entrega.
2 – Selecione a quantidade de botijões, veja o valor¹ do gás, escolha a forma de pagamento² e clique em Pedir.

4 – Pronto! Seu gás já está a caminho. Você pode visualizar seu pedido e acompanhar o tempo estimado da sua entrega.
5 – Após receber seu botijão, avalie sua experiência de compra pelo app.
DÚVIDAS? Entre em contato pelo SAC 0800 704 3433
¹ O preço do botijão pode variar de acordo com a região.
² Verifique as formas de pagamento aceitas pela revenda mais próxima.

Consultei outros apps de entregador e todos eles estavam apenas com a parte O que há de novo ou nem isso. Eles não trabalham texto de descrição.

bluejetty:00027260:ios.description:
GIVE THOSE RANGE BALLS A PURPOSE!
Your practice partner that won't laugh at your shanks (that's what friends are for)!
Ever find yourself at the range, mindlessly burning through a bucket of balls while scrolling through midnight YouTube golf tips? Yeah, we've been there. CORE Golf is the practice companion for golfers ready to graduate from the "hit and hope" method.
What makes CORE different?
- Structured practice plans that make more sense than your current strategy of "hit until frustrated"
- Easy-to-follow performance drills that actually have a purpose
- Progress tracking that's more reliable than your buddy's "yeah, that looked better"
- Practice schedules that fit your real life (because we know you're sneaking out to the range during lunch)
Perfect for:
- 10-20 handicappers who know just enough to be dangerous
- Golfers who want to stop treating the range like a buffet (all you can "hit" while you're there)
- Players whose bag has more alignment sticks than actual clubs
- Anyone who's ever blamed their clubs, the wind, or the ball for their misses
Not another golf app promising miraculous results – CORE helps you structure your practice time so you can stop randomly flailing at balls and start making actual progress. Because throwing your club in the lake isn't a practice plan.
Download now and transform from "random ball whacker" to "purposeful practice person" (we're still working on the name).

==EUCHRE.COM GAME FEATURES==
ONLINE ЕUCHRE
Invite friends and family, and play euchre online with your own rules in the “Play with friends” room! Create a custom game, choose the entry, prize, card deck (24 or 32) and many other options that will make the game more exciting!

LEADERBOARDS

GLOBAL CHAT 
Are you ready to exchange some free euchre tips or need small talk? Create chat threads, or comment & like others players' topics!
EUCHRE TOURNAMENTS
Do you like playing in Euchre tournaments? Compete against others in the euchre knockout challenge. Win 3 consecutive games, and get three times your stake. 
LIVE, IN-GAME CONVERSATION
Euchre free game with a real-time, in-game chat! Have a chit-chat with your buddies in a custom game! 
DAILY BONUSES 
Enter Euchre.com and collect free tokens by
- Collecting a daily bonus,
- Spinning the Wheel,
- Watching rewarded videos,
- Inviting a friend via Facebook to play on Euchre.com,
- Adding a login method.
VIP STATUS
Become a VIP member of the community and get access to benefits such as:
- Moderating your chat threads,
- “Like” chat threads,
- Deleting messages and removing players from your chat topics, 
- Access to other players' media galleries, 
- 15% more tokens on purchases,
- Access to exclusive content and promotions
ONE ACCOUNT
Enter at your convenience through a smartphone, tablet or browser.
DAILY CHALLENGES
We have more prizes prepared! Complete 2 euchre online challenges in 24 hours and collect a reward!
TAILOR YOUR PROFILE
Add an avatar, present yourself through a short bio, choose a frame, and change the table background where you're playing at.
The names under which the game is known are Euker, Eucre, Yuker, Eucha, Uker, etc. can be heard in different regions of the world.
=== THE RULES OF EUCHRE ===
Euchre is a trick-taking card game played by two fixed teams two. The game is played with a 24, ranked J (of trump suit), J (same color as trump suit), A, K, Q, 10, and 9 or 32 card deck (including 7 and 8s), where the Joker (Benny) can be additionally added. The cards are distributed as follows: each player receives 5 cards, and the remaining 4 cards form the kitty. The game begins when the top card of the kitty is turned up and the bidding begins. Each player can choose whether he like the suit of the top card to be trump by responding “pick it up” or “pass”. If the dealer picks up the card, the dealer then discards the card to the kitty, face down.
When a trump suit is selected, the J in the suit of the same colour becomes a member of this trump suit. Any card of the trump suit outranks any card of a non-trump suit. By naming a suit, each team intends to win the majority of the tricks. If a bid succeeds the team scores one point. If a team wins all five tricks, he makes a “march”. Failure to win three tricks is referred to as being “euchered”.
Euchre.com is the classic, free Eucher game, but for a better experience, we offer in-app, paid options.
Contact us at: support@euchre.com

==EUCHRE.COM GAME FEATURES==


ONLINE ЕUCHRE

DAILY BONUSES

VIP STATUS

Become a VIP member of the community and get access to benefits such as:

- Moderating your chat threads,

- 15% more tokens on purchases,
- Access to exclusive content and promotions

ONE ACCOUNT

DAILY CHALLENGES
We have more prizes prepared! Complete 2 euchre online challenges in 24 hours and collect a reward!

TAILOR YOUR PROFILE
Add an avatar, present yourself through a short bio, choose a frame, and change the table background where you're playing at.


The names under which the game is known are Euker, Eucre, Yuker, Eucha, Uker, etc. can be heard in different regions of the world.

=== THE RULES OF EUCHRE ===

Euchre is a trick-taking card game played by two fixed teams two. The game is played with a 24, ranked J (of trump suit), J (same color as trump suit), A, K, Q, 10, and 9 or 32 card deck (including 7 and 8s), where the Joker (Benny) can be additionally added. The cards are distributed as follows: each player receives 5 cards, and the remaining 4 cards form the kitty. The game begins when the top card of the kitty is turned up and the bidding begins. Each player can choose whether he like the suit of the top card to be trump by responding “pick it up” or “pass”. If the dealer picks up the card, the dealer then discards the card to the kitty, face down.

When a trump suit is selected, the J in the suit of the same colour becomes a member of this trump suit. Any card of the trump suit outranks any card of a non-trump suit. By naming a suit, each team intends to win the majority of the tricks. If a bid succeeds the team scores one point. If a team wins all five tricks, he makes a “march”. Failure to win three tricks is referred to as being “euchered”.

bluejetty:00091961:ios.description:
Hello, travelers. This is your totally indispensable tool for traversing the Meow Wolf multiverse from the palm of your hand. The Meow Wolf app invites you to explore the nature of reality and promises to be an illuminating companion for your interdimensional journeys.
Key Features:
- !New! Introducing Meow Wolf Comics, a series of webcomics based on the stories behind our exhibitions! Just tap the Comics icon to read.
- Expand your Meow Wolf exhibition experience with the Psychic Sensor which unveils hidden elements of story, characters, and artistry. (Available at Meow Wolf Santa Fe, Grapevine, Houston, and Denver.)
- Discover Brain Beans hidden throughout the exhibition and use the Messages applet to collect them in your Head Garden. (Currently available at Meow Wolf Grapevine and Houston.)
- Easily purchase, access, and manage tickets for any Meow Wolf exhibition or events. 
- Enjoy games from Meow Wolf artists and collaborators.
- Delve into the stories behind the making of our unique exhibitions.
- View exclusive, short-form videos and lore.
- Browse and buy some magnificently maximal Meow Wolf merch.
About Meow Wolf:
Meow Wolf started in 2008 as a small collective of Santa Fe artists sharing an interest in publicly displaying their works and developing their skills together. This collaborative approach blossomed into Meow Wolf's distinctive style of immersive, maximalist environments that encourage audience-driven experiences. We have numerous full-time artists on staff, working in a huge range of media, including sculpture, painting, fabrication, digital art, writing, film and more. Additionally, we prioritize collaboration with local artists in each exhibition location. The Meow Wolf app is our latest creation… or discovery, depending on your perspective.

bluejetty:00152180:ios.description:
Meridian: Invest is a self-custody wallet with an AI investing agent built in. Tell it what you want to do with your money: buy crypto, set up recurring investments, check your portfolio. It handles the rest. No fees. No middlemen. Your keys, your assets.
JUST TELL MERIDIAN WHAT YOU WANT
Most investing apps make you dig through menus, toggle settings, and hunt for the right screen. Meridian works differently. Your Meridian agent understands plain language:
- "Buy $100 of Bitcoin every Friday"
- "Put $500 into a mix of the three largest crypto assets"
- "How is my portfolio doing this month?"
- "What should I know about the market right now?"
No forms. No ticker lookups. Just say it.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Buy and sell BTC, ETH, SOL, and hundreds of tokens on the Solana network
- Access tokenized assets — including onchain representations of stocks and ETFs — available to trade around the clock
- Set up dollar-cost averaging with a single message
- Get personalized portfolio insights that go beyond basic charts
- Route every trade through best-price decentralized exchange aggregators automatically
ZERO MERIDIAN FEES
Meridian charges nothing to trade. Your trades are routed through decentralized exchange aggregators on Solana to find the best available price. As with any decentralized exchange, market-based spreads apply and vary with liquidity conditions.
SELF-CUSTODY. FULL STOP.
Your wallet. Your private keys. Your assets. Meridian never holds your funds and never has access to your private keys. This is not an exchange. This is not a brokerage. You are in complete control.
BUILT FOR THE LONG TERM
Meridian: Invest is designed for people who want to build wealth steadily — not chase hype or day-trade. Set your strategy, check in when you want, and let your Meridian agent keep you informed.
WHY SOLANA
Transactions confirm in under a second. Network fees are fractions of a penny. Markets never close. Solana is the infrastructure — Meridian is the interface that makes it effortless.
 ---
Meridian: Invest is a self-custody wallet interface built on the Solana network. Meridian is not a broker-dealer, investment adviser, exchange, or money transmitter. Not a member of SIPC or FINRA. Digital assets are volatile and carry risk of loss. Tokenized assets providing onchain exposure to equities or ETFs are issued by third parties, not by Meridian, and may not carry the same rights as directly holding the underlying security. Nothing in this app constitutes investment advice. Past performance is not indicative of future results.

bluejetty:00040009:ios.description:
MÔ PHỎNG GIAO THÔNG 2026
Mô Phỏng Giao Thông (MPGT) là ứng dụng tham khảo, hỗ trợ cho việc Ôn tập và kiểm tra tốt nghiệp Nội dung Mô phỏng các tình huống giao thông áp dụng cho tất cả các hạng GPLX ô tô B, C1, C, D1, D2, D, BE, C1E, CE, D1E, D2E, DE.
Trong giai đoạn chuyển giao, MPGT hỗ trợ đồng thời 02 hình thức thi tốt nghiệp mô phỏng, bao gồm: 
(1) Hình thức cũ: Nhấn SPACE tính điểm 5-4-3-2-1
(2) Hình thức mới: Thi trắc nghiệm mỗi tình huống gồm 4 câu hỏi.
Các tính năng chính của ứng dụng: 
1. Tính năng ôn tập
- Ôn tập 6 chương, 120 tình huống, bao gồm: 
Chương 1: Giao thông trên đường đô thị (29 câu)
Chương 2: Giao thông trên đường nông thôn (14 câu)
Chương 3: Giao thông trên đường cao tốc (20 câu)
Chương 4: Giao thông trên đường núi (10 câu)
Chương 5: Giao thông trên đường quốc lộ (17 câu)
Chương 6: Các tình huống tai nạn giao thông (30 câu)
+ Cho phép lựa chọn 2 chế độ màn hình: dọc và ngang
+ ĐẶC BIỆT ứng dụng có gợi ý phân tích bằng hình ảnh trực quan, dễ nhớ.
2. Tính năng thi thử:
- Gồm 29 đề thi mẫu điển hình được lựa chọn để phân bố đều 120 tình huống.
- Tạo đề thi ngẫu nhiên theo cấu trúc chuẩn: 
+ Cấu trúc mỗi đề thi bao gồm 10 câu được lấy ngẫu nhiên từ 6 chương, theo phân bố tiêu chuẩn.
+ Mỗi bài thi gồm có 10 tình huống, không có tên tình huống hoặc gợi ý.
+ Hình thức nhấn SPACE: Mỗi tình huống hệ thống ghi nhận 1 lần nhấn SPACE duy nhất (là lần nhấn SPACE đầu tiên trong tình huống). Điểm tối đa cho mỗi tình huống là 5 điểm, tối thiểu 0 điểm.
Điểm ĐẠT tối thiểu của bài thi là 35/50 điểm (Áp dụng chung cho tất cả các hạng GPLX B, C1, C, D1, D2, D, BE, C1E, CE, D1E, D2E, DE)
Kết thúc bài thi, chương trình mới hiển thị số điểm và kết quả ĐẠT/TRƯỢT.
+ Hình thức trắc nghiệm mới: mỗi tình huống gồm 4 câu hỏi (Tên tình huống, dấu hiệu nhận biết gián tiếp, dấu hiệu nhận biết trực tiếp, cách xử lý)
Trả lời đúng mỗi câu được tính 0.25 điểm. Điểm tối đa của bài thi là 10 điểm.

listings.description:
MÔ PHỎNG GIAO THÔNG 2026
Mô Phỏng Giao Thông (MPGT) là ứng dụng tham khảo, hỗ trợ cho việc Ôn tập và kiểm tra tốt nghiệp Nội dung Mô phỏng các tình huống giao thông áp dụng cho tất cả các hạng GPLX ô tô B, C1, C, D1, D2, D, BE, C1E, CE, D1E, D2E, DE.

Trong giai đoạn chuyển giao, MPGT hỗ trợ đồng thời 02 hình thức thi tốt nghiệp mô phỏng, bao gồm: 
(1) Hình thức cũ: Nhấn SPACE tính điểm 5-4-3-2-1
(2) Hình thức mới: Thi trắc nghiệm mỗi tình huống gồm 4 câu hỏi.

Các tính năng chính của ứng dụng: 

1. Tính năng ôn tập
- Ôn tập 6 chương, 120 tình huống, bao gồm: 
Chương 1: Giao thông trên đường đô thị (29 câu)
Chương 2: Giao thông trên đường nông thôn (14 câu)
Chương 3: Giao thông trên đường cao tốc (20 câu)
Chương 4: Giao thông trên đường núi (10 câu)
Chương 5: Giao thông trên đường quốc lộ (17 câu)
Chương 6: Các tình huống tai nạn giao thông (30 câu)
+ Cho phép lựa chọn 2 chế độ màn hình: dọc và ngang
+ ĐẶC BIỆT ứng dụng có gợi ý phân tích bằng hình ảnh trực quan, dễ nhớ.

2. Tính năng thi thử:
- Gồm 29 đề thi mẫu điển hình được lựa chọn để phân bố đều 120 tình huống.
- Tạo đề thi ngẫu nhiên theo cấu trúc chuẩn: 
+ Cấu trúc mỗi đề thi bao gồm 10 câu được lấy ngẫu nhiên từ 6 chương, theo phân bố tiêu chuẩn.
+ Mỗi bài thi gồm có 10 tình huống, không có tên tình huống hoặc gợi ý.
+ Hình thức nhấn SPACE: Mỗi tình huống hệ thống ghi nhận 1 lần nhấn SPACE duy nhất (là lần nhấn SPACE đầu tiên trong tình huống). Điểm tối đa cho mỗi tình huống là 5 điểm, tối thiểu 0 điểm.
Điểm ĐẠT tối thiểu của bài thi là 35/50 điểm (Áp dụng chung cho tất cả các hạng GPLX B, C1, C, D1, D2, D, BE, C1E, CE, D1E, D2E, DE)
Kết thúc bài thi, chương trình mới hiển thị số điểm và kết quả ĐẠT/TRƯỢT.
+ Hình thức trắc nghiệm mới: mỗi tình huống gồm 4 câu hỏi (Tên tình huống, dấu hiệu nhận biết gián tiếp, dấu hiệu nhận biết trực tiếp, cách xử lý)
Trả lời đúng mỗi câu được tính 0.25 điểm. Điểm tối đa của bài thi là 10 điểm.

3. Tính năng cho phép người dùng đánh dấu các câu lưu ý để học lại

4. Tính năng thống kê lại kết quả học và thi của người dùng

5. Nhiều tiện ích khác để hỗ trợ người dùng trong quá trình học và thi thử như: cho phép download 120 tình huống độ phân giải cao để học offline, không cần mạng; lựa chọn số giây đếm ngược (countdown) trước tình huống để tiết kiệm thời gian...

MÔ PHỎNG GIAO THÔNG cập nhật năm 2026 có gì khác biệt: 
- Đáp án chính xác và đồng bộ với các thông tư quy định về đào tạo GPLX do Cục Đường Bộ Việt Nam (Bộ Xây dựng) ban hành.
- Sử dụng video chất lượng cao được trích xuất từ video gốc.
- Gợi ý trực quan bằng hình ảnh dễ học.
- MPGT luôn ưu tiên play video chất lượng cao để cung cấp trải nghiệm tốt nhất cho người dùng, chúng tôi cũng kết hợp play video từ network và cache video để tiết kiệm dung lượng data cho người dùng

bluejetty:00166013:ios.summary:

Inmate Photos® makes it simple to stay connected with someone in jail or prison. Whether your loved one is in a federal, state, county, or
bluejetty:00166013:ios.description:
Send photos, letters, cards, calendars, and more — quick, easy, and with a positive lasting impact.
Inmate Photos® makes it simple to stay connected with someone in jail or prison. Whether your loved one is in a federal, state, county, or city facility, we help you send real, physical mail — without the stress of you having to figure out what is and isn't allowed. We serve over 4,000 correctional facilities across the United States and specialize in handling complex prison mail rules, ensuring your package is delivered to your incarcerated loved one.
You can send full-color photo prints, personalized letters, greeting cards, photobooks, calendars, postcards, Sudoku puzzles, crossword puzzles, how-to-draw tutorials, and even inmate-focused books like jailhouse cookbooks. We already offer great pricing, but our bundle deals and subscriptions make it even more affordable — so your loved one never feels forgotten.
Most people don’t know the rules of the facility they’re mailing to — that’s where we come in. Inmate Photos® automatically shows jail-specific rules at the time of upload, including photo restrictions and content guidelines. If a facility has a photo limit, we’ll automatically space out your order to stay compliant. You don’t need to figure anything out — we guide you through it every step of the way.
Unlike some other apps, we specialize in accuracy and compliance. While Pelipost, FreePrints, GTL Getting Out, Access Corrections, Securus Technologies, JPay, Corrlinks, Text Behind app, Pigeonly, and ICSolutions may offer inmate-related services, Inmate Photos® stands out by doing the hard part for you — helping your mail meet jail requirements from the start.
Your support matters! Staying connected helps reduce recidivism and creates a lasting, positive impact on the lives of incarcerated men and women. Every photo or letter is a reminder that they’re not forgotten. At Inmate Photos®, we’re proud to help you deliver hope and connection when it’s needed most.

Brisamusic is an ad-free application and with it you have access to more than 120 million tracks, dozens of radio stations, videos, albums and personalized programming according to your musical taste. The application recommends songs based on what you like, to compose the soundtrack of your life in an exclusive way.

Brisamusic is the new music streaming platform from Brisanet Telecomunicações, which provides an updated selection every day to its users, with thousands of options directly on your device, to listen to anywhere. This is a perfect app for playing what you already like and also for introducing you to new music and current artists.

By downloading Brisamusic, you will be able to enjoy musical experiences with a complete library, tracks from artists from all over the world and the most diverse musical rhythms, without having to download the media to your device. Listen online and offline: forró, country music, funk, pop, MPB and much more, and you can create as many playlists as you want, to listen to at all times.

Features:
🎵 More than 120 million songs for you to play!
🎶 5,000+ personalized playlists for every moment.
🚫 No interruptions: listen to your favorite music without ads.
📥 Offline mode: save your music and listen wherever and whenever you want.
🌍 Total connection with your region: discover and enjoy the music that is typical of your location.
🎙️The most played artists in Brazil: the music the country loves, at your fingertips.
❤️ Playlists and artists you love: Brisamusic connects you to the biggest hits, incredible playlists and albums of the moment.
🎯 Discover My Match: create playlists in an easy and fun way, choosing the songs that suit you!
🤖 Explore the power of MIX: let Brisamusic's Artificial Intelligence create incredible playlists with your favorite artists.
📚 Beyond music: listen to your favorite podcasts and explore thousands of options to have fun, learn and connect.
📻 Online radios: discover dozens of stations to listen to live, directly in the app.
📺 Integration with your TV: enjoy Brisamusic also on Android TV and Smart TVs.
✨ Complete streaming: regional, national and international artists in one place, without needing to download.

bluejetty:00085641:ios.description:
Discover hundreds of prayer communities around various spiritual themes on the Hozana app. Let us help you grow your prayer life every day of the year!
The communities are managed by Christian organisations (religious communities and movements, associations, media, etc.), priests and clergy members, or even laypeople: you, too, can create your own prayer community!
Prayer can transform our hearts and change the world around us. We receive hundreds of testimonies from our members who share with us the incredible graces that the Lord has granted them by joining their brother’s and sister’s online prayers! 
So, you, too, can share your faith, pray for one another, and become a true disciple of Christ by joining Hozana today!
« Rejoice always, pray constantly. » 1Th 5:16-17
THE HOZANA SOCIAL NETWORK OF PRAYER IN NUMBERS
• Over 1 000 000 members online.
• Over 25 000 000 prayers.
• Over 1 000 prayer communities.
• available in 4 languages.
CHOOSE FROM HUNDREDS OF PRAYER COMMUNITIES!
• Join a spiritual community of your liking: novenas, retreats, daily Gospel, daily reading, Verse of the day, teachings, and more!
• Receive content published by the communities you subscribed to every day in your prayer space. Choose the days that fit your schedule to create a personal prayer plan.
• You can experience the richness and diversity of Church tradition thanks to the presence of our numerous partners, including 10 minutes with Jesus, the Augustinians, a Miracle Every Day, the Franciscan Friars of the Renewal, the Centre for Applied Carmelite Spirituality, the Dominicans, Rosary on the Coast, the Diocese of Canberra and Goulburn and many others!
CREATE YOUR OWN CHRISTIAN COMMUNITY!
• Invite your friends and family to join a private prayer community - to celebrate a joyful event (marriage, baptism, etc.), or unite in prayer in difficult times ( illness of a family member, job or house search, difficulties at work, etc.)
• Publicly share an online retreat and become a missionary of Christ!
• Chat with members of your community.
POST YOUR PRAYER INTENTIONS ONLINE
• Share your prayer requests with millions of other praying members.
• Post a prayer intention for a loved one in need.
• Ask other members to join you in praising Lord for his grace.
• Pray for others and offer them your spiritual support.
• Experience the power of the communion of saints.
MEDITATE THE SCRIPTURE AND THE VERSE OF THE DAY WITH THE HOZANA APP
• Receive daily Gospel with a commentary of the greatest spiritual leaders.
• Learn how to meditate on the Bible with communities about Lectio Divina.
• Get closer to God through the light of his Holy Scripture.
• Reflect on different verses in your heart.
FOLLOW A HOLY MASS LIVE, ONLINE LIVESTREAM
• Thanks to our partners, you can now join your daily Mass live stream through Hozana App.
• Discover new communities and great parishes through this experience.
DISCOVER THE RICHNESS OF NOVENAS AND CATHOLIC RETREATS OFFERED BY HOZANA
• Join hundreds of retreats with saints: Virgin Mary, Saint Joseph, Saint Rita, Saint Jude, Saint Micheal, and many others!
• Learn how to pray the Holy Rosary
• Extensive content for all the highlights of the liturgical year: Lent, Advent, Holy Week, etc.
SHARE AND EXCHANGE WITH YOUR BROTHERS AND SISTERS IN CHRIST ON THE HOZANA APP
• In addition to confiding your prayer intentions directly online, you can also share and exchange directly with other members!
You can download the Hozana app today for free!

bluejetty:00165186:ios.description:
Playing as a webman Hero in Mr Spider Hero Shooting Puzzle, you are armed with your trusty spiderweb shooting abilities, allowing you to shoot webs and teleport to any location you have marked with a web. Use your spiderweb shooting skills in a strategic way to navigate your way through the map, avoiding obstacles, dodging enemies' attacks, and destroying various foes and bosses.
Mr Spider Hero Shooting Puzzle is a game that will challenge your reflexes, creativity, and logic. Use your webs strategically to solve puzzles and reach new areas. Be careful because Mr Spider will face hundreds of levels with different puzzles and enemies. The enemies in this world are not to be trifled with. They will attack you with everything they have, so you'll need to use your spiderweb shooting skills to dodge enemies' strikes and defeat them before they harm you. Mr Spider needs to be quick on his feet and strategic in his movements if you hope to make it to the end of each level.
You can unlock new abilities as well as customize your Mr spider hero with different skins as you progress through the spider hero game, giving you more options and fun.
Mr Spider Hero highlight features:
- Stunning minicraft pixel graphics, smooth animations, and catchy music
- Fast-paced action with addictive puzzle gameplay
- Dozens of spider hero's skins to unlock
- Challenging levels filled with tons of obstacles and enemies 
Can you master your web-shooting skills and become the ultimate web master hero? Only time will tell! Download Mr Spider Hero Shooting Puzzle now and experience the thrill of being a web shooting hero!

Welcome to Sandbox City!
Run and drive freely through a lively city full of pedestrians, zombies, and traffic in first or third person.
Punch zombies or run them over to save the people of Sandbox City.
Equip yourself to survive with weapons such as the MP-40, grenades, baseball bats, and more.
Jump into different AI vehicles, including taxis, police cars, ambulances, vans, and more.
Earn money by taking down enemies in melee, from range, or behind the wheel. Spend it in the Shop to unlock better gear.
Tune the game for your device and preferences. Graphics quality, shadows, view distance, anti-aliasing, and post effects can be changed at any time.
Prevent the zombie apocalypse!
Defend the city at all costs!
And join the community on Discord from the main menu.

bluejetty:00030862:ios.name: Pool Blitz
bluejetty:00030862:ios.summary:
Pool Blitz: Online Multiplayer 8 Ball Pool Games
Challenge friends, compete in real-time tournaments, and prove your skills in Pool Blitz – the ultimate pool experience! With ultra-realistic physics, stunning 3D graphics, and thrilling gam
bluejetty:00030862:ios.description:
Pool Blitz: Online Multiplayer 8 Ball Pool Games
Challenge friends, compete in real-time tournaments, and prove your skills in Pool Blitz – the ultimate pool experience! With ultra-realistic physics, stunning 3D graphics, and thrilling game modes like 8-Ball, 9-Ball, and the fast-paced Blitz Mode, Pool Blitz redefines the pool game experience. Plus, enjoy seamless play across devices with Cross-Play and connect with players worldwide!
KEY FEATURES
 • Breathtaking 3D graphics with immersive real-time gameplay and 2D top down option, play it your way.
 • Unique portrait mode for one-handed pool action
 • 8-Ball, 9-Ball, and Blitz Mode for thrilling multiplayer fun
 • Play with one account using Cross-Play between mobile and console
 • Challenge friends in 1v1 matches or Epic Tournaments
 • Customize and upgrade your cues, balls, and avatar masks
 • In-game chat: Banter with opponents using fun emojis!
GAME MODES FOR EVERY POOL FAN
8-Ball Pool
Play the most authentic 8-ball pool in 1v1 matches or enter tournaments to dominate the leaderboards. Master your shots, outplay your opponents, and climb to the top.
9-Ball Pool
Test your precision and strategy in this fast-paced mode. Pot the balls in numerical order and defeat your opponents with skilful shots. Whether you're a seasoned pro or a beginner, 9-Ball offers a unique challenge for everyone.
Blitz Mode
A high-octane multiplayer pool game! Every ball you pot is sent to your opponent’s table—and theirs to yours! With power-ups like Power Balls in play, your speed and strategy will be pushed to the limit.
PLAY WITH FRIENDS & CROSS-PLAY
Invite up to 7 friends to compete in Pool Blitz Tournaments. Spectate live matches, cheer (or heckle!) your friends, and prove who’s the best! Thanks to Cross-Play, you can challenge friends across devices, whether they're on mobile or console.
REALISTIC POOL PHYSICS & SHOTS
Our advanced physics engine delivers ultra-realistic ball movement, allowing you to pull off skill shots and trick shots like a pro. Whether you’re playing 8-Ball, 9-Ball, or Blitz Mode, you’ll feel the authenticity in every shot.
TOURNAMENTS & QUICKFIRE MODES
Jump into Quickfire Tournaments for fast, real-time competition. Watch live matches, or dive in to compete instantly! Rack up wins and rewards to unlock new cues, balls, and exclusive gear.
WHY POOL BLITZ?
 • Easy-to-use shot system: Enjoy the precision of 3D pool with simple 2D controls.
 • Collect & upgrade: Unlock a variety of cues and special skills to perfect your shots.
 • Banter & chat: Use fun emojis to communicate with opponents after each match.
 • Cross-Play: Seamless multiplayer action across all your devices.
Whether you’re aiming for the perfect break, pulling off trick shots, or dominating tournaments, Pool Blitz has something for everyone. Show off your skills, outplay your opponents, and BLITZ the competition!
Download Pool Blitz now and start your journey to becoming a Pool Legend!
(A network connection is required to play.)

bluejetty:00146825:ios.description:
Don’t let bullies steal your gift! Bad kids want all Christmas presents! Who will stop them? Good boy Christopher wants to visit Santa Claus’ land. Unfortunately, one kid is too jealous to let him do that… It’s Christmas Eve. A boy named Christopher writes a letter to Santa Claus. The teenager has only one wish – to visit his land, the North Pole. His parents have lost their Christmas spirit, and Christopher hopes that gifts from Santa will cheer them up. As impossible as it seems, the good wizard reads his letter and sends him the Golden Ticket to the Polar Express! Still, the trip is going to be rough because a group of bad boys wants to steal all Christmas gifts made for the good kids! And their sneaky leader, Harmverse, is up to no good…
· EXPLORE SANTA’S LAND, THE ASTONISHING NORTH POLE!
Have you ever been to the virtual North Pole in Domini Games quests? Santa Claus is waiting for you with pleasure in search and find games! Explore the beautiful, bright and unforgettable corners of this mysterious and cold pole in a point and click adventure! 
· USE YOUR WITS TO SOLVE VARIOUS PUZZLES!
Solving the mysteries is not so easy, try to prove the opposite using your mind and ingenuity in hidden object games!
· CATCH A CUNNING THIEF IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
Don't let the Christmas spirit go out in the hearts of adults and children! Hide and seek hidden pictures to solve the case and catch the enemies of Christmas who are stealing gifts in detective games!
· GATHER COLLECTIBLES AND LOOK FOR MORPHING OBJECTS!
You can be a real explorer, because the world of our games every corner is filled with highlights hidden pictures!

Cartão Poupa Mais

O Seu Folheto desta Semana
Esteja atento às recomendações personalizadas que temos para si e não deixe escapar nenhuma promoção, dos seus produtos preferidos. 
Faça listas de compras partilhadas e compre online
Faça a sua lista de compras na App, selecionando todos os produtos de que necessita. Pode pesquisar por texto ou por voz, adicionar a partir de sugestões exclusivas ou diretamente das promoções e dos folhetos, ou até fazer o scan do código de barras quando estiver em loja. Partilhe a lista com os restantes membros do seu agregado familiar, para que nunca se esqueça de nada. Com a lista pronta, a escolha é sua: visite o Pingo Doce mais próximo ou compre online e tenha as suas compras entregues em casa ou prontas para levantamento na loja.

Os melhores frescos estão aqui. Desde a carne mais tenra, ao peixe mais fresco e à fruta e legumes acabados de colher. Preparar o jantar nunca foi tão fácil. Basta encomendar as suas refeições preferidas na App aplicação. Os melhores pratos de carne, peixe ou vegetarianos estão aqui. Refeições feitas como em sua casa, com os mais frescos e melhores ingredientes.
É só, ir buscá-las à sua loja Pingo Doce de eleição e desfrutar. 
Dê-nos a sua opinião e faça sugestões de melhoria

bluejetty:00114488:ios.description:
Coin Identifier · Coin Scanner - Identify Any Coin in Seconds
If you have ever come across an old or unfamiliar coin and wondered where it came from, how old it is, or what it might be worth, you no longer need expert equipment or complicated guides. Coin Identifier · Coin Scanner gives you instant, accurate answers with a simple front-and-back photo. Powered by a large AI-driven database of over 300,000 coin types, it brings professional-level numismatic tools directly to your phone.
Whether you are starting a new hobby or managing an extensive collection, the app provides complete identification, detailed information, grading insights, and smart organizational tools. With industry-leading accuracy and fast scanning, Coin Identifier · Coin Scanner makes exploring the world of coins easier and more accessible than ever.
Key Identification Features:
- Identify any coin by taking or uploading front-and-back photos
- Detects country, denomination, circulation period, and issue year
- Analyzes physical properties such as diameter, weight, and thickness
- Recognizes materials including gold, silver, copper nickel, bronze, and more
- AI-powered grading to estimate condition and wear level
- Covers 300,000+ coin types with up to 99% recognition accuracy
- Provides rarity indicators and current estimated market value
Collection and Analysis Tools:
- Create and manage multiple custom coin collections
- Save identified coins with full details in your personal library
- Track total collection size, categories, and estimated value
- Access detailed info cards with history, composition, and design data
- Cloud synchronization for easy backup and cross-device access
- Ideal for learning, valuation, cataloging, and long-term collection tracking
Payment & Subscription Terms:
Choose between the following subscription options for unlimited access to all features:
• Weekly Subscription
• Yearly Subscription
Auto-Renewal: Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Manage Subscriptions: You can manage your subscriptions and disable auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
Payment: Payment is charged to your iTunes Account upon confirmation of purchase.
Renewal Charges: Your account will be charged for renewal 24 hours before the end of the current period, based on the selected plan.
Privacy Policy: https://heyos.co/privacy
Terms of Use: https://heyos.co/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00066477:ios.description:
On a hopeful morning, a queen ant finally found a haven where she would build her anthill. Yet, in this survival-of-the-fittest world, dangers lurk everywhere. Dear Ruler! The queen sends out a distress signal to you! Help her build your own ant kingdom!
[Survival Above All]
As the crisis looms, the ant colony faces a survival crisis. We must ensure that we have enough resources to survive in this dangerous world. As the ruler, your primary duty is to build the anthill, protect the queen, and confront crises.
[Rebuild Our Anthill]
Surviving is just the first step; you must expand your anthill. Ant Tunnels are the most important links between anthills. Location planning is a crucial strategy for the development of the anthill—it's time to showcase your wisdom!
[Find Powerful Special Ants]
By hatching eggs, you can acquire powerful special ants to become your fighting force. Only by hatching more special ants can you gain more control in the ant kingdom and survive more securely.
[Tame Dangerous Insects]
Other dangerous but powerful insects exist in this land. Tame them, bring them into battle, and dominate the battlefield. You can also dispatch them to work diligently within the anthill, accelerating the development of the anthill.
[Build a Strong Alliance]
Don't let the ant colony face invaders alone. Create or join an alliance, help each other, support one another, dominate the battlefield together, and rule the ant kingdom!
[Conquer the Tree of Abundance, Conquer Enemies]
Fight alongside your alliance members, compete for squirters, and occupy the Tree of Abundance. After that, your alliance will dominate the entire kingdom. Reward your allies, punish your enemies, and spread the legend of your story throughout the ant kingdom.
-------------------------------------------
Subscription Agreement in Brief:
The Ants: Underground Kingdom provides subscription services. During the subscription, you can enjoy exclusive attribute bonuses and privileges.
1. Content: Multiple privilege can be experienced every day, as well as various continuing huge bonuses.
2. Subscription duration: 7 days
3. Payment: Via your iTunes account
4. If you are a subscriber, within 24 hours before your weekly subscription expires, the subscription will be automatically renewed UNLESS you manually cancel it before then. 
5. To manage and cancel subscriptions, please head to Settings - iTunes Store & App Store - Check Apple ID - Account Settings - Subscription.
Privacy Policy: http://static-sites.allstarunion.com/privacy.html
Terms of Service: http://static-sites.allstarunion.com/terms.html
The Ants: Underground Kingdom provides an instant online customer service, which will surely give you a better gaming experience. No matter what kind of questions you have, we are here to help as much as possible. You can contact us through the following channels:
◆Official LINE: @theantsgame (don't forget "@")
◆Official Discord: https://discord.gg/PazRBH8kCC
◆Official Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/TheAntsGame
◆Official Support E-mail: theants@staruniongame.com
◆Official TikTok: @theants_global 
Attention!
The Ants: Underground Kingdom is free to download. However, some items in the game are not free. Players must be at least 3 years old to download it, as defined in the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. Besides, devices should have access to network as this is an online game.

bluejetty:00114922:ios.description:
Cat Away Jam: A Fun Casual Puzzle Game Adventure!
Welcome to Cat Away Jam, the ultimate casual puzzle game that blends adorable cat visuals with addictive block puzzle mechanics and smart logic puzzle challenges. This easy puzzle game is designed to be both a relaxing game and a stimulating brain game. Whether you're into match puzzles or need a great offline puzzle to play anytime, this game is for you!
In this fun and cat-themed puzzle, slide cat blocks to their matching cat houses. Think it's easy? Think again! As you move forward, you'll discover creative obstacles and tricky paths that require clever logic and strategy to solve.
Features of This Puzzle Game:
Easy-to-learn, deep-to-master puzzle game mechanics
Beautiful casual game experience with cat visuals
Play offline — perfect offline puzzle for any time
Hundreds of handcrafted block puzzle stages
No pressure, no timers — a perfect relaxing game
Fun match mechanics with increasing difficulty
Great for fans of both easy puzzle and logic puzzle fun
How to Play:
Each stage presents a new puzzle. Slide the cat blocks and match them with their correct cat houses. Use logic to figure out the best path. It's like a mini brain game that you can enjoy anytime.
Game Objective:
Slide blocks freely
Match cats correctly
Avoid traps and blockers
Solve each logic puzzle with strategy
Enjoy at your own pace — it’s a relaxing game after all!
Why You'll Love It:
This isn’t just another casual puzzle game. It’s a complete brain game experience. With every level, you’ll sharpen your mind while having fun. The combination of match, logic puzzle, and block puzzle design makes it unique and addicting.
Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned puzzle game player, you'll find enjoyment and challenge. No Wi-Fi? No problem. It's a full offline puzzle game you can enjoy on-the-go.
For All Players:
Ideal easy puzzle for all ages
Designed for both casual and strategic players
A top choice for fans of block puzzle and relaxing game mechanics
Whether on a break, commute, or relaxing at home, this offline puzzle fits perfectly
Download Now!
Join thousands already playing Cat Away Jam, one of the most addicting casual puzzle games available today. Whether you're seeking a light match game, a thoughtful logic puzzle, or just a beautiful relaxing game, this easy puzzle hits the purr-fect spot.
Download now and enjoy the cute, smart, and endlessly fun brain game journey today!
More Reasons to Love Cat Away Jam:
If you're tired of noisy, pay-to-win games and want a pure casual puzzle game that focuses on fun, logic, and satisfaction, Cat Away Jam is your best match. It's perfect for fans of classic match gameplay and modern block puzzle challenges. With intuitive controls, adorable design, and rewarding level progression, it’s an ideal relaxing game to spend time on.
Many players love how each level feels like a mini brain game. You can feel your skills improving as puzzles grow more complex. It's a satisfying loop: think, plan, slide, and win. And since it's an offline puzzle, you can take your adventure anywhere—on the subway, airplane, or even camping!
Evolving Difficulty, Never Boring
The game starts simple with easy puzzle stages that introduce the basic rules. But as you keep playing, new elements like blockers, portals, and multiple exits add layers of depth. This evolution transforms each puzzle into a genuine logic puzzle that makes you pause, analyze, and think ahead.
Whether you play 5 minutes or 50, you'll enjoy a rich experience every time. And since it’s a casual game, there's no rush. Take your time to complete each block puzzle without stress or pressure.

bluejetty:00022397:ios.name: K7D - Tape Delay
bluejetty:00022397:ios.summary: K7D is a powerful and affordable, vintage tape delay effect plugin for iOS. K7D recreates the hardware echo machines of the past using Imaginando’s signature style of obsessive analog emulation, but with an enhanced level of control from a
bluejetty:00022397:ios.description:
K7D is a powerful and affordable, vintage tape delay effect plugin for iOS. K7D recreates the hardware echo machines of the past using Imaginando’s signature style of obsessive analog emulation, but with an enhanced level of control from a sleek, modern interface. Using this approach allows a whole new world of creative possibilities, while still retaining a warm, full-bodied analog sound, bursting with character and personality.
To give K7D it’s distinctive analog flavour, we studied and analysed the tiny details of what makes classic hardware delays great, and painstakingly recreated every subtle nuance for a fantastically authentic sound.
Available as a standalone app and audio unit plugin, you can use it digital audio stations for iOS such as Garage Band, AUM, Cubasis, Auria, Audiobus, etc.
Features
- 1ms to 1 sec. dual playhead analog modeled delay with noise, tape distortion and mechanical vibration models
- Modeled microphone input with pre-amp saturation
- Normal and Ping Pong modes
- Optimized gain staging and saturation algorithms for very musical results
- Delay time spread between heads and stereo width control
- High pass and Low pass filter on feedback path
- Powerful LFO bipolar time modulation with multiple waveforms (sine, triangular, saw, square, sample and hold and filtered sample and hold) and possibility of inverted LFO phase on second play head (for added stereo imaging)
- Delay time syncable with BPM
- Possibility of delay time modulation via incoming midi notes
- Oscilloscope visualisation of audio waveform and LFO waveform
- Built-in patch manager
- Audiounit compatible

K7D recreates the hardware echo machines of the past using Imaginando’s signature style of obsessive analog emulation, but with an enhanced level of control from a sleek, modern interface. Using this approach allows a whole new world of creative possibilities, while still retaining a warm, full-bodied analog sound, bursting with character and personality.

To give K7D it’s distinctive analog flavour, we studied and analysed the tiny details of what makes classic hardware delays great, and painstakingly recreated every subtle nuance for a fantastically authentic sound.

Available as a standalone app and audio unit plugin, you can use it digital audio stations for iOS such as Garage Band, AUM, Cubasis, Auria, Audiobus, etc.

Features

- 1ms to 1 sec. dual playhead analog modeled delay with noise, tape distortion and mechanical vibration models
- Modeled microphone input with pre-amp saturation
- Normal and Ping Pong modes
- Optimized gain staging and saturation algorithms for very musical results
- Delay time spread between heads and stereo width control
- High pass and Low pass filter on feedback path
- Powerful LFO bipolar time modulation with multiple waveforms (sine, triangular, saw, square, sample and hold and filtered sample and hold) and possibility of inverted LFO phase on second play head (for added stereo imaging)
- Delay time syncable with BPM
- Possibility of delay time modulation via incoming midi notes
- Oscilloscope visualisation of audio waveform and LFO waveform
- Built-in patch manager
- Audiounit compatible

bluejetty:00074206:ios.description:
TwistedWave is a very fast and easy to use audio editor and recorder.
Even when working with huge files, it will remain very fast and fluid, and will never run out of memory.
TwistedWave Recorder is the free version of TwistedWave Audio Editor. You can use it to record and send audio by email. Once the full editing functionality and the extra export options have been purchased, "TwistedWave Recorder" and "TwistedWave Audio Editor" offer the same feature set.
UNIQUE TO TWISTEDWAVE
• Very fluid, even with very large files
• Unlimited undo / redo history, happens instantly
RECORD AUDIO
• No duration limit other than the available storage
• Up to 24 bit / 96 kHz audio if your audio interface supports it
• Record stereo audio with the built-in microphone (iPhone XS or more recent)
• Record studio quality audio with an external microphone
• Record audio from other music applications with Audiobus
APPLY EFFECTS (with in-app purchase)
• Precision Time Stretching & Pitch Shifting technology licensed from ZTX
• All the AudioUnit extensions (AUv3) available on the App Store can be used with TwistedWave
• Cut, copy / paste audio around
• Fade in / out
• Reverb
• Delay / echo
• Distortion
• Equalizer (parametric, or iPod EQ)
• Dynamics processor, can be used as a compressor or a noise gate
• Peak limiter to amplify audio without causing distortion
• Amplify or normalize the audio to a given level
• Filters (low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, low-shelf, high-shelf)
• Convert the sampling rate (with SoX' very high quality resampler)
• Reverse. Play the file backwards, mostly for fun!
MANY FILE FORMATS SUPPORTED
• WAV
• M4A (AAC or Apple Lossless)
• MP3 (Encoded with the LAME MP3 encoder for the best quality)
• FLAC
• AIFF
• CAF
MANY IMPORT OPTIONS
• Import songs from the music library
• Import files from the Files app
• Import files from an SD card or USB drive, with the right adapter
• Open files sent from other apps
• Browser access, send a file to TwistedWave from a device on the same WiFi network
MANY EXPORT OPTIONS (with in-app purchase)
• Send your files by
 - Email (available free, without the in-app purchase)
 - iMessage
 - SoundCloud
 - Dropbox
 - AudioCopy
 - An FTP or SFTP account
 - Any app that accepts audio files
• Export multiple files in a single ZIP file
• Browser access to allow downloading and uploading files from/to TwistedWave
• File too large? Just send a link. (30 days for free on TwistedWave's servers)
BROWSER ACCESS (with in-app purchase)
Connect to the TwistedWave app from a web browser on another device or computer on the same WiFi network, and:
• Play and download the files directly from a browser
• Send files to TwistedWave by drag and dropping them in the browser

bluejetty:00130238:ios.name: Number Games for Kids
bluejetty:00130238:ios.summary: Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading,
bluejetty:00130238:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
Skidos Number Games is an excellent game for children that helps develop their mathematical attention. It's designed to encourage understanding of the world through numbers, quantities, sizes, and geometric shapes. Since children are naturally curious about math, Skidos Number Games presents a fun and engaging world that helps them learn through play. Skidos Number Games is an excellent game that helps children develop their mathematical attention while having fun and exploring a colorful and engaging world.
Key features:
- Develop mathematical attention
- Explore numbers, shapes, and patterns
- Discover unique locations in a colorful and vibrant town
- Develop critical skills like sorting, matching, and identifying shapes
- Meet the cutest friends
- Enjoy fun and educational entertainment!
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

**Coin Dozer: A Thrilling Arcade Experience on Your Mobile Device**
Step into the vibrant world of **Coin Dozer**, the ultimate **arcade-style coin-pushing game** available on the **App Store**. This **addictive mobile game** brings the nostalgic fun of classic arcade coin pushers right to your fingertips, offering hours of entertainment with its **colorful graphics**, **engaging gameplay**, and **rewarding mechanics**. Whether you're a casual gamer or a seasoned player, Coin Dozer is designed to captivate and challenge you with its **simple yet strategic gameplay**.
In Coin Dozer, your goal is to **push coins off the edge of the machine** to earn points, collect prizes, and unlock exciting new levels. The game features **realistic physics** that make every push, slide, and drop feel satisfyingly authentic. As you progress, you'll encounter **power-ups**, **special coins**, and **bonus items** that enhance your gameplay and boost your winnings. From **gold coins** to **diamonds**, **tickets**, and **mystery cards**, every element is designed to keep you hooked.
One of the standout features of Coin Dozer is its **progression system**. As you collect coins and prizes, you can **unlock new themes** and **customize your coin pusher machine** with unique designs, such as **pirate treasure**, **space adventures**, or **enchanted forests**. Each theme comes with its own set of challenges and rewards, ensuring that the game never feels repetitive. Additionally, the game offers **daily bonuses** and **limited-time events** that provide extra opportunities to earn coins and prizes.
Coin Dozer also incorporates **social features** that allow you to compete with friends and players worldwide. Climb the **leaderboards**, share your achievements, and challenge others to see who can collect the most coins and prizes. The game's **in-app purchases** provide optional enhancements, such as **extra coins** or **boosters**, to help you progress faster or overcome tricky levels. However, the game is designed to be fully enjoyable without spending real money, making it accessible to all players.
The **user-friendly interface** and **intuitive controls** make Coin Dozer easy to pick up and play, while its **depth and variety** ensure long-lasting appeal. Whether you're looking for a quick gaming session or an immersive experience, Coin Dozer delivers on all fronts. Its **optimized performance** ensures smooth gameplay on all iOS devices, from iPhones to iPads.
With its **addictive mechanics**, **rewarding progression**, and **endless replayability**, Coin Dozer has become a **top-rated game** on the App Store. It’s perfect for players of all ages who enjoy **casual games**, **arcade classics**, or **skill-based challenges**. Download Coin Dozer today and experience the thrill of pushing coins, collecting prizes, and unlocking endless fun in one of the most **popular mobile games** available. Get ready to **doze, win, and repeat**!

失眠、打鼾等睡眠健康预警及改善方案

bluejetty:00070036:ios.description:
Explore the world of Runaria to find a beautiful place filled with fun where EVERYTHING may be COMBINED to create greater, more effective goods on your adventure!
Runaria has been concealed by a mysterious event and the Settlers need your help! Your miraculous ability to MATCH ANYTHING, is the only hope for Runaria.
Delve into dungeons to solve puzzles and learn new MERGE magic mechanics, then return the winnings to your Home Camp to gather and expand!
Manage and merge on your Home Camp, even when you're OFFLINE. Boost production and MERGE EVERYTHING into better and more powerful items full of magic for your journey.
Set foot in the Forest, Cave, Desert, and beyond. Find Iron, Gold, Emeralds, Diamonds, and hidden treasures!
The most challenging missions await you!
Match even more with DAILY QUESTS and by assisting your fellow Settlers! Every week, take part in fresh EVENTS! Are you, The One?
MERGECRAFTER FEATURES:
== MERGING ==
* Find over 600 amazing things to match and interact with!
* Drag items at will throughout the land to evolve them into better ones!
* Match 3 of a kind or 5 for a BONUS!
* Find the Waypoints that have become stuck in the obscured land of each DUNGEON level. MERGE them to solve the puzzle!
* MERGE items to gain XP to heal concealed land!
== TOOLS ==
* Craft and Merge Axes, Pickaxes, and Shovels!
* Axes chop down trees
* Pickaxes mine ores
* Shovels dig up sand piles 
* REFORGE to upgrade your tools with COINS!
* Increase your Tool Power by ENCHANTING, REFORGING, and Trinkets!
== ENCHANTING ==
* BRAND NEW gameplay in the MERGE genre!
* ENCHANT your tools with the spellbinding ALTAR to become more powerful!
* Unique ENCHANTS such as Frenzy, Chain Lightning, Lifesteal, and many more
* Upgrade your ENCHANTS to become even stronger
== DUNGEONS ==
* Explore a wide variety of different DUNGEONS in the Forest, Cave, and Desert!
* Enjoy unfolding and progressing through dungeons as you break and merge your way through the levels
== QUESTS ==
* Obtain and complete QUESTS from your fellow Settlers!
* Earn SUPPLIES and COINS by turning in completed QUESTS!
== SETTLER'S CAMP ==
* Upgrade your CAMP by completing QUESTS to earn SUPPLIES!
* Unlock powerful tools by upgrading your CAMP to assist you in your adventure!

bluejetty:00015742:ios.description:
Do you love the starry night? Do you want to know everything in the sky? Star Rover HD is the fantastic planetarium for your iPad. Just hold up your iPad and Star Rover HD will tell you exactly what you are pointing at.
Star Rover HD determines your location automatically. You'll see the stars, moon, planets, constellations in their proper place from your current location. As you move your iPad, the star map updates in real time.
Star Rover HD makes the virtual sky a gorgeous view. You can see star twinkling, beautiful nebulae, occasional meteor and even sunset glow in the evening.
Star Rover HD is very easy to use. You can simply change the sky view in settings and use Quick Find for everything you want to know in the night sky.
Star Rover HD lets you set your location manually so you can see the sky from any part of the world. It also lets you travel to the future or the past and see the sky on different dates and times. If you are planning for a solar eclipse, this is the app you need.
Features
- Over 120,000 stars.
- All 88 constellations with beautiful artworks.
- Planets and their moons with stunning graphics.
- Moon phases.
- Real images of Messier objects.
- Sky objects information.
- Realistic Milky Way.
- Equatorial and azimuthal grids.
- Sky view underneath the horizon.
- Visual magnitude adjustment.
- Manually time & date setting.
- Manually location setting.
- Quick Find.
- Point and view.

Spin makes difficult decisions easier, faster and more beautiful. Create multiple lucky wheels and customize them: choose the number of entries, change their colors, name them, and much more.
The following features are included in Spin:
-
bluejetty:00135721:ios.description:
Spin makes difficult decisions easier, faster and more beautiful. Create multiple lucky wheels and customize them: choose the number of entries, change their colors, name them, and much more.
The following features are included in Spin:
- Easy Start:
Tap the start button once to start the lucky wheel. Tap again to make it spin faster.
- Number of Entries:
Tap the plus and minus buttons to specify how many entries the lucky wheel should have. You can also quickly adjust the number of entries in the wheel settings.
- Customize Entries:
Tap a entry of the lucky wheel to change its color or name. The available colors can be adjusted in the app settings. Every entry can also have a weight that controls the likelihood of it being selected.
- Templates & SpinAI:
Create new wheels from a variety of templates, or let AI automatically generate one for any topic.
- Multiple Lucky Wheels, Apple Watch & iCloud:
You can create as many wheels as you like and quickly switch between them. All wheels are synchronized via iCloud with Spin on your iPhone, Apple Watch, iPad, Mac and Apple TV. Wheels can be named to find them quickly.
- Look and Feel:
Spinning the wheel feels amazingly real thanks to your iPhone's Taptic Engine and is smoothly animated at the same time! Depending on your preference, the vibration and sound can also be deactivated. When the wheel comes to a stop, the field name is displayed (if available) and a beautiful confetti animation is played.
- Elimination Mode:
In Elimination Mode, selected entries are not selected again. If all entries have been selected, the process starts again from the beginning.
- Counting Mode:
In Counting Mode, the entries are numbered consecutively. You can also set the starting value from which to start counting. This means you can also use Spin as a random number generator! The counting mode can be switched on and off individually for each wheel. Please note that for space reasons, this function is not suitable for more than 30 numbers.
- Color Pattern:
You can define a color pattern for each wheel. The color pattern determines the colors of the new wheel entries. For many entries, the pattern is repeated.
- Wheel Behavior:
The rotation speed and also the duration of the wheel can be adapted to your needs.
- Sounds:
The sounds, which are played when the wheel spins or comes to a stop, can be personalized.
- Dark Mode:
The system-wide dark or light mode is used as the primary color scheme.
This application is governed by Apple’s standard Licensed Application End User License Agreement (EULA), available at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
