bluejetty:00186611:ios.name: Google Classroom
bluejetty:00186611:ios.summary: Classroom is a free service for schools, non-profits, and anyone with a personal Google account. Classroom makes it easy for learners and instructors to connect—inside and outside of schools. Classroom saves time and paper, and makes it eas
bluejetty:00186611:ios.description:
Classroom is a free service for schools, non-profits, and anyone with a personal Google account. Classroom makes it easy for learners and instructors to connect—inside and outside of schools. Classroom saves time and paper, and makes it easy to create classes, distribute assignments, communicate, and stay organized.
Classroom is designed to help teachers create, collect, and grade assignments paperlessly, including time-saving features like the ability to automatically make a copy of a Google Document for each student. It also creates Drive folders for each assignment and for each student to help keep everyone organized.
Students can keep track of what’s due on the Assignments page and begin working with just a click. Teachers can quickly see who has or hasn't completed the work, and provide direct, real-time feedback and grades right in Classroom.
With the mobile app for iOS, students and teachers can view their classes and communicate with their classmates in real time. Students can open their assignments and work on them right from their iPhone or iPad. Teachers can keep track of who has turned in work and grade the assignment - at school or on the go. Students and teachers receive notifications when they have new content in Classroom, so they are always up to date.
There are many benefits of using Classroom:
Easy to set up
Teachers can add students directly or share a code with their class to join. It takes just minutes to set up.
Saves time
The simple, paperless assignment workflow allows teachers to create, review, and grade assignments quickly, all in one place.
Improves organization
Students can see all of their assignments on an assignments page, and all class materials (e.g., documents, photos, and videos) are automatically filed into folders in Google Drive.
Enhances communication
Classroom allows teachers to send announcements and start class discussions instantly. Students can share resources with each other or provide answers to questions on the stream.
Secure
Like the rest of Google Workspace for Education services, Classroom contains no ads, never uses your content or student data for advertising purposes.
Permissions Notice:
Camera: Needed to allow the user to take photos or videos and post them to Classroom.
Microphone: Needed to enable audio capture for recording videos to be posted to Classroom.
Photos: Needed to allow the user to attach photos or videos to Classroom. Photos or videos posted to Classroom will be stored on Google servers in order to show them in Classroom.

bluejetty:00112197:android.description:
The SRI Mobile application is a new information channel of the Internal Revenue Service that allows citizens to access public tax inquiries, news, information from agencies and social networks of the institution from mobile devices, in an agile and easy-to-use way.
The consultation services offered are:
- Tax Status (check if you are up to date with your tax obligations).
- Registration Value (know the value to pay for the registration of your vehicle).
- Debts (find out if you have outstanding debts and challenges with the SRI).
- Validity of Physical Documents (check the validity of the sales receipts and complementary documents).
- Caused Income Tax (know the amounts paid for Income Tax and Currency Outflow).
- Follow-up of Procedures (know the status of the procedures entered into the Administration).
- Validation QR Codes (check statements, certificates and documents issued by the Administration online).
- Electronic Receipts: (check your received electronic receipts, registering the username and password with which you enter SRI online).
- Request for Shifts (request an appointment in the future to be attended at certain agencies in the service you require).
- Calculators (confirm the values to pay according to the calculations offered by the SRI calculators).
- Complaints (report tax and administrative complaints).
- Contact us (register complaints, suggestions or congratulations).

This captivating adventure game has:

- Custom composed soundtrack and sound effects!

- A camera that takes photos of clues and symbols as you discover them

- Get helpful text hints that nudge you in the right direction and complete walkthrough videos for each hint and puzzle

bluejetty:00135050:ios.description:
Mantra, meditation, chakra, and yoga—all in one place.
From Gayatri and Shiva mantras to OM chanting, guided meditation, Japa practice, and chakra sounds, Mantra Meditation Chakra Yoga brings together meaningful ways to make meditation part of your daily routine.
Explore Kundalini meditation, singing bowls, meditation music, Solfeggio frequencies, nature sounds, and customizable soundscapes for meditation, sleep, relaxation, focus, and quiet moments throughout your day.
MANTRA & CHANTING
Explore a collection of mantras, chants, and meditation sounds for your daily practice:
• Gayatri Mantra
• Shiva Mantras
• OM Chanting
• OM So Hum
• Om Mani Padme Hum
• Ganesh Mantra
• Chakra Seed Mantras
• Japa Meditation
• Sanskrit and Vedic-inspired chants
Listen, chant along, repeat your favorite mantras, or simply create a peaceful space for meditation and reflection.
MEDITATION, CHAKRA & YOGA
Choose from meditation practices and sounds for different moments and intentions:
• Guided Meditation
• Chakra Meditation
• Kundalini Meditation
• Yoga-inspired meditation
• Mindfulness
• Sleep & Relaxation
• Focus & Clarity
Explore the seven chakras from Root to Crown with chakra sounds, seed mantras, and meditation content designed to complement your personal practice.
SOUNDS & MUSIC
Create the atmosphere that feels right for you with a wide variety of meditation sounds and music:
• Tibetan Singing Bowls
• Meditation Music
• Solfeggio Frequencies
• Binaural Beats
• Nature Sounds
• Ambient Soundscapes
• Sleep Sounds
Whether you're meditating, preparing for sleep, practicing yoga, or taking a quiet moment during the day, choose the sounds that fit your routine.
JAPA COUNTER & MEDITATION TIMER
Bring more structure to your mantra and meditation practice.
Use the built-in Japa Counter to keep track of mantra repetitions, and personalize your meditation sessions with the timer. Whether you practice with a mala, repeat a mantra, or simply sit in meditation, these tools make it easier to follow your own rhythm.
CREATE YOUR OWN SOUNDSCAPE
Mix nature and ambient sounds to create a personalized sound environment.
Choose from rain, ocean waves, fire, wind, birds, rivers, waterfalls, and more. Combine your favorite sounds for meditation, yoga, relaxation, focus, or your bedtime routine.
WHAT’S INCLUDED
• Mantra meditation and chanting
• Gayatri and Shiva mantras
• OM chanting and Japa meditation
• Chakra meditation and seed mantras
• Guided meditation sessions
• Kundalini and yoga-inspired meditation
• Japa Counter and meditation timer
• Meditation music and sleep sounds
• Tibetan singing bowls
• Solfeggio frequencies and binaural beats
• Nature and ambient sounds
• Custom sound mixer
Whether you're just beginning or already have a regular meditation, yoga, or Japa practice, Mantra Meditation Chakra Yoga gives you different ways to listen, chant, meditate, and create a routine that works for you.
SUBSCRIPTION & ACCESS
Free content is available to help you get started.
Unlock full access with flexible options:
• Monthly
• Annual
• Lifetime (one-time purchase)
Your account will be charged upon confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.

bluejetty:00183198:ios.description:

* Amount Estimation (How much you should drink based on your weight)
* Update Past Data
* Work great with iOS Voice Over/ Screen Reader

bluejetty:00182483:ios.summary: Grindr is the world’s leading free dating app serving the LGBTQ community. If you’re gay, bi, trans, queer, or even just curious, Grindr is the best and easiest way to meet new people for friendships, dates, and whatever else you’re looking
bluejetty:00182483:ios.description:
Grindr is the world’s leading free dating app serving the LGBTQ community. If you’re gay, bi, trans, queer, or even just curious, Grindr is the best and easiest way to meet new people for friendships, dates, and whatever else you’re looking for.
On a trip? Grindr is an indispensable tool for LGBTQ travelers—log in to meet locals and get recommendations for bars, restaurants, events, and more. With Grindr in your pocket, you’ll always be connected to other LGBTQ people around you and have your finger on the pulse of what’s happening.
Ready to get started? Creating your profile is easy, and you can share as much or little about yourself as you like. Within minutes you’ll be ready to connect, chat, and meet up with people near you.
Grindr is faster and better than ever:
• See people nearby based on your location
• Chat and share private photos
• Add tags to share your interests
• Search tags to find others based on their interests
• Create private albums to share (and unshare) multiple photos at once
• Filter your search to find what you want
• Star your favorites and block others
• Report people easily and safely
Looking for even more? Upgrade your Grindr experience to XTRA for more features, more control, and more fun:
• No 3rd party ads
• See up to 600 profiles at once
• View only people who are online now
• View only profiles with a photo
• Filter by position, relationship status, and more
Want more control? Upgrade to Grindr Unlimited:
• Unlimited profiles
• Full access to your Viewed Me list
• Incognito mode - browse profiles without being seen
• Unsend messages and photos
• All XTRA features
More action, less effort. Get Grindr Edge, our top subscription tier, with three features you won’t find anywhere else:
• Insights: Someone catches your eye? Know your chances before you make your move. See what they’re into, how often and how quickly they reply, and how well you match.
• Recommendations: Get five profiles picked for you based on your interests and how you use Grindr, including people beyond your grid. Each stays in your lineup until you’ve checked them out.
• Reconnect: Pick up the conversation where you left off with a quick summary of where things stand. Sort by activity to find the connections worth another message, including the ones you never replied to.
Get further, faster with Edge.
Need help? If you are experiencing any issues, you can get support by contacting us through https://help.grindr.com
Grindr Ads:
Grindr (excluding XTRA, Unlimited and Edge accounts) includes third-party advertising, which involves the sharing of limited data with our Ad/Marketing partners as described in our privacy policy. Grindr does not share any of your Grindr profile information with Advertising or Marketing partners. You can adjust your third-party advertising privacy settings within the app at any time.
Grindr Subscriptions:
Your subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your iTunes account will automatically be charged at the renewal price within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period unless you change your subscription preferences in your App Store account settings. You can manage your subscriptions at any time through your App Store account settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when making a purchase of an auto-renewing subscription.
Grindr, Grindr XTRA, Grindr Unlimited & Grindr Edge are for adults 18 years and older only. Profile photos depicting nudity or sex acts are strictly prohibited.
Terms of Service: www.grindr.com/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: www.grindr.com/privacy-policy/

Mico — Your Home Screen Personalization App, Fully Optimized for iOS 27!
[Create Your Custom Home Screen]
Create a home screen that reflects your style with Animated Artwork, 3D and Depth Effect Wallpapers, Liquid Glass Themes, customizable widgets, and more.
[iOS 27 Depth Effect Wallpapers and Liquid Glass Themes]
Depth Effect Wallpapers use intelligent layering to blend time, icons, and wallpaper elements, creating a vivid sense of depth.
Liquid Glass Themes combine light, transparency, and fluid textures for a fresh visual experience.
4x6 Extra‑Large Widgets provide more space for photos, battery information, health data, couple widgets, and other content.

Mico is optimized for foldable devices and iPad. Enjoy responsive layouts across different screen sizes, orientations, and display modes.

Combine stylish widgets, wallpapers, and lock screen templates in seconds. Explore designs created by designers from around the world and apply your favorite theme with one tap.
[Home Screen and Lock Screen Widgets]
Couple Widget: Share a little love with your partner directly on your home screens.
Battery Widget: Display your battery level with customizable styles and themes.
Photo Widget: Choose from photo frames featuring cute pets, retro game consoles, movie film styles, and more.
Animation Widgets: Enjoy emoticons, flashing emojis, GIFs, bear animations, cute cat animations, flashing hearts, and other fun designs.

Fully compatible with iOS 27. Customize your Home Screen, Lock Screen, Control Center, and Lock Screen buttons with cute, text‑based, animated, and personalized icons.
[Apple Health Tracking]
Mico Lock Screen Widgets can integrate with Apple Health to display data such as daily steps. Please allow Mico to access your health data when using health widgets.

bluejetty:00195778:android.description:
McAfee Safe Family 👨👩👧👦 provides parents with the visibility and simple controls needed to improve web, app & digital safety for children. We encourage positive parent-child interactions and help establish trust and peace of mind in an ever-mobile, ever-social, ever-changing world.
Accessibility services are required for McAfee Safe Family App to block access to inappropriate websites and applications for children.
McAfee Safe Family is a comprehensive parental control app that enables you to monitor your kids’ phone activities and protects your children from exposure to inappropriate digital content. It sets up a child lock that blocks inappropriate apps 🚫, monitors your kids’ cell phones 🔍, locates their position with a GPS map 🌎 using the phone tracker feature and limits their screen time ⏰ .
Download McAfee Safe Family now to view reports 📋 about your kids’ device usage and allows parents to block social media apps 📵 to avoid any potential cyber-bullying or trolling. Instantly block apps you consider inappropriate, monitor your kids’ phone activities, enable a child lock 🔒 and limit screen time with a bedtime curfew ⏱. Choose to allow extra app time or provide access a blocked app plus know where your children are at all times through their connected devices with the Family Locator 👬.
Features:
✔️ View history about app usage activity, location details and system alert history
✔️ App Blocker by category keeps your children from accessing apps in specific categories
✔️ App Blocker by specific Android apps allows you to block individual apps on your kid’s Android device
✔️ Set a daily time limit for apps to help manage the amount of screen time your child spends with specific applications
✔️ Track a cell phone and see your kids on a live map so that you know where they are in real time - from breakfast to bedtime
✔️ Use geofences to receive an automatic alert when your child has arrived or left a known place (e.g. school, park, or library) with the GPS location tracking feature so you’ll know where they are
✔️ Limit screen time to prevent your kids from using their devices early in the morning or set a bedtime curfew and limit accessibility late at night
✔️ Use this function to promote good mental health and limit the negative impacts of artificial

bluejetty:00179830:ios.description:
How many national flags can you recognize? Which is your favorite country all over the world? If you travel to your favorite country, what kind of cultural activities and local food would you like to enjoy? Papo Town features this new theme room decoration and play house game. 
There are 6 countries for your choice: USA, China, Russia, Egypt, Mexico and Saudi Arabia. Enter your favorite country themed room and decorate it as you like. The furniture and decorations are carefully selected and rich in customs of various nations. Fill the room with your favorite elements! When you are done, invite your Papo friends over for a party! 
The Papo Town series are very popular among the players of Papo Town Wedding Party, Papo Town Seasons, Papo Town Castle, Papo Town Skyscraper, Papo Town Hospital Story, Papo Town Clinic, Papo Town Sports Meet, Papo Town Superstar, Papo Town Pop Star, Papo Town School, Papo Town Forest Friends, Papo Town Pirate, Papo Town Apartment and Papo Town Hospital. 
【Features】
 6 country themed rooms!
 Free decoration and room design.
 Learn about the local customs of styles of each country
 More than one hundred interactive items!
 No rules, more fun!
 Explore creativity and imagination
 Multi-touch supported. Play with your friends.
 No Wi-Fi needed. It can be played anywhere!
This version of Papo Town Countries is free to download. Unlock more rooms through in-app purchase. Once complete the purchase, it will be permanently unlocked and bound with your account. 
If there are any questions during the purchase and playing, feel free to contact us via contact@papoworld.com

website: www.papoworld.com
Face book: https://www.facebook.com/PapoWorld/

bluejetty:00156192:ios.description:
Welcome to Ellafi Federal Credit Union — banking designed to support women and those who support them.
Our mobile banking app offers simple, secure, and powerful features to help you manage your money with confidence—wherever life takes you.
Key Features:
• Quick and Secure Login: Log in safely using Face ID, Touch ID, or your secure passcode.
• Account Management: View balances, track spending, and review transactions in real-time across your checking, savings, and loan accounts.
• Money Movement Made Easy: Transfer funds between accounts, pay bills, and send money to friends and family with ease.
• Remote Check Deposit: Deposit checks anytime, anywhere—no branch visit required.
• Card Controls: Turn your debit or credit card on or off, report it lost or stolen, and set travel notices directly in the app.
• Credit Score Access: Stay on top of your financial health with free credit score monitoring and tips to improve your score.
• Financial Wellness Tools: Access curated resources built to empower your financial journey—designed with women in mind.
• Customized Alerts: Set up push notifications and email alerts to stay in control of your finances.
• ATM & Branch Locator: Easily find surcharge-free ATMs and shared branches nationwide.
Built for real life. Backed by a community that gets you.
At Ellafi, we believe in banking that uplifts, empowers, and evolves with you. Our mobile app is more than a financial tool—it's a companion on your journey toward financial independence and resilience.
Not a member yet?
Join a financial institution that puts people—not profits—first. Visit ellafifcu.org to learn more.

bluejetty:00166239:ios.name: Zapya - File Sharing
bluejetty:00166239:ios.summary: File sharing has never been simpler! Without the need of a cable or cellular data, you can share files from device to device for free with Zapya. Zapya allows you to seamlessly transfer massive files across multiple platforms with speeds up
bluejetty:00166239:ios.description:
File sharing has never been simpler! Without the need of a cable or cellular data, you can share files from device to device for free with Zapya. Zapya allows you to seamlessly transfer massive files across multiple platforms with speeds up to 10MB/second or up to 260 pictures in a minute. 
Looking to quickly connect with someone nearby? With the support of GPS location, Zapya provides a fast and accurate way to find nearby devices. You can also shake your devices at the same time in order to connect. Zapya can support USB Backup and Restore on iPad.
Another way to connect on Zapya is via QR Codes. You can generate a personalized QR code in order to share multiple files at once. Others just need to scan the QR code to have the files to instantly start downloading onto their phone. Without touching your keyboard, you can share files to others! 
If you have important files on your device that you do not want others to have access to, you can select and lock those files into a hidden folder. By doing this, the next time you go to share files with someone; they will not be able to see or access those files. 
Besides sharing files, you can chat offline with up to five other devices using Zapya. You can also move the phone log and photos from your old device to your new phone in a matter of minutes. Or if you want to take photos remotely, you can use the PeerCam feature and control the camera of a connected device with peer permission. 
If you like Zapya, please give us reviews and high ratings. Your support is much appreciated!
If you experience any issues or have any suggestions, please send feedback to us within the app or contact: feedback@dewmobile.net.
Disclaimer: This app may use your location even when it is not open, which can decrease device battery life.

bluejetty:00073431:ios.name: OneTouch Reveal® app
bluejetty:00073431:ios.summary:
The OneTouch Reveal® mobile app has helped over 4 million* people take a step forward in their diabetes management. The OneTouch Reveal® app can be used to track information from blood glucose meters to support diabetes management.
The app
bluejetty:00073431:ios.description:
The OneTouch Reveal® mobile app has helped over 4 million* people take a step forward in their diabetes management. The OneTouch Reveal® app can be used to track information from blood glucose meters to support diabetes management.
The app seamlessly syncs data with compatible OneTouch brand meters to change the way you see your blood glucose.
Helps you easily spot blood glucose patterns
• Transforms data into colorful snapshots that connect your blood glucose with food, insulin and activity.
• Draws a timeline of important blood glucose events and activities, highlighting when you have been repeatedly out of range.
• Receive automatic notifications on your smartphone when a high or low blood glucose pattern is detected.
Personalize your diabetes management tools
• Set personalized reminders to stay on top of patterns, meds, food, exercise—whatever you need to manage your diabetes.
• With the Blood Sugar Mentor™ feature**, you get personalized guidance, insight, and encouragement to help you manage your blood glucose.
Set up and track personalized goals and visualize your progress over time.
• Test your blood glucose to identify patterns.
• Monitor the number of steps you walk each day.
• Regularly log the carbohydrates you eat to see the correlation between your food intake and your blood glucose levels.
• Track the amount of exercise you are getting.
Easy-to-view diabetes logbook
• Automatically logs and organizes your blood glucose readings.
• Identify high and low blood glucose readings with the color-coded logbook.
• See how you’re doing at a glance, with a simple 14-, 30- and 90-day overview of your blood glucose readings.
Other helpful blood glucose management features
• Share your progress with your care team between visits – you can email your personalized diabetes report.
• The A1c comparator lets you compare your lab A1c to the average of your blood glucose readings from the last 90 days.
• Optionally integrates with the Health app.
• Easier carb logging with the integrated food search functionality.
To learn more, contact OneTouch® Customer Care at
https://www.onetouch.com/global
*Data on file.
**Feature only available when using a meter compatible with the Blood Sugar Mentor™ feature.
Treatment decisions should be based on the current numerical reading and healthcare professional’s recommendation.
All trademarks are registered by their respective owners and used by permission.
GL-DMV-2300012

bluejetty:00172610:ios.description:
PHOTO ENHANCER 
Perfect for enhancing and improving the quality of your photos. It's easy to use to sharpen, unblur out of focus, low to high resolution and upscale your photos. Convert your low-resolution and old photos into beautiful HD 4K images. Transform blurry photos into clear memories! Transform dark photos into bright memories! Transform blemished photos into flawless memories!
OLD PHOTO REPAIR
Restore the original colors and details of old photos while enhancing the overall visual effect of the photo to bring memories back to life. Repair old, scratched photos and remove scratches on photos. Find those precious photos now and let Pica AI help you restore the details and colors on them.
FACE SWAP
With Pica AI you're in control to replace anyone on photos and videos. Change your portrait with realistic face swaps, making editing fun and accessible for everyone. Pica AI is designed to offer exceptional convenience and quality, making editing a breeze for all. Become a historical figure, take a selfie with a celebrity, swap your face onto '90s yearbook photos, mashup anything you can think of. Face swapping is not just fun - it lets you explore different realities and bring your wildest ideas to life. 
AI HEADSHOT
Whether it's for job hunting, social media, or personal branding, AI helps generate high-quality, professional portraits, allowing you to showcase your best image. Skip the hours-long photo shoots and makeup routines. With just a few simple steps, AI can quickly create professional headshots and personalized portraits for you. Best of all, you get studio-quality portraits without the studio prices or the long wait.
EASY TO USE
Easy to get started with, even users without professional skills can quickly learn to use it. No professional image processing skills required, just upload a photo, and one click, then AI will automatically perform high-quality image restoration and enhancement, resulting in naturally improved image.
QUICK TO GENERATE
Generating results in a short time greatly improves work efficiency, especially suitable for work scenarios that require rapid content updates. During the AI generation process, you can leave at any time or continue with a new generation. Once the results are generated, you will be notified, saving a lot of time.
FREE TRIAL
Free credits will be automatically refreshed every day. You can try it

bluejetty:00126292:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00126292:ios.description:
The Camera Tools for GoPro® Hero app controls GoPro® cameras, including settings, Protune, live preview and media download.
The app is compatible with: GoPro® Hero 3 (White/Silver/Black), Hero 4 Silver/Black Edition, GoPro® Hero 5 Black Edition, GoPro® Hero 5 Session, GoPro® Hero 6 Black Edition, GoPro® Hero 7 White/Silver/Black Edition, GoPro® Hero13 Black, Hero12 Black, Hero11 Black, Hero10 Black, Hero9 Black, and Hero8 Black, GoPro® Hero 11 Mini, Hero 2024, Lit Hero, GoPro Mission 1 Pro, GoPro® Max and Max 2 360°, and GoPro® Fusion 360° cameras.
Demo video: https://youtu.be/FpTIr1dNZF4
## Features
- Start and stop recording and tag moments on multiple cameras at the same time.
- Change camera settings (including Protune settings for cameras supporting Protune).
- Create and edit presets on Hero 8 and newer models.
- Show the live preview of one camera in full screen mode (with histogram).
- Background download media (photos, videos) from one camera (you can hide the app during the download).
- Access downloaded media with the iOS files app.
- The time lapse tool allows you to capture at specific times and intervals (screen must be active).
- Quick capturing tool.
- Control GoPro cameras with external Bluetooth keyboards: https://www.cameraremote.de/camera-tools-keyboard-shortcuts-for-controlling-gopro-cameras/
- Control GoPro cameras via Bluetooth: Hero 5 Session, Hero 5/6/7/8/9/10/11/12/13, Max, Max 2, Fusion, GoPro Mission 1 Pro.
- Control GoPro cameras via WiFi (one camera at the same time only!): Hero 3, 4 (Session/Silver/Black Edition), Hero 5 Session, Hero 5/6/7, Fusion.
- Control GoPro cameras via USB (iPad Pro only): Hero 8, 10, and 11/12/13, Max 2, GoPro Mission 1 Pro.
### Disclaimer
This product and/or service is not affiliated with, endorsed by or in any way associated with GoPro Inc. or its products and services. GoPro, HERO and their respective logos are trademarks or registered trademarks of GoPro, Inc

Sign in only to save addresses across devices, connect a do
bluejetty:00089326:ios.description:
Get a temporary email address when you open the app—no account needed to start. Use it for websites, apps, newsletters, downloads and free trials without exposing your real email.
Sign in only to save addresses across devices, connect a domain you own or get Premium.
WHY TMAILOR
• A new address anytime: tap Random to get a fresh one.
• See new mail as it arrives: messages appear without manual refresh. Turn on notifications to get an alert when new mail arrives.
• Automatic cleanup: every message is deleted 24 hours after it arrives.
• Reuse the same address: it doesn't expire on its own, so you can come back to it later.
• Save your addresses: they're kept on your phone. Sign in to keep them in your account and use them on other devices.
• Reopen the same inbox on another device: scan its QR code or open its link.
• Use a domain you own: sign in and follow the in-app guide to receive email at your own domain. Premium is not required.
• Available in 19 languages, with light and dark mode.
GOOD FOR
• Websites and apps you don't want to give your real email to
• Newsletters, downloads, e-books and coupons
• Free trials and one-time sign-ups
• Wi-Fi sign-in pages in cafes, hotels and airports
• Reducing unwanted mail and the risk of exposing your real email
PREMIUM (OPTIONAL)
The free version shows ads, including full-screen ads. Premium removes all ads, includes priority email processing and unlocks all premium domains. Premium is an auto-renewing subscription, available monthly or yearly.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase.
• The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Your Apple Account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends.
• Manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple Account settings.
• If a free trial is offered, any unused part of it ends when you buy a subscription.
GOOD TO KNOW
• Tmailor only receives email. You can't send, reply to or forward email.
• Save anything you need within 24 hours, before the message is deleted.
• If you're not signed in, your addresses are lost when you delete the app.
• Don't use a temporary address for banking, important accounts or anything you may need to recover later.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://tmailor.com/privacy-policy.html

*New characters including a family doctor, surgeon, medical professional, pregnant mom, nurse, dad, siblings and newborn baby.
*Treat patients who arrive in the hospital, deliver babies, discover the hidden lab and more!

Welcome to the ultimate Fashion Dress up & Makeup Game! Dive into a world of style and creativity. Becoming a fashion designer at major fashion events worldwide is a dream for any trendy fashion game enthusiast. This game isn't just about pretty clothes and lipstick; it's about empowering you to become a complete fashion icon.
From the house of Dreamland Games, we present you a Fashion Styler makeup game for girls developed with the help of unique super stylist fashion ideas. Are you guys ready to compete on the fashion ramp walk to prove your makeup games skills? Design and dress up your fashion supermodel, dress them up with fancy clothes suitable to the occasion.
--- FASHION STYLER | KEY FEATURES ---
Features that make Fashion Styler apart from other fashion games
► Four Unique Modes - Experience the thrill of classic makeovers, competitive challenges, memory-based puzzles, and captivating storylines
► Endless gameplay -With endless levels in Multiplayer and Puzzle Modes, there's always a new fashion challenge waiting for you
► Style Every Occasion - Variety of clothes of different fashion occasion
► Glamorous Themes - For multiple occasions like wedding, birthday parties, picnic, movie nights, job interviews, and more!
► Stylish Accessories - Handbags, glasses, sandals, jewelry and many more
--- FASHION STYLER | MODES ---
► CLASSIC MODE
In the Classic Mode, start on a journey through 20 levels where you'll immerse yourself in the art of dress up and makeup game. Follow instructions to style the model for various events like birthday parties, weddings, picnics, or movie nights. Show off your fashion game sense and attention to detail in this engaging mode.
► MULTIPLAYER MODE
Switch gears to the Multiplayer Mode for a thrilling player vs player competition. Compete endlessly with other players in fashion matches where you must dress up the model according to specific event instructions. Whether it's a birthday party, wedding, picnic, or movie night, aim to outshine your opponents and emerge as the ultimate fashionista Barbie game.
► PUZZLE MODE
Inject some excitement into your gameplay with the Puzzle Mode. Test your memory and observation skills as you are given short, timed instructions for dressing up the model. Pay close attention, solve the fashion game puzzle, and progress through endless levels while honing your styling abilities.
► STORY MODE
Experience a unique narrative in the Story Mode as you tackle 20 levels of makeover challenges based on story events. From birthday parties to weddings, picnics, movie nights, job interviews, or gym sessions, immerse yourself in diverse scenarios that will put your fashion creativity to the test.
--- More Than Just a Fashion Game - It's a Creative Playground! ---
This game isn't just about following trends - it's about unleashing your creativity and expressing your unique sense of Fashion style.
Think you have what it takes to become the ultimate fashion icon? Download Fashion Styler: Dress Up Game today and step into the exciting world of fashion, dress up, and makeup!

bluejetty:00014159:ios.name: Goodreads: Book Tracker & More
bluejetty:00014159:ios.summary: Goodreads is the free book tracker and reading community for everyone who loves books. With more than 150 million members, it is the world's largest community of readers. Keep track of everything you've read, discover your next favorite boo
bluejetty:00014159:ios.description:
Goodreads is the free book tracker and reading community for everyone who loves books. With more than 150 million members, it is the world's largest community of readers. Keep track of everything you've read, discover your next favorite book, save it to your Want to Read shelf, and update your reading progress as you go. Then share your shelves and progress with friends who love books as much as you do. Rate and review books, read honest reviews from other readers, join book club groups, and talk about the stories you can't stop thinking about.
Behind all those conversations is a book tracker that makes staying organized easy. Add a book in seconds by scanning the cover or searching by title, author, or ISBN. Add it to your Want to Read, Currently Reading, Read, or Did Not Finish (DNF) shelf, or create your own book lists for beach reads, favorite series, or the books your friends keep recommending. Want to read more this year? Set a personal goal with the Reading Challenge, adjust it anytime, and follow along as friends work toward theirs. Take on seasonal challenges and watch your reading tracker fill up as you go. When the year ends, Year in Books recaps every page you read.
Reading is better with company. Follow friends to discover what they're reading and find more books to read, rate the books you finish, and check reviews from millions of readers before you pick your next one. Join a book club through Goodreads groups to read along and share your thoughts, or recommend a favorite to a friend who needs it. You can even vote for your favorite books of the year in the Goodreads Choice Awards.
GOODREADS FEATURES
FREE BOOK TRACKER, LOG & LISTS
• Rate books with half, quarter or whole stars, share your review, and like or comment on reviews from other readers.
• Book Scanner: Scan a cover or search by title, author, or ISBN to add any book to your book tracker in seconds.
• Reading tracker: Organize your Read, Currently Reading, and Want to Read shelves, plus custom book lists for any genre or mood.
• Did Not Finish shelf: Keep track of the books you set aside, so your reading history tells the whole story.
• Update your progress by page or percentage and keep a book log of every title you finish.
• Set a yearly reading goal with the Reading Challenge and earn achievements in seasonal challenges.
• Look back on your Year in Books, a recap of every book from your reading tracker.
DISCOVER NEW BOOKS TO READ
• Get personalized recommendations based on the books you've read and loved. With millions of ratings and reviews, discover what's trending this week in your favorite genres, from romance to historical fiction, and find new books to read.
• Get ahead of the next big release with our Most Anticipated Books lists, based on what readers are adding to their Want to Read shelves, plus author interviews and featured lists.
• Use the Book Scanner at the bookstore or library to pull up ratings and reviews instantly and decide if it's your next read.
READING COMMUNITY & BOOK CLUBS
• Connect with a reading community of more than 150 million members.
• Join book club groups to start discussions and meet readers who share your taste.
• Keep up with what friends add to their shelves and how their reading goals are going.
• Recommend books to friends and vote for your favorites in the Goodreads Choice Awards.
Whether you're logging your latest read or discovering your next obsession, Goodreads is the free reading tracker made for readers like you. Join the community and start building your shelves today.
By using this app, you agree to Goodreads’s Terms of Use (https://www.goodreads.com/about/terms) and Privacy Policy (https://www.goodreads.com/about/privacy).

Unlock powerful and legendary magical brooms, grow your collection, and discover detailed information about each broom’s history and abilities.
- Player Profile:
Create your own wizard profile and track your progress.
- Broom Flight Game:
Take to the skies in an exciting broom flight game. Earn coins, improve your skills, and compete for top positions on the global leaderboards.
- AR Game:
Play an exciting AR game, collect coins, and unlock new maps featuring magical creatures.
- AR Drawing:
Create colorful AR drawings and videos by bringing your imagination to life in augmented reality.

Use the Secret Room to securely store your photos, videos, and notes.

bluejetty:00160972:ios.summary: Introducing "Hidden Camera Detector Pro+", your ultimate privacy guardian that empowers you with advanced tools to detect and neutralize threats to your personal space. Whether you're at home, staying in a hotel, or in a confidential meetin
bluejetty:00160972:ios.description:
Introducing "Hidden Camera Detector Pro+", your ultimate privacy guardian that empowers you with advanced tools to detect and neutralize threats to your personal space. Whether you're at home, staying in a hotel, or in a confidential meeting, our app provides peace of mind by ensuring your environment is free of prying eyes.
What "Hidden Camera Detector Pro+" Offers:
- Comprehensive Scanner Technology: Utilize our multifaceted scanner to identify hidden cameras, microphones, and other spy devices. Our sophisticated algorithm and user-friendly interface make it simple to scan and secure your surroundings.
- IP-Scanner Integration: Connect to any Wi-Fi network and let our IP-scanner meticulously analyze the connected devices, highlighting suspicious IPs that could belong to covert cameras.
- Bluetooth Analysis: Our app's cutting-edge Bluetooth analysis tool scans for devices that might be concealed within your vicinity. It detects unusual signals that could indicate hidden cameras linked via Bluetooth.
- Infrared Camera Detection: With our advanced detection capabilities, even the most discreet IR cameras can't escape our watchful eye. Our app is calibrated to spot the faintest red dots emitted by hidden infrared cameras.
Key Features of "Hidden Camera Detector Pro+":
- AI-Powered Detection: Harness the power of artificial intelligence to identify hidden devices with unparalleled accuracy.
- Network Scanning: Secure your network by identifying unauthorized devices that could be spying on you.
- Camera Finder: Our app doesn't just alert you to potential threats; it helps you find the exact location of hidden cameras.
- Anti Spy Detector: Stay one step ahead of spies with our app that detects and blocks attempts to compromise your privacy.
- Hacker Protection: Ensure your digital safety by preventing unauthorized access to your devices and networks.
How It Works:
1. Wi-Fi Network Analysis: Upon connecting to a Wi-Fi network, tap 'Scan' and let our app scrutinize the network for active devices, singling out any suspicious ones.
2. Bluetooth Device Mapping: Activate the Bluetooth analysis to reveal hidden devices in your vicinity.
3. Infrared Scanning: Use your camera to detect infrared signals that could indicate hidden cameras.
Safe, Secure, and Subtle:
- "Hidden Camera Detector Pro+" is designed to operate discretely, ensuring that your search for hidden devices remains confidential.
- The app provides you with exclusive guides and tips to enhance your privacy protection strategies.
User-Friendly Interface:
- Our app is designed for ease of use. With a simple tap, you can initiate a comprehensive scan of your surroundings.
- Share the app easily with friends and family via social media to help them protect their privacy too.
Reliable and Trustworthy:
- Trust in our app's accuracy and reliability when it comes to detecting hidden devices.
- With a database of camera signatures, our app can detect a wide range of spy devices, from the common to the highly sophisticated.
About Subscription:
Subscription Services: Weekly subscription, Monthly subscription, Yearly subscription.
Subscription Price: Weekly subscription is $4.9 /week, Monthly subscription is $9.9/month, Yearly Subscription is $18.9/year.
Payment: Payment will be deducted from user's iTunes account, upon confirmation of purchase by user.
Renewal: iTunes account will be charged 24 hours before expiration, after successful charge, the subscription period will be extended by 1 cycle.
Cancellation: To cancel subscription, please operate at least 24 hours before the end of current cycle. Go to [Settings] > [iTunes Store and App Store] > [Apple ID] > [Subscriptions], and cancel subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://camera-detector.netlify.app/camera/privacy
Terms of Service: https://camera-detector.netlify.app/camera/terms

bluejetty:00134522:ios.description:
Paragon Pioneers is a city-building idle game in which you discover, conquer and then build on islands to fulfill the needs of your inhabitants. Even with limited time to play you can enjoy this deep simulation game and follow one of the countless ways to optimize your empire. Build an impressive palace and go down in history as Paragon's most successful leader.
This is the full version of Paragon Pioneers. The lite version is available here: https://apps.apple.com/app/paragon-pioneers-lite/id1622824091
» What can I expect? «
BUILD your empire stone by stone: construct over 100 different buildings to meet all the needs of your inhabitants.
PRODUCE more than 70 goods with complex production chains.
DISCOVER more islands for your ever-growing empire: build a big fleet, send it across the sea and widen your realm step by step.
CONQUER newly discovered islands from the orcs with an intuitive and multifaceted combat system.
RELAX as your empire stays active even when you're not playing.
IMMERSE yourself in a stylized and cute medieval/fantasy setting without the bother of ads, in-app purchases or even the need to be online.
SHAPE every island in the game with a unique island generator to suit your needs.
ENJOY this game again and again by selecting a special custodian at the end that offers powerful skills for your next empires.
» Get in touch! «
Join the community on Discord: https://discord.gg/pRuGbCDWCP
Send me an email: tobias@paragonpioneers.com
» Thank you for playing Paragon Pioneers! «
With my passion project Paragon Pioneers I’m following my dream of being a game developer. After working for nearly two years on it now, it makes me really happy when it brings joy to other people. So please feel free to get in touch and tell me how you experienced my game :)
- Tobias

Introduction
Welcome to our Mannic app! Before you start using the app, please take a moment to read this document. It contains essential information about the app's purpose, functionalities, and usage guidelines.
-------Important Information-------
Purpose of the App: The app you are using isn't for streaming movies, animes, or TV shows. It serves as a comprehensive tracker, allowing you to keep tabs on your favorite movies, animes, and TV shows.
Data Source: This app utilizes the The Movie Database (TMDb) library to display posters, titles, cast, crews, and some trailers. We are grateful for their extensive database, which enhances your experience within our app.
Usage Guidelines:
The app has the right to display posters, titles, cast, crews, and some video trailers sourced from TMDb.
For detailed information about content rights and terms of use, please refer to the "Content Rights & Terms of Use" section in your profile settings within the app.
Features
-- Track Your Favorites: Keep track of movies, animes, and TV shows you want to watch or have watched.
-- Explore: Discover a vast collection of movies, animes, and TV shows with detailed information.
-- Trailers: Watch trailers to get a sneak peek before deciding what to watch.
-- Cast and Crew: Learn about the talented individuals behind your favorite movies, animes, and TV shows.
-- Personalized Recommendations: Receive tailored recommendations based on your viewing history and preferences.
-- Quotes: Dive into a world of wisdom and inspiration with our Quote App,
-- Customize your app them dark light mode.
-- Customize your avatar: Dive into a world of endless possibilities with our Avatar Generator App, crafting over 12 billion unique avatars to express your individuality and creativity in every virtual realm.
Feel free to contact us if you have question.

CLASS ACTION SETTLEMENTS
PayMe's AI scans 5,000+ active class action settlements and matches you with claims you're eligible for - automatically. No legal knowledge required. See a match, tap to claim, and track your payout in real time. Users have already claimed millions through PayMe. Companies overcharged you. It's time to collect.

Your cable, internet, phone, and insurance bills are almost certainly too high. PayMe connects you with expert negotiators (powered by Billshark) who call your providers and fight for lower rates. Average savings: $300+ per year. You don't lift a finger - we handle everything.
UNCLAIMED PROPERTY SEARCH
Search all 50 states for forgotten money that's legally yours. Old bank accounts, uncashed insurance payouts, forgotten tax refunds, utility deposits - billions sit in state treasuries waiting to be claimed. PayMe's dedicated Unclaimed tab makes searching instant.
MASS TORT & PERSONAL INJURY
Beyond class actions, PayMe checks your eligibility for major mass tort and personal injury lawsuits. These cases can result in significantly larger payouts. Get matched with qualified attorneys - no upfront cost to you.
GMAIL BILL SCANNING
Connect your Gmail and let PayMe automatically detect overcharges, duplicate fees, rate hikes, and billing errors hiding in your inbox. Most people are overpaying and don't even know it.
GIFT CARD RECOVERY
Got old gift cards collecting dust? PayMe helps you recover balances from forgotten, expired, or retailer-liquidation gift cards. Money you thought was gone - recovered.
SUBSCRIPTION MANAGEMENT
See every active subscription in one place. Spot forgotten free trials before they charge you. Identify services you're paying for but never use. The average American wastes $200+/year on forgotten subscriptions.
TAX CREDIT CHECK
Millions of Americans qualify for the Earned Income Tax Credit but never claim it. PayMe's quick eligibility check tells you in seconds if you're leaving money on the table at tax time.
WHY PAYME?
• 8 money-finding tools in one app
• AI-powered claim matching
• Expert bill negotiators on your side
• All 50 states covered for unclaimed property
• 5,000+ active settlements tracked
• Real-time claim and payout tracking
• Rated 4.8 by 34,000+ users
• No legal expertise needed - ever
PayMe isn't just a class action app. It's the only app that finds every dollar you're owed - from lawsuit settlements and forgotten property to overpriced bills and unused gift cards.

bluejetty:00153955:ios.description:
Block Puzzle: Texture Blast brings a fresh upgrade to the classic block puzzle experience. A variety of rich textures — wood, gems, glass, and more — make every move feel uniquely satisfying. Simple and calming, it’s the perfect way to relax and enjoy a quiet moment anytime.
Whether you want to kill time or challenge your high score, this game plays at your pace — no timers, no pressure, just clear puzzle and satisfying block style.
What makes it different?
Clean visual style with textured puzzle blocks
The board stays uncluttered while each block feels distinct. The subtle textures bring a tactile feel that makes every move more satisfying.
Responsive, smooth controls
Drag, drop, and place with precision. The gameplay flow is simple and snappy — exactly what you want in a relaxing puzzle game.
Built for focus
This is a block puzzle game without countdowns, pop-ups, or distractions — just a clear board and your next move.
Play anywhere, anytime
As a truly portable block puzzle game, it’s ready whenever you are — no Wi-Fi, no sign-in, just pick it up and play offline at your own pace.
How to play:
Drag blocks onto the 8x8 board in this relaxing puzzle game.
Fill rows or columns completely to clear them and score.
The game ends when there’s no more room to place new blocks.
Plan ahead — space management is the key to high scores.
Block Puzzle: Texture Blast keeps things simple, requiring you to making small decisions, clearing space, and chasing that next higher score. Whether you're new to block puzzle game or a longtime fan, it’s designed to be easy to pick up and fun to return to again and again.
No stress, no rush — just a clear, focused block puzzle game that fits into your day. Start playing and see how far you can go.

The KB Klíč app verifies your identity and safely logs you into MojeBanka online banking and Komerční banka's other online apps. You don't have to enter a texted code and you also authorise payments through the app.
You need the following
bluejetty:00014357:ios.description:
The KB Klíč app verifies your identity and safely logs you into MojeBanka online banking and Komerční banka's other online apps. You don't have to enter a texted code and you also authorise payments through the app.
You need the following for KB Klíč activation:
- KB ID, which you will find in the Electronic Signature Agreement. You can also use your username/email
- An activation code that you will receive at a KB branch or when you log into mujprofil.kb.cz otherwise than via KB Klíč
The activation guide is available at https://www.kb.cz/en/faq-and-support/how-to-sign-in
Set the PIN on the occasion of activation. You can set up your fingerprint if your phone supports them. Komerční banka will never see your fingerprints; they are retained in a secure repository in the phone.
If your phone is connected to the internet the request to confirm the activation will be received automatically in your phone. Check and confirm the request. If offline, select 'The device is not connected to the internet' option in your computer. Using the KB Klíč app, scan the pictorial code from the computer's screen. Then confirm the code by the PIN or fingerprint. Finally, type the generated code in your computer.
Please note: If you enter an incorrect PIN five times KB Klíč blocks access. You will then activate the apps using an activation code that you will receive in an ATM, at a KB branch or after logging into mujprofil.kb.cz otherwise than via KB Klíč.
KB Klíč will not work for you if you have reinstalled software on your phone and your platform (root) is therefore not protected. All of this for the sake of security.

⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯
What is Migiri?
⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯
Migiri is the go-to app for those seeking to overcome adult content addiction using proven clinical techniques. Backed by experts, it provides personalized tools and resources tailored to your needs.
⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯
Features & Benefits
⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯
◉ Smart Adult Content Blocker with Anti-Tampering
Migiri’s adult content blocker prevents access to explicit websites, even in private mode. Its customizable app blocker also lets you restrict websites and apps of your choice. Anti-tampering mechanisms keep your settings intact, providing consistent protection and peace of mind.
◉ Kanjo: Your Interactive Companion
Use Kanjo to check in daily, share your thoughts, stay accountable, and receive tips and encouragement. It’s like having a trusted friend to guide and support you every step of the way.
◉ Inspiring Milestones
Achieving long-term goals is easier when broken into smaller, manageable steps. Migiri’s challenges motivate you to stay on track, and the app celebrates your progress as you conquer each milestone.
◉ Healthy Habits
Migiri offers Daily Exercises, including guided meditations designed by clinical psychologists and approachable workouts created by fitness experts, to reduce stress and improve overall well-being.
◉ Personalized Courses for Tailored Support
Whether you’re celebrating abstinence or working through a relapse, Migiri provides specialized courses designed by clinical psychologists to guide you through every phase of your journey.
◉ Companion Support
Select someone you trust to support you. Migiri notifies your chosen companion when you face challenges or reach milestones, ensuring you have encouragement when it matters most.
◉ Therapy Sessions
Dive deeper into the root causes of your addiction with optional remote sessions. Work with licensed therapists specializing in adult content addiction to identify triggers, manage stressors, and develop coping strategies.
⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯
Privacy and Security First
⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯
You can sign up anonymously and we never sell or share your data. All your information remains secure and confidential.
⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯
Pricing
⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯
Migiri offers a free trial so you can explore its features and see how it supports you. After the trial, a subscription is required to continue using the app. You can cancel anytime through your device settings.
Optional one-on-one sessions with licensed therapists are available at an affordable price and are not included in the app subscription. These sessions offer personalized support to enhance recovery and address individual challenges. Therapy sessions can be canceled anytime through the app.
Migiri aims to provide the tools and resources you need to succeed, with no pressure and easy cancellation.
⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯
What Makes Migiri Unique?
⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯
◉ More Than Blocking: Migiri combines an adult content blocker with a customizable app blocker, then goes further with personalized exercises, expert-designed courses, accountability tools, and professional support to help you build lasting, healthier habits.
◉ Better Accountability: Migiri celebrates your successes with your companion, offering support not only when things go wrong but also when you achieve milestones.
◉ Affordable Therapy: Get expert-backed resources and therapy at a price that makes sense.
◉ Proven Success: After 30 days of using Migiri, 91% of users reported significant improvement in managing their adult content addiction (2023 Market Research).
◉ We’re Here for You: We’re here to help you every step of the way. If you need guidance or have questions, contact us anytime through the app’s support section or at help@migiri.app.

bluejetty:00027550:ios.description:
BODYCLOCK AI: YOUR PERSONALIZED DAY, OPTIMIZED
What if your calendar could help you lose weight, sleep deeper, focus faster, move more, and feel better every day?
Meet your personal AI tool for a healthier life. BodyClock AI uses the science of your circadian rhythm—your body clock—and cutting-edge AI to build a personalized 24-hour plan just for you. We transform your schedule into a visual blueprint for your most productive, balanced day. It’s not just a planner; it’s a guide to feeling your best and achieving more.
---------------------------------------------
FREE FEATURES YOU’LL LOVE
BodyClock AI is free to download and use. Visualize your day, prioritize wellness, and share your routines with others. Connect Apple Health to track your results and compare planned versus actual activities. Stay focused on-the-go with Apple Watch, or prop your iPad on your desk as a smart clock.
Included for all users:
• My Clock: See your 24 hours at a glance. Solve time blindness with a 360° circular view of your day.
• My Goals: Stay motivated with long-term goals. Craft a vision board season-by-season.
• My Moai: Build a peer support group, share progress, and inspire those you love on their wellness journeys.
---------------------------------------------
UPGRADE TO PLUS
Go beyond planning with BodyClock AI Plus, our premium subscription that provides daily, AI-powered recommendations personalized to your goals.
Your personalized AI coach for:
• Deep Sleep: Get daily insights for optimal bedtime and rest.
• Deep Work: Discover your peak focus windows for maximum productivity.
• Peak Fitness: Pinpoint the best time to exercise for better results.
• Eating Windows: Receive personalized recommendations for fueling your body.
With Plus, there are no limits:
• Custom Categories: Set up your own categories, colors, and themes.
• Unlimited Day Plans: Create unlimited Day Plans for each day of the week. 
• Unlimited Goals: Make as many goals as you need for every season. 
---------------------------------------------
HEAR FROM OUR COMMUNITY

“It’s not just about health—it’s also about productivity and relationships. We all have 24 hours, and BodyClock AI helps me make the most of them.” — Khadevis R., 8X USA National Track & Field Champion

READ ENGLISH AT YOUR LEVEL
bluejetty:00039651:ios.description:
Learn English with what you actually enjoy reading and watching: books, stories, news and real videos. Bookvo turns every text into a lesson — tap any word, understand it instantly and save it to practice later.
READ ENGLISH AT YOUR LEVEL
- Books, short stories and classic novels sorted by level, from A1 to C2
- Fresh news and articles to practice everyday English
- Personalized recommendations based on your level and interests
- Import your own books and read them with every Bookvo tool
TRANSLATE WITH ONE TAP
- Tap a word or phrase to see its translation, meaning and pronunciation
- Ask AI to explain sentences, idioms and grammar with examples
LISTEN AND READ AT THE SAME TIME
- Audio synced with the text to improve your listening and pronunciation
- Listen to full books as audiobooks while you follow along
LEARN FROM VIDEOS
- Interactive subtitles: tap words, replay lines, translate or simplify them
- Minimize the video and keep studying with the transcript
SAVE AND REVIEW YOUR VOCABULARY
- All your saved words in one place, from books and videos
- Games to lock them in: flashcards, fill the gap, word builder, listening and translation drills
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
- Daily goal, streaks and stats for reading, study time and words learned
- Build a daily English reading habit
BOOKVO PREMIUM
Premium unlocks the full library, unlimited learning time and all AI features. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://bookvo.app/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://bookvo.app/terms-of-use.html

bluejetty:00015832:ios.summary:
Locate, listen, explore and enjoy the artworks of the Uffizi Gallery.

Essential and immediate, the app that will guide you during your visit without diverting your attention
bluejetty:00015832:ios.description:
Locate, listen, explore and enjoy the artworks of the Uffizi Gallery.
Forget traditional audio guides. All you need is in your pocket. 
Essential and immediate, the app that will guide you during your visit without diverting your attention from the artworks.
40 of the most beautiful and important artworks of the Uffizi Gallery, description and audios.
Easy and smart access to info
Discover artworks through the exploration page and find them grouped by position or artist.
Use textual research to find them typing the title or artist name.
Add artworks to your favorite collection to find them quickly and to share them with your friends.
Image, Audio, Details
Wear headphones or bring your phone to your ear and let yourself be guided by narrations.
Look at the images or discover the details of the artworks to better appreciate them.
Image recognition
Recognize artworks by framing them with your camera. 
If they are in the app, you'll be able to immediately access the corresponding information.
Interactive maps
Check the position of artworks to better move around and locate yourself.
Find rooms and artworks and explore each detail.
Accessible
Art belongs to everyone. Accessibility is one of the issues we most cherish. 
This app can be used the same way by sighted people and people with visual impairments: nobody shall be left behind!
...and now...download it and simply enjoy your tour...
PS: if you have dubts or suggestions contact us at support@itcares.it

bluejetty:00016935:ios.description:
*Students who subscribe can access the entire library for auditions and rehearsals.
*Professional vocalists can see if audition cuts for the most recent National Tours and Broadway Shows have been recorded.
*Singing teachers who subscribe can stream the entire song before they decide if it's a good fit for their students and download it as an Mp3 on their computer hard drive.
*Schools and theaters can find entire shows for rehearsals and/or performances.
Features:
•Purchase and download individual tracks.
•Change key and tempo.
•Browse by category or search individual titles or shows.
•Create multiple playlists.
•Add pins to mark the spots you rehearse most, see each pin's time at a glance, and jump between them with a location slider.

Tap Knight is a mobile idle/clicker game that brings together your favorite elements from many genres. Featuring immer
bluejetty:00077023:ios.description:
Tap Knight proudly features NO ADS and IN-APP-PURCHASES. Ever.
*iOS 12.5.5 on older iPad Airs might not work properly.*
Tap Knight is a mobile idle/clicker game that brings together your favorite elements from many genres. Featuring immersive level structures, a skill tree to master, and of course, idle experience collection.
With ten unique worlds to explore, increasingly difficult boss fights, and new allies to discover and train, there is always something to keep you “tapping” while finding your own way to play and master the game. 
Stuck in a level? No Problem! In true “Idle” fashion, Tap Knight collects experience while the app is closed. Each time you will open the game stronger and better prepared for the adventure ahead. 
Help defend the lost kingdom from the evil monsters that have banded together to destroy humanity. Fight alongside Tap Knight, he cannot do it without your help!
Game features: 
- 200 levels & 10 bosses 
- 20 skills to choose from 
- Skill tree to fit your own play style 
- Idle experience collection 
- 19 original music tracks by AURON SILVERBURGH 
- Bestiary & in-game lore 
- Ollie The Giant Pup 
- 10 Themed cosmetic skins
Tap Knight is brought to you by a 2-person team of enthusiastic brothers who couldn’t find the Idle Game they were looking for on the App Store, and decided to make it themselves instead. We hope you enjoy the game as much as we enjoyed making it.

bluejetty:00033749:ios.description:
Turn your living room into a thrilling fitness playground with Kids Workout at Home! 
Why settle for boring activities when fitness can be so much fun with kids' workouts? 
Customize your workout buddy, personalize your workout spot, and stay consistent with daily exercise to build a streak and enjoy the process! 
7-Minute Easy, Fun Indoor Workouts for Children & Toddlers: Better Sporty Active Mornings for All Kids
Fun Kids Workout to Keep Them Active
Kids Workout at Home is the world's first fun and interactive kids workout and fitness app designed for all kids!
Tailored Kids Workout: Fun fitness games are designed for toddlers and children, ensuring they are appropriate and safe.
Variety of Exercises: From basic movements to more challenging tasks, there’s something for every young athlete! Kids Workout at Home offers exciting 5-minute exercises, 7-minute exercises, and 10-minute exercises to keep your little ones active and entertained.
Non-Stop Fun Zone: With a vibrant, adventurous theme and many surprises, fitness becomes a thrilling adventure even for children!
No Gear, No Problem: Jump into fitness anytime, anywhere! Our body weight exercises mean no special equipment is needed. Perfect for a spontaneous kids workout at home!
Kids Workout Categories
Kids Workout at Home is where your little ones can jump, stretch, and giggle for better health. Our kid-friendly exercise guide is specially designed to make fitness fun and foundational. 
Basic Kids Workout: Get started with simple, foundational exercises perfect for beginners. It’s like the ABCs but for muscles and fun!
Daily Personalized Workouts: Every day brings a new adventure… and a personalized workout tailored to keep pace with your child’s growing skills and giggles.
Cardio Exercises: Increase heart rate and endurance with fun cardio routines. Watch your kiddos' energy soar with heart-pumping, joy-jumping cardio routines that make exercise feel like a playmate with speed!
Strength Training: Build muscle and strength through kid-friendly exercises.
Balance and Coordination: Improve overall stability and coordination with targeted movements. It's a wobble party where every little step improves their stability and coordination.
Stretching Routines: Essential stretches to keep those growing bodies agile and injury-free. Think of it as yoga but with a lot more wiggling.
Fun Exercises: Fitness is the game, and these playful exercises are the power-ups, turning every workout into a laugh-filled quest of discovery!
Kids Workout App is designed with flexibility in mind. It offers three difficulty levels: light, medium, and hard, which align perfectly with your child’s fitness level and goals. 
Fantastic Streak System for Super Kids
Each day you keep up with your kid's workout, you'll add another shiny star to your streak. Can you imagine the excitement of reaching 10 days, 20 days, or even 100 days in a row? 
# Kids Workout & Fitness PREMIUM PRICING & TERMS
Kids Workout & Fitness offers the following subscriptions:
• 1 week: $9.99
• 1 year: $39.99
These prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on your country of residence. Your Kids Workout & Fitness Premium subscription will be charged through your iTunes account.
At the end of the term, your subscription will automatically renew through your iTunes account.
You will be charged for the regular price of your subscription within 24 hours prior to the end of the current term.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.

bluejetty:00120977:ios.description:
Bridge Baron: Master the Game of Bridge
Bridge Baron Gold offers a comprehensive and immersive bridge playing experience, perfect for players looking to sharpen their skills, challenge AI opponents, or relive historic tournament victories.
Why Bridge Baron Gold?
With AI-powered gameplay, you can test your skills against sophisticated AI opponents and customize their difficulty to match your skill level, whether you’re a beginner or an advanced player. The game also allows you to step into the shoes of the pros by replaying famous tournaments and comparing your results, providing a unique way to learn and improve.
Flexible game management ensures that you can save your progress effortlessly, allowing you to start fresh or pick up right where you left off. This feature makes it easy to fit bridge practice into your schedule, no matter how busy you are. The in-depth practice tools, including the option to view all cards face-up, help you practice and perfect your strategies for tough deals, making sure you are always ready for any challenge.
For enhanced learning, Bridge Baron Gold offers vocal bidding hints and the ‘i’ button for on-demand guidance on conventions and signals. This feature is particularly helpful for players looking to deepen their understanding of the game and improve their bidding strategies.
The customizable experience allows you to choose the winning hand, control the type of contracts, and dive into different bidding conventions across basic, intermediate, and advanced levels. You can also tailor your and your opponents’ signaling arrangements for a personalized bridge experience, making the game truly your own.
Subscription Benefits:
Bridge Baron Gold offers a monthly subscription for only $4.99 in the US (prices may vary for other currencies). Enjoy uninterrupted access with easy subscription management and auto-renewal options directly from your App Store account settings. You can stop the renewal of your subscription at any time via your iTunes account, just make sure to do so at least 24 hours before your subscription expires to avoid unwanted renewal. Please note that no unused subscription period will be refunded.
Stay informed by reading our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy on our website: bridgebaron.com. For any feedback or support, contact us at help@greatgameproducts.com.

bluejetty:00042375:ios.description:
Feel stronger, supported, and more confident through every stage of motherhood.
FitMama is a pregnancy and postpartum fitness app designed to help you move safely, reduce pain, and build strength with short, guided home workouts tailored to your body, stage, and symptoms.
Move Better During Pregnancy:
Stay active with safe, effective prenatal workouts designed for every trimester. Relieve common pregnancy discomforts like back pain, tight hips, and poor sleep while building strength, mobility, and stability to support your changing body. From prenatal pilates and strength training to gentle mobility, every workout is designed to help you feel better now and more prepared for labor.
Recover and Rebuild After Birth:
Ease back into movement with structured postpartum recovery. Reconnect with your core and pelvic floor, safely rebuild strength, and support healing from diastasis recti or C-section recovery. Progress at your own pace with guided workouts that help you feel stronger, more stable, and confident in your body again.
Short, Effective Home Workouts
Get results in just 7–20 minutes:
Fit workouts into your day with simple, guided routines you can do at home, no equipment needed. Whether you need a quick stretch, strength session, or full workout, everything is designed to be efficient and easy to follow.
A Plan That Adapts to You:
Personalized fitness for your body, stage, and goals. Your workouts adjust based on your pregnancy stage, postpartum recovery, and symptoms so you always know what’s safe and effective. Build consistency with a plan that evolves as your body changes.
Simple Nutrition That Supports You:
Feel better with recipes designed for pregnancy and postpartum. Access quick, practical meals to help manage nausea, support lactation, boost energy, and stay nourished during busy days. From freezer-friendly meals to easy snacks, everything is designed to support your body without adding stress.
Thousands of women use FitMama to:
- Reduce back, hip, and pelvic pain during pregnancy
- Prepare their body for labor with strength and mobility
- Rebuild core and pelvic floor strength postpartum
- Return to exercise safely and confidently
- Stay consistent with simple, effective home workouts
- Stay nourished with easy, supportive recipes
Download FitMama and start moving in a way that supports your body, every step of the way.
Privacy Policy: https://fitmama.app/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://fitmama.app/terms-of-services

bluejetty:00100155:ios.description:
ShiftLink connects frontline teams with shift opportunities in real time—making scheduling fast, easy, and equitable. Join thousands of professionals who’ve simplified their work-life balance while helping their organizations stay fully staffed.
Key Features:
• Real Time Shift Notifications
• Custom Responses like Partial Shifts
• AI-Powered Scheduling Tools with Calendar View
• Rapid Alert for Emergency Situations
• Broadcast Messaging to All Staff
• Multi-Employer & Multi-Location Support
• Purpose-Built for Healthcare & Social Services
Free for all staff members. Download ShiftLink today and take control of your schedule.
What's New in Version 4.0
• Performance improvements: Faster startup and smoother navigation
• Stability: Advanced error handling and fewer disruptions
• Design: Fresh new interface, dark mode, and accessibility enhancements
• Notifications: Smarter push alerts, full history with search and filters
• Security: Stronger encryption, biometric authentication, and auto-updates
• Fixes: Time zone accuracy, improved shift workflows, and bug resolutions
Why ShiftLink?
• Save up to 75% of the time usually spent calling staff
• Over 40,000 users across healthcare teams and organizations
• Over 300 million shift notifications sent
• Designed with real-world feedback from frontline healthcare leaders
Use Cases:
• Hospitals & Clinics
• Unionized Healthcare Environments
• High-Skilled Labour Scheduling (specialized roles, regulated staff)
• Government-Funded Shelters & Social Services
• Environmental Services Teams
• Nursing & Medical Staff Coordination
About ShiftLink
For 8 years and counting, ShiftLink has been helping healthcare organizations take the pain out of scheduling.
Built by people who know the challenges firsthand, ShiftLink goes beyond automation. It delivers a smarter, fairer, and more transparent way to manage shifts.
The results speak for themselves: organizations save time, staff feel supported and empowered, and patient care stays consistent.
Download ShiftLinkApp today and see how smarter scheduling makes all the difference.

bluejetty:00117678:ios.description:
Discover the ultimate platform to buy and sell new and used construction equipment, heavy machinery, industrial tools, parts, and attachments. Whether you’re a buyer, a private seller, or a dealer, the Machinery Trader app makes connecting with buyers and sellers in the construction and other equipment-heavy industries fast, easy, and secure.
EXPLORE THOUSANDS OF HEAVY EQUIPMENT LISTINGS WITH PERSONALIZED SEARCH
Browse thousands of listings for excavators, wheel loaders, dozers, forklifts, skid steers, telehandlers, backhoes, aerial lifts, motor graders, off-highway trucks, and so much more. Plus, attachments and parts to keep your business running.
Once you’ve narrowed the search, dive into detailed photos and videos of your desired equipment and its specifications. Contact sellers directly to get the best price, and explore your financing and shipping options offered by trusted MachineryTrader partners, CurrencyFinance and FR8Star. 
The Machinery Trader app features convenient search tools that allow you to filter listings by category, make, model, location, condition, and various other specs, from horsepower to hours used, to find what you need fast. 
EASILY TRACK EQUIPMENT YOU ARE INTERESTED IN BUYING
Create a private Watch List to save your favorite equipment, or post a “Want-to-Buy” ad to allow sellers to reach out to you. Receive new listings and weekly updates tailored to your interests via email, and you can also monitor category pages, which are updated daily with new equipment. 
CONSIGN YOUR INVENTORY FAST
If you are a dealership representative or an independent seller, Machinery Trader is happy to provide you with access to thousands of qualified buyers shopping for new and used heavy equipment, tools, and attachments.
Consign your inventory with Machinery Trader to reach a global audience. Click the "My Inventory" button in your Machinery Trader app and get transferred to the Sandhills Inventory Management app, your trusted, easy, and cost-effective way to track and manage inventory. Add listings, set prices, upload photos and videos, edit descriptions, and update your listings on the go-right from your iOS device.
CHOOSE THE MACHINERY TRADER APP FOR ALL YOUR HEAVY-DUTY NEEDS
Whether you are upgrading your fleet or selling heavy equipment, Machinery Trader provides you with access to a comprehensive range of construction tools, industrial machinery, and heavy equipment and a large buyer audience.
As part of Sandhills Global, Machinery Trader connects you to a network that includes Truck Paper, TractorHouse, NeedTurfEquipment, LiftsToday, CraneTrader, AuctionTime, and other prominent brands within the Sandhills portfolio. You can access a live database of heavy equipment, commercial trucks, trailers, and other machinery for sale from trusted manufacturers such as Caterpillar, John Deere, Bobcat, Komatsu, Volvo, and more.
GET THE MACHINERY TRADER APP NOW
Thousands of construction companies, independent buyers, dealerships, small equipment shops, and individual sellers trust Machinery Trader to manage their operations. Download the app now to receive the best service tailored to your needs.
