bluejetty:00070544:ios.description:
FastEasy - YOUR PROFESSIONAL FASTING ASSISTANT
Tired of dieting endlessly without results? Want to lose weight without harming your health? Then our intermittent fasting app can help you. Join the millions of people who have already discovered the power of this practice and start your fasting journey today!
What is intermittent fasting? This is an eating pattern where you cycle between periods of eating and fasting. At the same time, you can enjoy your favorite foods and:
► lose weight
► improve heart health
► boost metabolism
► improve insulin resistance and more
With FASTEASY you'll get:
► EFFICIENT FASTING PLANS
Start your first fast with a ready-to-follow fasting plan. Choose the most suitable plan depending on your age, body type, and goals, the most popular of which are:
 • 14:10 plan - for those who are just beginning their fasting journey
 • 16:8 plan - the most followed plan, beloved by millions around the world
 • 18:6 plan - a fasting protocol to challenge yourself
 • 23:1 or OMAD (one meal a day) plan - for more hardcore fasters
 • custom fasts based on your individual rhythm
► FASTING TIMER
Сustomize your fast and feast times with one click! With our handy reminders and useful tips, you’ll stay motivated and on track.
You can also track all the key stages of your fasting journey and understand what is happening to your body while you are fasting.
► WATER TRACKER
The water tracker will encourage you to drink enough water throughout the day and help you keep track of your hydration levels.
► WEIGHT LOSS STATISTICS
Track your fasting and weight statistics with a visualization of your progress for the current day. A calendar with navigation for the previous days will provide you with a complete picture of your fasting experience.
► PERSONAL RECIPES
Personal recipes are the perfect way to tailor your meals to your specific dietary needs and taste preferences. With our AI-powered customization, it's never been easier to cook tasty, healthy dishes. Try it out today and start enjoying personalized, delicious meals.
► HELPFUL INSIGHTS TO YOUR HEALTH
Get more out of intermittent fasting, your body cleanse, and your health with useful tips and insights.
HEALTHKIT:
FastEasy integrates with HealthKit, so you can export your weight and activity data from FastEasy to HealthKit.
SUBSCRIPTION INFO:
You can download the app for free. Further use requires a subscription. Please note that:
• When opting for a subscription, you pay the fixed price for your country, which is displayed in the app.
• Payment will be charged to your Apple ID Account upon confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews and your free trial automatically converts into a subscription unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Your Account will be charged for renewal within the 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period.
• You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
• When canceling a subscription or a free trial, your subscription/free trial will stay active until the end of the current period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded.

bluejetty:00185217:ios.description:
Imagine this: you wake up, feed your beloved kitty, and then — all hell breaks loose! Where did Mr. Fluffy go and what is... is that an armored turkey? Does it have anything to do with these... unicorns? Uh, what's going here? Well you’re gonna find out in this adventurous new entry in the gun shooting games genre. Mad GunS comes from the school of online shooters that have strange, cute, pixel art. 
Mad GunS is not like regular online FPS, or other gun shooting games that haven’t surprised you very much. No, this online shooter won’t teach you any new tactics or make endlessly fiddle with your gun settings. Just get out there and shoot your rivals with a banana gun, or a hamster thrower, or slap them with a handbag! Break into the shooting games online arena and crush everything in the wackiest new shooter games free! 
So, this is what Mad GunS — new guns game online is about:
- Far from realistic, but SUPER beautiful pixel art! 
- The most incredibly weird guns - beat your rivals with a handbag with a dog in it, a huge lollipop or a magic wand. Or just shoot them with… cat fur! 
- Enemies from the best of gun games, shooter games and online FPS games, including zombies, crazy chickens and even a mad octopus! 
- Plus! Mad GunS is the first of the online gun shooting games in which you can see your feet!

 Begin combo with special card to earn more points with combo.
Enjoy yourselves !!

bluejetty:00158273:ios.description:
Welcome to Wizard Tower: Idle TD, the ultimate tower defense adventure where you, as a powerful wizard, stand as the guardian of your castle against relentless waves of monstrous invaders. Harness the ancient arts of magic and strategy to protect your realm from chaos and destruction.
Engage in epic battles with intuitive spell-casting mechanics, as you unleash a diverse array of magical abilities to vanquish your foes. From scorching fireballs to freezing ice blasts, electrifying thunder strikes to swift katana slashes, each spell offers a unique method of deployment, allowing you to adapt your strategy to the ever-shifting threats that besiege your stronghold.
Strategize wisely and fortify your defenses to withstand the relentless assaults of the enemy horde. Upgrade your spells and fortifications to unleash devastating power and maintain your guard against increasingly ferocious attacks. Explore enchanted forests, forbidding wastelands, and other treacherous terrains, each presenting its own set of challenges and opportunities for mastery.
With captivating visuals, immersive gameplay, and addictive tower defense action, Wizard Tower: Idle TD promises hours of thrilling adventure for players of all skill levels. Whether you're a seasoned strategist or a casual gamer, embark on an epic quest to defend your kingdom from darkness and emerge victorious against the forces of evil.
Join the ranks of legendary wizards, forge alliances with powerful allies, and become the ultimate guardian of the realm. Will you rise to the challenge and safeguard your people, or will your castle fall to ruin under the relentless assault of the enemy? The fate of the kingdom rests in your hands. Enter the world of Wizard Tower: Idle TD and unleash the full power of magic to secure victory against all odds!

bluejetty:00144205:ios.description:
ROZETKA — your favorite online store always at your fingertips!
Update your wardrobe and closet, shop for the latest electronic gadgets, take care of your pets, or choose gifts for loved ones & family — all in one convenient Rozetka app. We've gathered a mobile market with millions of products across various categories to make your shopping experience enjoyable, fast, and affordable.
Why download the Rozetka app?
Wide range of products
We have it all: stylish outfit, original shoes, bags, perfect backpacks, modern electronic gadgets, cosmetics, gaming accessories, good books, home goods, children's toys, pet supplies, makeup, TVs, furniture, and even sports equipment. Rozetka is a tech store, clothing store, cosmetics shop, and much more — all combined in one place. Our assortment is constantly updated to meet your needs.
Speed and convenience
Digital shopping has never been easier! We’ve created a convenient internet marketplace with a catalog and filter to help you quickly search & find the items you need. Place orders using your phone or tablet, choose a delivery method, and receive your purchases in no time. Shipping and delivery to Rozetka stores is free. Our delivery zone covers all of Ukraine, including Kyiv city, Kharkiv city, Odesa town, Lviv town, and other cities. Making quick orders has never been simpler!
Great deals
Dreaming of the best prices? Rozetka regularly holds promotions, discounts, and sales on top product categories like home appliances, trendy clothing, workout gear, perfumes, cosmetics, TVs, a vast selection of toys, household items, and more. We also offer installment plans and credit options from leading banks. Download the app to be the first to know about our special offers and earn bonus for order and writing review!
Reviews and smart recommendations
Can’t decide? Trust our users! Read customer reviews from those who’ve already purchased the product to learn all the pros and cons and make the right choice. Additionally, you can create wish lists, add products, and share them with friends and family.
Always at your fingertips
No more wasting time in lines or traveling to the mall or hypermarket. Rozetka offers convenient online shopping anytime, anywhere. Need a new phone or laptop for work, a TV for your home, a gift for a loved one, or comfortable clothes for walks? Order from anywhere in Ukraine, we’ll ensure express delivery and track packages and parcels with ease. For bulky items, our courier service has you covered.
Easy Product Comparison
Can’t decide between multiple options? In the Rozetka app, you can compare products by features, price, reviews, and ratings. Add items to the comparison list to view all important parameters in one place. This helps you quickly make informed decisions and find the best option for your needs.
Rozetka Trade-In: upgrade your gadgets with profitably
With the ROZETKA Trade-In service, you can trade in your old gadget and receive a certificate for its appraised value. This certificate can be used to purchase new electronic gadgets or any items marked "Sold by ROZETKA," excluding alcohol, tobacco products, and gift certificates.
How Does It Work?
Bring your device and ID to a ROZETKA store.
We’ll appraise the value of your gadget and issue a certificate for the corresponding amount.
Use the certificate at the checkout to buy and pay for a new device or other items. If the item's price exceeds the certificate's value, simply pay the difference.
Rozetka Trade-In is a convenient service for upgrading your tech and saving money!
Download the Rozetka app now and explore a new level of online shopping. Shopping has become simpler, faster, and more rewarding!

bluejetty:00155269:ios.description:
First National Bank of Dryden is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with First National Bank of Dryden:
- Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
- Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
- Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
- Transfer money between your accounts
- Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
- Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
- View and save your monthly statements
- Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the First National Bank of Dryden app, you must be enrolled as a The First National Bank of Dryden digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00134623:ios.description:
Discover a world of creative possibilities with our crafting app, offering an extensive collection of inspiring DIY craft ideas and expert craft tutorials to fuel your imagination. Dive into a diverse range of creative projects, including paper art, woodworking, and more, allowing you to craft beautiful, handmade crafts that reflect your unique style. Our app provides comprehensive step-by-step crafting guides, ensuring that crafters of all levels can successfully complete projects with confidence. Enjoy the convenience of offline crafting and the ability to bookmark crafts for quick access, so your crafting inspiration is always at hand. For visual learners, our app offers a vast array of video demonstrations, helping you master various crafting techniques. Find endless creative inspiration and discover new DIY ideas to bring your artistic visions to life. Whether you're a seasoned crafter or just beginning, our app caters to all, making it the ultimate destination for your crafting journey. Explore the world of craft projects, embrace your crafty hobbies, and create heartfelt homemade gifts with expert guidance. Start your crafting adventure today with an app designed for both crafting for beginners and experienced artists. Immerse yourself in the world of art and craft, where your creativity knows no bounds.
Key Features:
Offline Crafting, Anytime, Anywhere: No internet connection? No problem! Our app offers an extensive selection of craft projects that you can download and access offline. Craft whenever and wherever you feel inspired, with no interruptions.
Bookmark Your Favorites: With our convenient bookmark feature, you can save and organize your preferred craft ideas, ensuring you never lose track of that project you can't wait to try. It's your personal DIY crafting library at your fingertips.
Step-by-Step Crafting: Discover a treasure trove of craft tutorials with clear and detailed step-by-step instructions. From the initial materials to the finishing touches, you'll have expert guidance every step of the way, making it easy for beginners and seasoned crafters alike.
Crafting Through Video: Visual learners, rejoice! Our app boasts an extensive library of video tutorials, allowing you to watch and learn from experienced crafters. See the techniques in action and gain confidence in your crafting skills.
Endless Crafting Inspiration: Delve into a diverse array of craft ideas, including paper crafting, knitting, jewelry making, woodworking, and so much more. Explore new horizons and ignite your creativity with each visit to the app.

bluejetty:00177386:ios.description:

• Replace objects using ready-made templates or your own
• Create your own content like stickers, stories, creatives, logos
Moreover, all this can be used not only manually, but also using SMART function! Never before has photo editing been so easy and so much fun.

3. Yearly plan

- Within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, your account will be debited with the renewal fee, including the cost of the renewal.
- You can manage subscriptions and disable auto-renewal after purchase by going to your App Store account settings.
- Any unused portion of the free trial period, if offered, will be voided when you purchase your subscription.
- The offer is limited to a 3-day trial for a one-week subscription. After the 3-day trial period expires, the subscription will automatically renew according to the rate unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the 3-day trial ends.

bluejetty:00150220:ios.description:
Pixel Shrine JINJA is a shrine building defense game based on ancient Japanese shrine. 
You can create beautiful shrines in a world of pixel art.
*How to play
The shrine is connected to the road to attract worshippers.
Receive resources from worshippers.
Reinforce the buildings with the collected resources and prepare for enemy attacks.
When you defeat enemies, your shrine level will increase and you will get buildings and plants.
The number of buildings will be increased by raising the level, and the shrine will be enlarged.
*Features of the game
Resources can be accumulated even when the game is closed.
You can place terrain blocks and water sources anywhere you like.
Shrines can be opened to other players.
You can give souvenirs to players who visit your shrine.
Various buildings such as shrines, torii gates, and kaguraden (Shinto music and dance halls) will appear in the game.
You can take a walk with a dog with the walk function.
Combat progresses automatically.
The skills of the residents, the characteristics of the buildings, and the gimmick elements provide a deep gameplay experience.
*This game is recommended for the following people.
People who like to build things
People who like pixel art
People who like to grow

bluejetty:00090784:ios.description:
Are you ready to manage your own hotel and become the ultimate hospitality tycoon? Look no further than Hotel Star, the ultimate hotel simulation and time management game. With stunning graphics, engaging gameplay, and a host of exciting features, Hotel Star lets you experience what it's like to run your hotel.
And as you travel the world and build your hotel empire, you'll encounter new and exciting challenges unique to each city and country. Whether it's the hustle and bustle of New York City, the romantic charm of Paris, the serene beaches of Bali, or the cultural wonders of Japan, each city offers a unique and thrilling experience that you won't find anywhere else.
By Upgrading you'll be able to design and customize every aspect of your hotel, from the lobby to the rooms to the amenities. Choose the perfect decor and equipment to make your guests feel at home, and upgrade your hotel to attract more visitors and earn more profits.
But running a hotel isn't just about design - it's also about managing your time and resources effectively. You'll need to keep your staff organized and your guests happy, all while dealing with unexpected challenges and emergencies.
Feature Highlights
- Super easy Tap based game
- Amazing graphics and addictive gameplay
- Play Offline anytime anywhere
- Fast-Paced time management game
- Tailor-made challenging levels for a fun experience
- Travel & open grand luxury hotels around the world- 
- Cook all kinds of tasty food to satisfy your guest’s hunger
- Collect coins, gems, likes and smiles to upgrade hotels
- Powerful Boosters to reach any goals
- One of the best new cooking and hotel games
- Highly recommended games for girls, men and women.
In Hotel Star, you'll take on the role of a hotel manager, tasked with designing, building, and managing your hotel. You'll need to hire staff, manage guest satisfaction, and keep your hotel running smoothly, all while dealing with unexpected challenges and surprises.
And with regular updates and new content, Hotel Star is the perfect way to satisfy your inner hotel tycoon. So why wait? Download Hotel Star today and embark on a journey of adventure, discovery, and hotel tycoonery across the globe!

* Remote recor
bluejetty:00063845:ios.description:
This app lets you control a Panasonic Wi-Fi camera via a smartphone.
Compatible models
 S series: DC-S1 / S1R / S1H / S5 / BS1H / S5M2 / S5M2X / S9
 G series: DC-G100 / G110 / GH5M2 / BGH1 / GH6 / G9M2 / G100D / GH7 / G97
* Remote recording and image transfer functions can be used with DC-GH5 / GH5S / G9.
 For using all functions, use Panasonic Image App.
* For models other than the above, use Panasonic Image App.
--
The Panasonic LUMIX Sync application software allows you to operate a Panasonic digital camera supporting Wi-Fi with your smartphone. With it, you can copy images into your smartphone, take pictures from your smartphone by remote control, and do more.
The following major functions are available with this application.
・LUMIX Sync allows you to copy pictures and videos from the digital camera to your smartphone.
・LUMIX Sync allows you to take pictures by remote control, checking the digital camera live view on your smartphone.
・LUMIX Sync allows you to easily register a camera (camera pairing) through guidance.
・LUMIX Sync allows you to easily make a Wi-Fi connection through Bluetooth.
・The photographic location (location information) is automatically recorded to pictures, which is handy for sorting pictures later on.
・LUMIX Sync, which supports 802.11ac Wi-Fi, allows you to copy images at a higher speed through a Wi-Fi router. (*1)
・LUMIX Sync includes "User Guide", which allows you to know more about how to use it.
 *1: The Wi-Fi router and smartphone must support 802.11ac.
[Compatible Operating Systems]
　　iOS 16 – 26
[Notes]
・When using an iPhone or iPad that is equipped with a GPS sensor, be aware that continued use of the GPS function can lead to a dramatic decrease in battery capacity.
・Continued use of GPS/Bluetooth running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00095585:ios.description:
EMERGENCY! The art world needs YOU! Those adorable yarn sprites who call the world’s most famous paintings home are in desperate trouble! One minute they were living the colorful high life, the next… BAM! Acid rain washed all their colors away, leaving them as sad, gray shadows of their former selves! 
But all hope is not lost! Now’s your chance to unleash your inner color wizard and embark on a mission to recover the scattered, vibrant yarn coils that hold the power to restore their world! 
Think collecting yarn is easy? Think again! You’ll need to put your engineering hat on and master a range of quirky, mechanical devices to snag those precious coils.
Sharpen your focus! Your mission is to carefully match the colors and start collecting!
Easy to pick up, but a satisfying challenge awaits for anyone!
Join us and use your skills and compassion to help these sweet yarn sprites regain their dazzling hues! The fate of the art world is in your hands!

bluejetty:00137357:ios.name: GO / Taxi app for Japan visit
bluejetty:00137357:ios.summary:
・GO is most used Taxi App(Taxi booking app)in Japan
GO is Japan's No.1 App (cab app) with the most extensive service coverage, available in all 47 prefectures across Japan! Coverage extends to all major tourist areas, such as Hokkaido, Toky
bluejetty:00137357:ios.description:
・GO is most used Taxi App(Taxi booking app)in Japan
GO is Japan's No.1 App (cab app) with the most extensive service coverage, available in all 47 prefectures across Japan! Coverage extends to all major tourist areas, such as Hokkaido, Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka, Fukuoka, and Okinawa.
80％ of time spent on Taxi Apps in Japan is on GO.
You can now sign up with a non-Japanese mobile number.
* Sourced from data.ai by Sensor Tower
- Number of taxi app downloads in Japan（iOS）
- Survey period: October 1, 2020 - June 30, 2026
- Among the top 5 taxi apps in Japan, GO has approximately 80% of the market share of total usage time.（Total of iOS and Android smartphone）
- Survey period: January 1, 2021 - June 30, 2026
*Actual app screen may differ.
・Travel around Japan easily with GO
Use GO to hail the nearest Taxi(cab) to get to your destination easily. No more having to stand on the side of the road waiting for one to go by!
- Go easy anywhere on time
- Stress-free Taxi(cab) experience
- Best Taxi(cab) type selection
・From hail to payment in one app by using GO
Do everything from hailing a Taxi(cab), to confirming your ride and paying your fare in the GO app, and go easy anywhere in Japan.
・GO PREMIUM: Request a large luxury van
With the GO app you can easily request a professional, highly-rated driver to pick you up in a luxury van with seating for up to six. 
This service is available in major areas of Tokyo and Nagoya.
Visit the webpage below for details.
https://go.goinc.jp/en/premium
・Airport Flat-rate
Get flat-rate fares from a location you specify, such as your home, hotel, a train station or travel destination to select airports. With GO there is no need to make reservations in advance: you can take advantage of this flat-rate even if you want to hail a Taxi right away.
Currently available for: boarding from Tokyo - Haneda/ Narita Airport (Tokyo - Narita is only transfer to the airport).
・Pay your fare cashlessly with GO Pay while you ride
Pay for your fare automatically by adding your credit card in the app and choosing GO Pay in the Taxi. When you arrive at your destination just get out.
No more time wasted dealing with change or credit cards.
*Not available in all Taxis
・Advance Destination Setting
With this feature, you can hail a Taxi and set your destination ahead of time. This eliminates having to explain your destination to the driver, so there is no need to worry if you cannot communicate in Japanese.
・Confirmation Number
Give this number to the driver when your Taxi arrives, then get in. You no longer have to worry about finding your Taxi and being sure you are getting in the right one.
・Reservation Service: Reserve a Taxi for a specific date and time
Our Reservation Service automatically hails a Taxi for you on the date and time you specify. Reservations can be made from 15 minutes to 7 days in advance.
A service charge will apply in addition to the Taxi fare at the time of payment.
*While limited to certain urban areas, new areas being added all the time.
・Tipping Feature
Show your appreciation to your driver by giving them a tip. You can give tips at the end of the ride from the rating screen or from "Usage History / Receipt" in the GO app's menu.
*Tips are optional.
[Notes for using GO]
- If there are no available cars nearby, we may not be able to dispatch a car.
- In addition to fare and pickup fee, GO App charge will apply in some areas.
- Credit cards accepted: Visa / Mastercard / JCB / American Express / Diners Club
- Estimated arrival time is based on current conditions and these may change depending on traffic and other factors.
- Please note that the car request may be cancelled after it has been accepted due to traffic or other reasons.
- Location and push notification permission must be turned on when using this service.

Aumente a segurança e melhore a comunicação no seu condomínio!
O Severino APP é um aplicativo para condomínios com funcionalidades para moradores, síndicos e portaria. Tenha o interfone no seu bolso, sempre! 
Contate o seu vizinho, agende o salão de festas, fique sabendo quando há nova correspondência para você na portaria, receba avisos e saiba antes de chegar em casa que haverá manutenção no prédio, autorize a entrada do seu amigo ou pré-autorize a pizza subir sem perturbar o filme. Tudo isso no seu smartphone ou tablet. 
Conheça mais sobre o Severino:
É o seu novo Interfone:
Atenda seu interfone, onde estiver. Não precisa mais ir até a cozinha para ouvir que alguém da família está subindo, nem pare o filme para descer quando você já pré-autorizou que a pizza pode subir.
Fique sabendo, de qualquer lugar, avisos do condomínio: se vai faltar água, se o elevador está com problema ou se um amigo deixou uma encomenda.

Protego – Security App
Protego is a comprehensive security solution designed to protect your iPhone and your personal information. With advanced device protection, network security, and privacy monitoring, Protego helps you maintain control and peace of mind.

Device Security: Monitor your OS and password protection to ensure your device stays safe.
Battery Health: Track and maintain battery performance for optimal device operation.

Identity Monitoring: Stay informed about potential email leaks and protect your personal information.
Wi-Fi Security & VPN: Secure your connection on public and unsecured networks.
WebShield (DNS): Protect against unsafe websites and harmful content while browsing.
Subscription Options:
Weekly: $9.99 with a 3-day free trial
Monthly: $19.99

Protego is built with your privacy in mind. All personal data stays on your device and is never shared or uploaded.

• Stuck on a question? Just ask.For the last 10 years, QANDA has answered
bluejetty:00015626:ios.description:
Chosen by over 95 million students worldwide, QANDA helps you learn smarter and more enjoyably. Experience the new QANDA today—studying becomes easier and even fun!
• Stuck on a question? Just ask.For the last 10 years, QANDA has answered billions of student questions, providing the most accurate step-by-step explanations.
Now, in addition to taking a photo of your question, you can chat with QANDA AI to solve problems interactively. 
Try asking:“Make a similar question using this concept.”
You’ll instantly get a concept quiz. QANDA not only gives you the answer—it also generates step-by-step solutions, concept quizzes, similar problems, and even an incorrect-answer notebook.
• All the study tools you needQANDA includes everything you need while studying—from past exam questions and quizzes to a formula calculator and QANDA Notes.
· Upload your school’s past exam questions, and our AI analyzes them to show key patterns, high-frequency topics, common wrong answers, and even creates practice tests. Since QANDA’s database contains most problems on the market, powerful analysis is possible.

bluejetty:00173210:ios.summary: Get ready to indulge in a delightful world of Sweet Cube Blast! In this exciting same-match blast game, you’ll join Nancy, a talented home baker, and her trusty companion, Jack on a sweet journey to become the most renowned pastry chefs in
bluejetty:00173210:ios.description:
Get ready to indulge in a delightful world of Sweet Cube Blast! In this exciting same-match blast game, you’ll join Nancy, a talented home baker, and her trusty companion, Jack on a sweet journey to become the most renowned pastry chefs in town! With hundreds of unique and challenging levels, Sweet Cube Blast offers a fun family-friendly game that’s easy to learn but hard to master. 
Blast colorful cubes and solve challenging puzzles to create powerful boosters that will help you overcome difficult obstacles! With Jack by your side, you’ll navigate your way through a sweet adventure and face exciting daily challenges that will keep you entertained for hours. Use special power-ups like rockets or bombs to help you complete harder levels and enjoy a variety of missions. 
But that’s not all all! Sweet Cube Blast now offers an updated and improved user experience. Enjoy a smoother gameplay, new levels and challenges, and even more colorful graphics and animations. And with the option to purchase in-app items like ad-free or coins, you can enhance your gaming experience even further. 
So what are you waiting for? Join Nancy and Jack on their sweet adventure and grab a sweet treat to enjoy as you match and blast your way through this addictive puzzle game!
HOW TO PLAY
• Tap on 2+ adjacent cubes of the same color to blast!
• Match the cubes in fewer moves to score higher.
• Reach your goal by matching every cube carefully.
• Blast many cubes at the same time to create awesome boosters. 
GAME FEATURES
• Hundreds of addicting levels!
• Gorgeous and colorful game graphics.
• Full of exciting challenges and daily rewards.
• No wifi required. Play offline!
NOTES
• Sweet Cube Blast is free to play, but you can purchase in-app items.
• Sweet Cube Blast contains advertisements.
• Sweet Cube Blast is optimized for smartphones & tablets. 
E-MAIL
• contactus@puzzle1studio.com
PRIVACY POLICY
• https://www.bitmango.com/privacy-policy/
Have fun & enjoy!

bluejetty:00184932:ios.description:
Follow an enigmatic Cleopatra and her spooky companion, The Mummy, into the deserts of Ancient Egypt to play Pyramid Solitaire: Mummy’s Curse. Under the sand dunes lies a pyramid, waiting to be raised. Will you be able to uncover its hidden treasure?
With detailed graphics, clear-cut sound effects and, above all, relaxing gameplay, you will be captivated by its moreish quality. One game will never seem enough, especially as you can track your progress on our scoreboard! 
It’s easy to learn. Simply match cards which add to 13 to remove them. Clear all the cards up to the peak to win the round and unveil an ancient pyramid. But be quick! The less time you take, the larger your score bonus! 
Try to better your time with each round or compete with friends with online scores. You can even compete against yourself and others in your home with the additional local score board. 
FEATURES OF MUMMY'S CURSE PYRAMID
- High Quality graphics of a spooky ancient Egypt 
- Simple to play; just tap away!
- Global Leader Boards
- Atmospheric Sound Effects
- The original accumulative score mode. When the high scoreboard in the game is full, you can keep on trying to beat each other!
- One of the most beloved types of solitaire, a totally different game to Tri-Peaks, Spider Solitaire and Klondike!
As a universal application, this card game adapts to look and play perfectly on either your iPhone or iPad.
Simply put, this is the best version of pyramid solitaire you can get.

bluejetty:00032671:ios.description:

• Coin collectors identifying, organizing, and valuing their collections

• Metal detectorists identifying finds in the field
• Buyers researching a coin before an auction, coin show, or flea-market purchase
Coinoscope has helped collectors identify tens of millions of coins since 2018. Coin identification is free and unlimited. Coinoscope Pro removes ads and removes daily limits on Value Estimates and Advanced Image Analysis.

bluejetty:00077373:ios.summary: Get ready for the ultimate card gaming experience with Spades: Classic Card Game! If you're a fan of strategic gameplay and thrilling challenges, then you're in for a treat. Spades: Classic Card Game is your go-to choice for endless hours o
bluejetty:00077373:ios.description:
Get ready for the ultimate card gaming experience with Spades: Classic Card Game! If you're a fan of strategic gameplay and thrilling challenges, then you're in for a treat. Spades: Classic Card Game is your go-to choice for endless hours of entertainment.
Spades: Classic Card Game is about mastering the art of spades, where every move you make can tip the scales in your favor. Join millions of players worldwide and dive into the world of spades like never before. Play against people worldwide or challenge skilled AI opponents for an exhilarating showdown.
RULES OF THE GAME: In Spades, differently from Solitaire Card Games, players are divided into two teams and work together to win tricks based on the cards' strength. The game is played with a standard deck of 52 cards. Players bid on the number of tricks their team will win, and spades are always the trump suit. The team that meets or exceeds their bid wins points while failing to meet the bid results in penalties. The goal is to reach a predetermined score first.
SPADES, SPADES, SPADES! 
Embrace the excitement as you bid, strategize, and play your cards right in this classic game of spades. Outsmart your opponents and score those elusive spades to secure your victory. It's all about teamwork and precision in this intense card battle!
CARD GAME EXCLUSIVES
But wait, there's more! Alongside the heart-pounding spades action, we've also included several avatars you can choose from to stand out from the other people!
SPADES FOR ALL SKILL LEVELS
Whether you're a Spades pro or a newcomer to the game, Spades: Classic Card Game offers an engaging and customizable experience. Adjust the rules and settings to match your skill level and preferences. Learn the ropes, sharpen your strategies, and become a spades master!
MULTIPLE GAME MODES
Dive into the world of spades with a variety of game modes to choose from. Play in Classic mode for a traditional experience or try your luck in the multiplayer universe. You don't have to play alone anymore like in Solitaire Card Games
SOCIALIZE AND COMPETE
Connect with friends and players from around the globe in multiplayer mode. Collaborate with your partner to conquer the opposition, or prove your skills in the solo modes. Climb the leaderboards, we will be watching!
Download Spades: Classic Card Game now and experience the thrill of spades like never before. With spades at the core and solitaire modes to enhance your gaming experience, this app is a must-have for every card game enthusiast. Don't miss out – immerse yourself in the world of spades today and leave Solitaire Card Games for another time!

Enjoy a refreshed mobile experience with updated menus, a redesi
bluejetty:00035353:ios.description:
Your finances, on your terms. Blue Digital by Blue Federal Credit Union makes it easy to manage your accounts, move money, and stay connected to Blue wherever life takes you.
Enjoy a refreshed mobile experience with updated menus, a redesigned passcode screen, and helpful improvements to transaction memos and payment notifications. View and edit scheduled transfers right from your mobile device, and see your scheduled transaction history for greater visibility into your money.
GETTING STARTED
Log in with your Blue Digital username and password. New to Blue Digital? Select “Enroll for a Login” in the app to create your credentials and get started.
MANAGE YOUR MONEY
• Securely view account balances and transaction history.
• Transfer money between accounts and set up external accounts.
• View and edit scheduled transfers.
• View your scheduled transaction history.
• Make loan payments and pay bills.
• Send money to people you know and trust with Zelle®.
• Deposit checks using your mobile device’s camera.
MANAGE YOUR CARDS
• Activate your cards, add travel notices, and change your PIN.
• Launch CardNav by Blue FCU from within Blue Digital by Blue FCU to activate your cards, add travel notices, and change your PIN, and more.
STAY CONNECTED
• Send and receive secure messages with Blue.
• Update your contact information.
• Find nearby branches and ATMs.
SECURITY
All transactional data is encrypted, and no sensitive account information is stored on your mobile device.
PERMISSIONS
• Location permissions are used to help you find nearby branches and ATMs.
• Camera permissions are needed to deposit checks remotely.
The companion CardNav by Blue FCU app periodically collects, transmits, and uses geolocation information to enable features that prevent fraudulent card use and send alerts, but only if you, the End User, expressly authorize collection of such information. Geolocation information can be monitored on a continuous basis in the background, only while the Solution is being used, or not at all, depending on the End User’s selection. End Users can change their location permissions at any time in their device settings.
ACCESS
Deposit limits, transaction limits, and other restrictions apply. Access to Blue Digital is subject to eligibility. Some features are available for eligible members and accounts only. There is no charge from Blue Federal Credit Union to use the Blue Digital app, but message and data rates may apply.
All transactions are subject to our Funds Availability Policy and related applicable laws.
QUESTIONS OR NEED HELP?
Blue Federal Credit Union
www.BlueFCU.com
1-800-368-9328
support@BlueFCU.com

This is a different kind of notes app. Simpler. Smarter. Better.
